About Centric Software:

Centric Software® is a global leader, providing an innovative and AI-enabled product-concept-to-commercialization platform for retailers, brands and manufacturers of all sizes. We equip retail, fashion, luxury, footwear, outdoor, home and consumer goods brands with pioneering best-of-breed solutions to plan, design, develop, source, comply, buy, make, price, allocate, sell and replenish products. Our technology powers brands to streamline processes, drive efficiency and operate with confidence in an ever-changing market.

Our story is one of rapid growth, bold ideas and extraordinary opportunities. We’re here to challenge the status quo—and we’re looking for brilliant people who want to do the same. No matter where you are in the world, this is your chance to be part of something exceptional.

Job Summary:

Position effectively high-impact solutions across sales engagements, marketing initiatives, and business development activities by effectively positioning Centric Planning & Pricing solutions. Translate customer requirements into tailored and differentiating solution capabilities, ensuring alignment with customer business objectives. Partner closely with Professional Services to develop compelling, high-quality proposals that support successful deal execution.

About the Team:

The global Centric Planning & Pricing team is at the forefront of delivering planning and pricing best-in-class solutions for the fashion and retail industries. Comprised of dynamic, results-driven solution, technical and business experts, the team specializes in end-to-end planning systems that drive measurable customer success. Through deep industry knowledge and a collaborative approach, the team consistently delivers innovative solutions that enable clients to optimize performance and achieve their strategic goals

Responsibilities:

  • Analyze customer business requirements as a basis to propose Planning & Pricing Solutions
  • Collaborate with the rest of Sales Team in qualifying prospects
  • Responsible for in-depth, broad-based pre-sales presentations of the entire Centric Planning and Pricing Solution suite
  • Position and Configure when required Centric Planning and Pricing solutions which are fit for purpose through product presentations and supporting materials.
  • Produce written specifications (i.e. Solution Scope Documents and Use Case Documents) highlighting product features and benefits / value-add to customers to capture business process requirements for proposed solutions.
  • Analyze requirements and design solutions for complex customer requirements and its pain points
  • Prepare response documentation for RFI/RFP requests
  • Ensure clear understanding of customer’s technology requirements; providing support for proposal and project teams and technical leadership with a vision to win and deliver large- scale, complex solutions.
  • Transition customer and requirements knowledge to Professional Services Project Teams and be involved in early phases (typically the general analysis) of the implementation / customer onboarding project. This is normally 10/20% of the role’s yearly activity allocation.
  • Provide input into future solution functionality, implementation methodology and customization standards.
  • Take part in marketing campaigns according to personal understanding on markets and customer potential needs, ensuring that sales pitches are also aligned

Qualifications:

• Bachelors or Masters Degree

  • Availability for travel depending on location and
  • Fashion / Specialty Retail Planning processes industry expertise.
  • Significant experience with Software Planning, Optimization, Analytics.
  • Knowledge of database and BI data science applications
  • Excellent presentation, and application demonstration skills with small or large audiences
  • Ability to develop multi-level relationships of confidence and trust with customers and cross-functional colleagues.
  • Ability to adapt to a rapidly evolving technology and commercial environment

Centric Software provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status or genetic information.

Company Overview Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM). What you'll do Scaled Customer Success Managers (Scaled CSMs) operate as part of the broader Customer Success team. They focus on targeted 1:1 and 1:many customer engagements that complement our digital programs and designated CSAM coverage, helping customers achieve measurable business outcomes and realise maximum value from the Docusign platform at scale. Scaled CSMs lead strategic, outcome-driven engagements across the customer lifecycle (launch, optimise, renew), specialising in adoption, optimisation and expansion motions for commercial and enterprise segments. They partner closely with Digital CSMs, Customer Success Account Managers (CSAMs), Account Executives and Renewal Specialists to intervene at key moments-such as low adoption or upcoming renewals-to drive usage, mitigate risk and uncover new growth opportunities. The successful candidate will be comfortable working in a one-to-many model, managing a high volume of requests while delivering high-quality, expert-led 1:1 or 1:many engagements through calls and webinars. This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Manager, Dynamic Customer Success Management, EMEA. Responsibility Work at scale across a portfolio of customers to increase satisfaction and long-term value, as measured by customer health, product usage, net revenue retention and post-engagement feedback Deliver targeted 1:1 engagements (e.g., health checks, optimisation sessions, feature adoption, use-case design) to diagnose current usage, uncover blockers and recommend best-practice solutions on Docusign IAM, eSignature and related products within Scaled CSM scope (templates, PowerForms, web forms, IDV, branding, org admin and standard integrations, etc.) Partner with Digital CSMS, CSAMS, AEs and Renewal Specialists to engage customers identified through CTAs, digital campaigns, webinars or renewal workflows especially under-trending or at-risk accounts and those approaching key renewal dates Run renewal-readiness and adoption-focused sessions that clarify value, optimize existing use cases, surface new use cases and help protect and grow recurring revenue Translate technical and product concepts into clear, easy-to-follow guidance, including recommended configurations, workflows and next steps tailored to the customer's business objectives Document all engagements, recommended actions and outcomes in Gainsight and Salesforce to ensure full visibility for the wider account team and to inform scaled success programs Collaborate with internal teams (Digital Success, CSAMs, Sales, Renewals, Support, Marketing and Operations) to share customer insights, influence product and program priorities, and continuously improve our scaled success motions Contribute to playbooks, best-practice content and success stories that can be reused in digital programs and by peers across Scaled, Digital and designated CSAM teams Job Designation Remote: Employee is not required to be in or near an office frequently and works from a designated remote work location for the majority of the time. Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law. What you bring Basic 3+ years of related experience Fluent in English and Spanish Experience in customer-facing roles such as customer success, account management, consulting, support or implementation, preferably within SaaS Experience breaking down technical enablement into clear, step-by-step guidance for non-technical audiences Experience crafting and delivering clear, concise customer communications across email, calls and digital channels Experience working with data and reports (e.g., usage, health scores) to prioritise actions and track impact Preferred Passion for addressing customer needs and driving successful delivery of enablement solutions that improve adoption and outcomes Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage a large volume of daily requests while maintaining quality and attention to detail Collaborative, goal-oriented and team-centric, with a high level of resilience and a positive attitude in the face of challenges Experience in scaled / digital customer success or tech-touch programs, including playbook-driven engagements and use of CTAS Examples of success working on a large volume of requests while maintaining strong customer outcomes History of collaborating with cross-functional teams to build and execute adoption strategies and scaled playbooks Familiarity with Docusign products (eSignature, IDV, IAM) and common commercial SaaS use cases Experience using systems such as Salesforce, Gainsight, Outreach and analytics or BI tools in a customer success context Life at Docusign Working here Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal. We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live. Group Regional Business Manager - ADG BU is a people-leadership role responsible for leading the ADG European Regional Business Manager organization and managing multiple Business Managers, including Senior Business Managers, across the EMEA region. The role reports to the ADG BU Director of Business Management – AMER & EMEA and may be based in any major European city.

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:

  • Recruit and lead a high-performing team of Regional Business Managers that delivers business wins and strong growth for ADG.
  • Coach and develop Regional Business Managers in domain expertise, sales, business planning, leadership, and influencing skills.
  • Lead and mentor teams to achieve the Orders and Sales Targets for overall ADG and specific ADG systems/applications in alignment with Business Line Lead Managers.
  • Manage the business outcomes for ADG investments within the region.
  • Design, recommend, and execute EMEA Business Manager coverage aligned with the highest potential growth opportunities identified by the Business Unit and Regional Sales.
  • Lead and enable Sales teams to identify priority regional accounts and generate new ADG revenue.
  • Deliver annual Business Manager targets and key sales objectives.
  • Provide industry and regional customer insights to help shape current and future ADG systems.
  • Lead go-to-market activities alongside Sales and recommend strategic adjustments when needed.
  • Serve as the Business Unit’s primary leadership representative for EMEA sales strategy and execution.
  • Gather insights into government initiatives, programs, and market requirements.
  • Build credibility and develop key relationships with prime contractors, program offices, government depots, and industry influencers.
  • Own and be accountable for ADG growth and ADG Applications/Systems growth in collaboration with Business Managers, Regional Sales Leadership, key regional stakeholders, partner ecosystems, executive influencers, customers, and prospects.

Who You Are:

You build strong partnerships and work collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives. You develop and deliver communications that address the unique needs of different audiences. You create and implement strategies that align with long-term business goals while adapting to evolving market conditions. You develop talent and foster an environment where individuals can grow, contribute, and achieve shared success.

For This Role, You Will Need:

  • Bachelor's degree in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics).
  • 10+ years of experience in sales.
  • 5+ years of experience managing sales professionals.
  • 5+ years of experience within the Aerospace, Defense, and Government industry.
  • Aerospace and Defense industry domain expertise, including technical, business, market, competitive, and National Instruments-related knowledge.
  • Proven expertise in leading teams and contributing as part of a senior leadership team.
  • Track record of leading customer-facing engagements that deliver customer and business success.
  • Demonstrated leadership in account planning and business planning.
  • UK or EU citizenship and the ability to obtain applicable governmental security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:

  • Ability to influence external partners and effectively align internal resources to drive customer success.
  • Demonstrated ability to build partnerships and collaborate with senior leaders across an organization.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams toward strategic objectives and milestones over multiple years.

Our Culture & Commitment to You:

At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.

raw.description:
Overview

Your Future. Secured. ISC2 is a force for good. As the world’s leading nonprofit member organization for cybersecurity professionals, our core values — Integrity, Advocacy, Commitment, Diversity, Inclusion, and Excellence — drive everything we do in support of our vision of a safe and secure cyber world. Our globally recognized, award-winning portfolio of certifications provide an independent and globally recognized endorsement of cybersecurity knowledge, skills and experience for all career levels. Our charitable arm, the Center for Cyber Safety and Education, enables ISC2 and our members to serve the public by educating the most vulnerable about cyber risks and empowering access to enter and thrive in the cyber profession. Learn more at ISC2 online and connect with us on Twitter, Facebook and LinkedIn. When you join ISC2, you’ll demonstrate your commitment to an inclusive and equitable environment. Your support of the unique perspectives and experiences shared by our global cybersecurity workforce and profession will be recognized. We invite you to take an active role in helping us create a true sense of belonging across our organization — an environment of authenticity, trust, empowerment and connectedness that empowers all of our successes. Learn more.

Position Summary

The Sr. Instructional Designer (Sr. ID) will work with the ISC2 Education team, subject matter experts, external vendors, and member volunteers to develop. purposeful and quality learning experiences and materials. The Sr. ID is primarily responsible for the design of instructional content for all deliverables; working with content team members to influence the creation of information to be taught and organized into logical, instructional patterns that are appropriate for the culture and level of expertise of the learners. Responsible for delivering learning solutions at the highest level of complexity which includes high profile strategic initiatives and online and in-person education for cybersecurity professionals.

**This position is not available to residents of California**.

Responsibilities

  • Drives innovative learning design approaches utilizing effective instructional design strategies and adult learning principles to facilitate the design, development and production of experiences that best serve the learning needs and preferences of the defined audience(s).
  • Influences the creation of course statements and analysis documents that communicate the scope of work for learning projects.
  • Manages subject matter experts and third-party providers to support the development of a variety of interactive and innovative learning solutions that are high quality, personalized, streamlined, and targeted, on time and on budget, that align with the overarching enterprise learning and assessment strategy.
  • Collaborates with the multimedia and other development teams to develop and deliver highly engaging and interactive learning assets that reflect best practices in learner and user experience and adult learning theory.
  • Leads and collaborates with team members, SME’s, instructors, and other relevant stakeholders to evaluate learning and ensure updates or revisions are implemented in accordance with instructional design best practices and current learning preferences.
  • Aides team professional development on technology-specific and instructional design best practices and modern learning preferences.
  • Researches and identifies internal and external resources for instructional material development and learner materials.
  • Reviews and revises course content designs accordingly to promote and ensure quality experiences.
  • Remains knowledgeable and proficient in best practices, strategies, tools, and current preferences in curriculum and learning design and development.
  • Performs miscellaneous duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Ability to lead and mentor others.
  • Proficient knowledge of Learning Management Systems (D2L preferred).
  • Exceptional proficiency/ability to work with subject matter experts to guide online course asset development and standards alignment.
  • Ability to use advanced adult learning and instructional design principles to create effective distance-learning courses.
  • Ability to persuade colleagues to encourage innovation.
  • A strong sense of responsibility, attention to detail, and proven commitment to quality.
  • Ability to independently follow through to successful completion of projects within a deadline.
  • Ability and desire to continuously learn and apply new innovations in adult learning.
  • Passionate about making learning invigorating and empowering experience.
  • Intermediate to advance knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint.
  • Ability to demonstrate and support the 5 Company Core Values: Integrity, Advocacy, Commitment, Diversity, Inclusion, and Excellence.
  • Ability to apply effective leadership and mentoring techniques.
  • Ability to guide and influence others.
  • Effective communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability and willingness to work professionally with teammates, partners, subject matter experts, clients, and other departments.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to independently follow through to successful completion of projects with great emphasis on detail and meeting aggressive deadlines.

Education and Work Experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree preferably in Education, Instructional Design, Curriculum Development, Online Learning, or a related IT field; Master’s Degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience in curriculum and learning design, development, and delivery.
  • Experience with assessment development and/or standards alignment preferred.
  • Experience working with AI tools or a demonstrated willingness to learn.
  • Experience in the association industry, a plus.

Physical and Mental Demands

  • Work normal business hours and extended hours when necessary.
  • Up to 10% travel required.
  • Remain in a stationary position, often standing or sitting, for prolonged periods.
  • Regular use of office equipment such as a computer/laptop and monitor computer screens.
  • Occasionally, approximately 5-10% of the time, transport and/or lift up to 25 lbs. of equipment or packages, which may also involve squatting, bending, or kneeling.

Total Rewards

The pay range for this position is $86,600 - $97,987/Yr.

Final pay is based on several factors including but not limited to internal equity, market data, and the applicant’s education, work experience, certifications, etc.

Information regarding our comprehensive benefits package is available here.

This position will be posted for a minimum of 5 calendar days. This is a current vacancy, and the employer intends to fill this position within approximately 30 days.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic as protected by applicable law. raw.description:
Harbor IT is a leading Managed Service Provider (MSP) specializing in delivering cutting edge Cybersecurity, IT, and Cloud Services to a diverse portfolio of clients. We pride ourselves on our commitment to excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction. Harbor IT is backed by investment firm Worklyn Partners since 2022 and has built a national platform through acquisition and rapid organic growth. Our mission is to manage our clients’ technology and mitigate their cyber risks, so that they don’t have to.

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Senior Network Engineer is Harbor IT's technical authority for network design and delivery, owning the architecture, engineering standards, and delivery quality for networking engagements across the client portfolio. This role leads pre-sales design work, drives complex network implementations, and sets the technical standard for Harbor IT's networking domain - spanning LAN/WAN, wireless, SD-WAN, network security, and next-generation campus and branch architectures.

The Senior Network Engineer has deep hands-on expertise with Extreme Networks and Fortinet platforms, both of which are core to Harbor IT's networking stack and required experience for this role. Beyond delivery, this role contributes to the practice by developing standards, reviewing peer designs, mentoring junior engineers, and engaging clients as a trusted advisor on infrastructure strategy. The ideal candidate brings enterprise-class architecture experience, strong vendor platform depth, and communication skills to operate effectively in both technical and client-facing contexts.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own network architecture and design across Harbor IT's professional services engagements including campus LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, wireless, and network security deployments.
  • Serve as technical lead and delivery authority on complex network implementations - providing hands-on engineering support and directing engineers and field resources through project execution.
  • Lead pre-sales solution design for networking opportunities including discovery sessions, architecture documentation, bill-of-materials development, and technical proposal support.
  • Design, configure, deploy, and validate Extreme Networks (campus switching, wireless, ExtremeCloud IQ) and Fortinet (FortiGate, FortiSwitch, FortiAP, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer) solutions as primary Harbor IT-supported platforms.
  • Develop and maintain Harbor IT's networking architecture standards, design templates, and configuration baselines to drive consistency and reduce delivery risk across the engineering team.
  • Conduct network assessments and health reviews for existing clients, producing findings reports and remediation roadmaps that translate technical risk into business language.
  • Collaborate with solutions architects and account managers during pre-sales to validate scope, identify technical risk, and produce accurate statements of work.
  • Mentor and develop junior and mid-level network engineers through project participation, design reviews, and direct technical coaching.
  • Maintain working knowledge of relevant vendor ecosystems including competitive platforms, licensing models, support structures, and roadmap direction.
  • Represent Harbor IT's networking practice in client-facing settings including architecture reviews, executive briefings, and technology strategy discussions.

QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS

  • Expert-level hands-on experience with Extreme Networks platforms including campus switching (EXOS/VOSS), wireless (ExtremeCloud IQ, AP series), and network management - required.
  • Expert-level hands-on experience with Fortinet platforms including FortiGate firewalls, FortiSwitch, FortiAP, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, and FortiClient EMS - required.
  • Strong architecture and design depth across LAN/WAN, campus networking, SD-WAN, network segmentation, VLANs, routing protocols (BGP, OSPF), and next-generation firewall policy design.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into network architecture designs and produce clear, client-ready documentation including diagrams, BOMs, and design rationale.
  • Experience leading network deployments as the senior technical resource - coordinating field engineers, managing vendor resources, and validating final configurations against design intent.
  • Solid understanding of network security principles including zero-trust segmentation, NGFW policy, NAC, and secure SD-WAN as applied to enterprise and mid-market environments.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills - able to present architecture recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences and contribute to pre-sales proposals.
  • Comfortable operating in an MSP professional services environment with concurrent client engagements, billable utilization expectations, and cross-functional coordination with PMs, architects, and account teams.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Network Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline. Equivalent experience considered.
  • 7+ years of network engineering and architecture experience, with at least 3 years in a senior architecture or lead engineer role.
  • Hands-on Extreme Networks experience required. ExtremeCloud IQ or EXOS/VOSS certification strongly preferred.
  • Hands-on Fortinet experience required. NSE 4 minimum required, NSE 7 or higher strongly preferred. FortiGate and FortiManager expertise essential.
  • Additional certifications a plus: CCNP (routing and switching or enterprise), CWNA/CWSP, SD-WAN vendor certifications.
  • MSP or consulting delivery background preferred over pure enterprise IT - experience managing multiple concurrent client environments is a meaningful differentiator.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Senior technical role within Harbor IT's Professional Services department, operating in an EOS-managed, growth-stage MSP environment with shared accountability across engineering, architecture, and project delivery functions.
  • Remote-first with occasional travel to client sites for network assessments, project deployments, and architecture reviews - infrequent but expected.
  • Direct client exposure across enterprise, healthcare, agribusiness, and defense-adjacent verticals with complex, multi-site network environments.

BENEFITS

  • Competitive base salary commensurate with experience

•Health, dental, and vision insurance

•401(k) with company match

•Unlimited PTO

raw.description:
Mission

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,
leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.

We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.

What You’ll Do:

  • Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.
  • Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.

What We Offer

raw.excerpt: OverviewPlanned Systems International (PSI) is an Enterprise IT services company who focuses on designing, building, securing, and operating cutting-edge software solutions that drive mission success and operational excellence for Federal Government organizations.
raw.description:
Overview

Planned Systems International (PSI) is an Enterprise IT services company who focuses on designing, building, securing, and operating cutting-edge software solutions that drive mission success and operational excellence for Federal Government organizations. PSI is currently seeking a Federal Acquisition Support Manager to join a Program Management Office (PMO) Support team supporting the VA Loan Guaranty (LGY) Product Line.

This critical role primarily focuses on supporting the LGY Government Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) team with contract administration activities, monitoring contract deliverables and invoice approvals, coordinating acquisition documentation, and serving as the primary contract-management resource for software development and operations efforts.

The position is a contractor support role within a PMO Support Team and serves as a vital bridge among Government program personnel, procurement organizations, budget/finance personnel, and the IT contractor. The ideal candidate will possess strong experience in federal contracting, experience supporting federal programs or COR functions, and the independent judgment to translate evolving requirements into clear contract-management actions in a fast-paced environment.

Essential Functions and Job Responsibilities

  • Support a Government program team in contract administration activities for federal contracts and task orders supporting VA LGY Product Line initiatives.
  • Lead the development of contract documentation through the entire acquisition lifecycle, from initial requirements development to submission of compliant procurement packages.
  • Monitor monthly contract deliverables; coordinate review, disposition, and approval by the appropriate Government authorities; and verify alignment with contractual requirements, schedules, quality standards, and program objectives.
  • Serve as a primary contract-management resource for the COR team, providing contract guidance and interpretation to internal teams, contractors, and Government stakeholders.
  • Facilitate and lead recurring contract status meetings with VA leadership, program managers, CORs, Contracting Officers (COs), budget personnel, and contractor personnel, serving as an interface between the IT contractor and Government stakeholders.
  • Coordinate closely with budget and finance personnel to track contract funding across Contract Line Item Numbers (CLINs) and support budget planning, execution, and funding-related contract actions.
  • Maintain accurate contract documentation, acquisition records, action items, status reports, meeting minutes, and milestone tracking.
  • Help manage and track contract-specific processes for initiating, planning, and executing mission-specific work, including optional-task activities and associated documentation.
  • Utilize Jira, Microsoft SharePoint, and other project management tools to manage project activities, monitor workflows, track deliverables, maintain documentation, and facilitate issue resolution across teams and stakeholders.
  • Coordinate across program management, budget/finance, procurement and procurement-support organizations, technical teams, and contractor personnel to advance contract actions and meet program and procurement timelines.
  • Identify contract risks, performance concerns, funding issues, and process gaps, and use independent judgment to recommend practical mitigation and resolution approaches.
  • Support contract modifications, invoice review and approval tracking, vendor coordination, performance evaluations, and compliance reporting.
  • Draft, edit, review, and coordinate contract and acquisition documentation, including Performance Work Statements (PWSs) sections, in-scope determinations/memoranda, Justifications and Approvals (J&As), and related acquisition artifacts; support budget personnel in the development and review of Independent Government Cost Estimates (IGCEs).
  • Apply federal acquisition knowledge and independent judgment to evolving program needs, identify required contract-management actions, and recommend practical paths forward in a fast-paced environment.
  • Translate program and technical requirements into clear contract-related documentation and procurement-ready acquisition artifacts for Government review.
  • Provide advisory and technical support to CORs and PMO leadership on acquisition, contract-management, and program-support matters.
  • Facilitate stakeholder communication and build working consensus among program, acquisition, budget, technical, and contractor teams when requirements, interpretations, priorities, or trade-offs differ.
  • Support Government stakeholders in applying the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), Veterans Affairs Acquisition Regulation (VAAR), agency policies, and contractual requirements.
  • Conduct research on special topics and recommend solutions to government clients.
  • Facilitate executive-level virtual meetings, including preparing meeting agendas, capturing minutes, and tracking outcomes and action items.
  • Work proactively and independently to carry out assignments to completion within parameters of instructions given, prescribed routines, and standard accepted practices.
  • Function as part of an integrated team sharing products, best practices, and information across the PMO Support Team.
  • Perform related duties as assigned by supervisor.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • At least 8 years of total professional experience with 5+ years in federal acquisition, contract management, COR support, and/or federal program/PMO support, preferably supporting IT modernization projects.
  • Federal acquisition certifications (FAC-C, FAC-C Professional, FAC-COR).
  • Strong knowledge of Federal acquisition and contract-support documentation for IT or professional services contracts, the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), Government budgeting and procurement lifecycles
  • Experience supporting Independent Government Cost Estimates (IGCEs), contract modifications, and contract administration support processes
  • Advanced experience in strategic planning and analysis for acquisition activities, requirements planning, and stakeholder management across program, technical, budget, and acquisition communities
  • Experience collaborating with CORs, COs/Contract Specialists, Budget personnel, PMO leadership, and contractor teams.
  • Experience working on multiple concurrent acquisition actions and program/technical requirement translation for contract and procurement purposes.
  • Experience in Federal PMO/program support and coordination activities
  • Demonstrated ability to: articulate complex contract requirements, options, and trade-offs clearly; manage detailed documentation with exceptional attention to accuracy; work effectively in fast-paced, evolving program environments; bridge program, technical, budget, and acquisition communities; and maintain organization across multiple concurrent projects.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with diverse stakeholder groups and exercise sound independent judgment when direction is incomplete or evolving.

Desired Qualifications

  • Familiarity with Veterans Affairs Acquisition Regulation (VAAR) strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency in project management tools (e.g., JIRA, MS Project) and methodologies.
  • Experience with Veterans Affairs or other federal agencies a plus.
  • Experience working in a contractor support role alongside Government acquisition and program personnel a plus.

Physical Demands

  • Ability to effectively communicate in English, including talking and hearing.
  • Ability to operate productively in a fully remote work environment, including the ability to take meetings and phone calls from a quiet and private space during business hours.
  • Ability and willingness to actively participate in virtual meetings throughout most of the workday and be responsive to messages (MS Teams) and emails (MS Outlook) within reasonable timeframes set by the supervisor or client.
  • Ability to be responsive and working during Eastern time zone standard business hours (8:00am to 4:00pm EST).
  • Ability to satisfy security clearance and onboarding requirements:
    • Print, sign, scan, and return onboarding documentation.
    • Travel at personal expense to nearest government facility to get fingerprinted, apply for a PIV badge, pick-up the PIV badge, and pick-up government equipment.

Additional Information

Professional Certifications

  • Federal acquisition certifications (FAC-C, FAC-C Professional, FAC-COR)

Required Technical/Business Tools

  • MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams)
  • MS SharePoint
  • MS Visio
  • Jira or comparable development management tool

Company Benefits

PSI offers full-time, benefits eligible employees a competitive total compensation package that includes paid leave, and options for employer sponsored group medical, dental, vision, short-term and long-term disability, life insurance, AD&D coverage, legal services, identity theft, and accident insurance. Flexible spending account and health saving account options offer pre-tax savings for qualified medical, dental, and vision expenses. The company sponsored 401(k) retirement plan has an employer contribution match that is immediately vested. We invest in the professional growth of our employees through professional courses, certifications, and tuition reimbursement programs.

EEO Commitment

It is company policy to promote equal employment opportunities. All personnel decisions, including, but not limited to, recruiting, hiring, training, promotion, compensation, benefits, and termination, are made without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, citizenship status, veteran status, protected veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

To ensure fair and consistent consideration of all applicants, all candidates must submit a formal application through Planned Systems International's Applicant Tracking System (ATS), iCIMS. Resumes submitted via email, social media, referrals, recruiting events, or other means will not be considered an official application and must be accompanied by a completed online application in the ATS before a candidate can be considered for employment. Reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities will be provided. If a reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, or to receive an update regarding the status of your application, please contact Talent Acquisition by emailing , or by dialing 703-575-8400.

raw.description:
Discover your 100% YOU with MicroSourcing!

Position: Staff Accountant
Work setup & shift: WFH, Midshift

Why join MicroSourcing?

You'll have:

Competitive Rewards: Enjoy above-market compensation, healthcare coverage on day one, plus one or more dependents, paid time-off with cash conversion, group life insurance, and performance bonuses.

A Collaborative Spirit: Contribute to a positive and engaging work environment by participating in company-sponsored events and activities.

Work-Life Harmony: Enjoy the balance between work and life that suits you with flexible work arrangements.

Career Growth: Take advantage of opportunities for continuous learning and career advancement.

Inclusive Teamwork: Be part of a company that celebrates diversity and fosters an inclusive culture.

Your Role:

As a Staff Accountant, you will manage day-to-day accounting operations and support financial reporting, analysis, and compliance in collaboration with the fractional CFO and CEO. You will oversee the full monthly accounting cycle, maintain accurate and audit-ready financial records, and develop analytical reports that support financial planning and organizational growth.

This role goes beyond transactional accounting, combining hands-on bookkeeping, reconciliations, financial analysis, and opportunities to use AI tools to improve accounting workflows.

You will:

Day-to-Day Accounting

  • Maintain the general ledger in QuickBooks Online (QBO), including recording and summarizing transactions and generating reports for management and auditors.
  • Handle routine QBO administration, including maintaining the chart of accounts, classes, and user access, while following established account administration protocols.
  • Record donations, grants, and contributions through invoices or sales receipts, ensuring consistent receivables coding and appropriate application of accounting principles.
  • Upload and code vendor invoices in Ramp and review accounts payable coding transferred from Ramp to QBO.
  • Record payroll in QBO through journal entries based on payroll provider reports.
  • Prepare and post journal entries for pledges receivable, grants payable, bank and investment activity, prepaid expense amortization, and accrued expenses using approved schedules and supporting documentation.

Month-End Close and Reconciliation

  • Prepare monthly bank, investment, and Ramp credit card reconciliations.
  • Reconcile asset and liability accounts at month-end and review account analysis and reconciliation details.
  • Investigate aged or unusual items and flag proposed write-offs or matters requiring management decisions.
  • Review journal entries for accuracy, completeness, and consistency, escalating discrepancies when necessary.
  • Maintain a clean, well-documented, and audit-ready general ledger.
  • Identify opportunities to improve month-end close processes by reducing manual steps, strengthening controls, and improving reporting timelines.

Financial Reporting, Budgeting, and Compliance

  • Enter approved budgets into QBO and prepare budget-to-actual reports.
  • Collaborate with the fractional CFO on monthly financial reporting, ad hoc analysis, and preparation of Board meeting materials.
  • Support annual financial statement audits by preparing schedules and gathering requested documentation.
  • Prepare supporting schedules for the external tax firm's annual IRS Form 990 filing.
  • Prepare IRS Forms 1099 and 1096 based on vendor classifications and requirements determined by the organization.
  • Help document and periodically review internal controls supporting Board oversight and external audits.
  • Maintain written accounting policies and procedures.
  • Organize and retain digital records of bank statements, reconciliations, vendor invoices, donor and grant agreements, and other supporting documentation.

Program and Grant Support

  • Support cost allocation across programs and grants to ensure shared expenses are distributed accurately and consistently.
  • Assist with grant tracking and nonprofit-specific financial reporting.
  • Monitor cash positions across accounts and flag potential transfers between operating and reserve accounts for approval. Execution of transfers is outside this role's responsibilities.
  • Send invoices and receipts to external firms in accordance with documented procedures.
  • Coordinate with the Partnerships team when donor- or funder-related matters require relationship-facing communication. Donor and funder correspondence remains the responsibility of the Partnerships team.

Financial Analysis and Process Improvement

  • Build and maintain analytical Excel workbooks covering variance analysis, cash flow, program-level cost tracking, and Board-ready financial summaries.
  • Support financial modeling and data analysis, including multi-year scenarios and growth projections as the organization expands.
  • Assist with impact and outcomes reporting where financial and program data intersect.
  • Use AI tools, including Claude and Claude Code, to explore workflow automation, improve reconciliation processes, draft analyses, and develop small tools or agents that accelerate reporting.
  • Take on additional accounting, analysis, and operational assignments as needed in a small, collaborative finance team.

What You Need:

Non-negotiables

  • Approximately 1–3 or more years of full-cycle bookkeeping or staff accounting experience, including month-end close, account reconciliations, and financial reporting—not solely transactional data entry.
  • Strong proficiency in QuickBooks Online.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup functions, conditional logic, and well-structured workbook design.
  • Solid understanding of core accounting principles, including accruals, reconciliations, journal entries, and month-end close.
  • Ability to prepare and review accounting work, investigate discrepancies, and raise concerns when transactions or balances do not appear correct.
  • Genuine interest in financial analysis and understanding the business or program insights behind the numbers.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • Ability to handle sensitive financial and related organizational information with discretion and confidentiality.
  • Willingness and enthusiasm to work in an AI-forward environment and learn to incorporate AI tools into daily accounting and analysis workflows.

Preferred skills/expertise

  • Experience in nonprofit accounting or fund accounting.
  • Familiarity with U.S. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (U.S. GAAP).
  • Experience with Power BI or similar business intelligence and reporting tools.
  • Previous experience building or using AI agents, automation tools, or AI-assisted workflows in finance and accounting.
  • Experience supporting grant reporting, cost allocations, financial audits, or nonprofit tax documentation.

About MicroSourcing

With over 9,000 professionals across 13 delivery centers, MicroSourcing is the pioneer and largest offshore provider of managed services in the Philippines.

Our commitment to 100% YOU

MicroSourcing firmly believes that our company's strength lies in our people's diversity and talent. We are proud to foster an inclusive culture that embraces individuals of all races, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and backgrounds. We provide space for everyone, embracing different perspectives, and making room for opportunities for each individual to thrive.

At MicroSourcing, equality is not merely a slogan – it's our commitment. Our way of life. Here, we don't just accept your unique authentic self - we celebrate it, valuing every individual's contribution to our collective success and growth. Join us in celebrating YOU and your 100%!

For more information, visit MicroSourcing.

raw.description:
POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES

WHAT DOES A WORK AT HOME CONTACT CENTER REPRESENTATIVE DO?

This position supports customer service, technical support, and customer sales interactions. This role requires you to interact with hundreds of customers each week across the country to resolve support issues, sell new products and services, and ensure best in class customer experience. In addition to being the best in the business when it comes to customer interactions, you will need to be confident, fully engaged, a team player, and dedicated to bringing a positive and enthusiastic outlook to work each day.

Our entry-level Contact Center Representatives are responsible for the following tasks:

  • Listen to customers, understand their needs, and resolve customer issues
  • Utilize systems and technology to complete account management tasks
  • Recognize sales opportunity and apply sales skills to upgrade
  • Explain and position the products and processes with customers
  • Appropriately escalate customer dissatisfaction with managerial team
  • Ensure first call resolution through problems solving and effective call handling

CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS

WONDER IF YOU ARE A GOOD FIT?

MCI provides all new employees with world-class training, so all positive, driven, and confident applicants are encouraged to apply. Ideal candidates for this position are highly motivated, energetic, and dedicated.

Qualifications

  • Must be 18 years of age or older
  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Excellent organizational, written, and oral communication skills
  • The ability to type swiftly and accurately (20+ words a minute)
  • Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook)
  • Basic understanding of Windows operating system
  • Highly reliable with the ability to maintain regular attendance and punctuality
  • The ability to evaluate, troubleshoot, and follow-up on customer issues
  • An aptitude for conflict resolution, problem solving and negotiation
  • Must be customer service oriented (empathetic, responsive, patient, and conscientious)
  • Ability to multi-task, stay focused and self-manage
  • Strong team orientation and customer focus
  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment where change and ambiguity prevalent
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build relationships with your team and customers

COMPENSATION DETAILS

WANT AN EMPLOYER THAT VALUES YOUR CONTRIBUTION?

At MCI, we believe that your hard work deserves recognition and reward. Our compensation and benefits packages are designed to be competitive and to grow with you over time. Starting compensation is based on experience, and we offer a variety of benefits and incentives to support and reward our team members.

What You Can Expect from MCI:

We understand the importance of balance and support, which is why we offer a variety of benefits and incentives that go beyond a paycheck. Our team members enjoy:

  • Paid Time Off: Earn PTO and paid holidays to take the time you need.
  • Health Benefits: Full-time employees are eligible for supplemental health coverage through Blue Cross.
  • Life Insurance: Access life insurance options to safeguard your loved ones.
  • Supplemental Insurance: Accident and critical illness insurance
  • Career Growth: With a focus on internal promotions, employees enjoy significant advancement opportunities.
  • Paid Training: Learn new skills while earning a paycheck.
  • Fun, Engaging Work Environment: Enjoy a team-oriented culture that fosters collaboration and engagement.
  • Casual Dress Code: Be comfortable while you work.

Compensation & Benefits that Fit Your Life

MCI takes pride in tailoring our offerings to fit the needs of our diverse team across subsidiaries and locations. While specific benefits and incentives may vary by geography, the core of our commitment remains the same: rewarding effort, providing growth opportunities, and creating an environment where every employee feels valued.

If you’re ready to join a company that recognizes your contributions and supports your growth, MCI is the place for you. Apply today!

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

This job operates in a professional office environment. While performing the duties of this job, the employee will be largely sedentary and will be required to sit/stand for long periods while using a computer and telephone headset. The employee will be regularly required to operate a computer and other office equipment, including a phone, copier, and printer. The employee may occasionally be required to move about the office to accomplish tasks; reach in any direction; raise or lower objects, move objects from place to place, hold onto objects, and move or exert force up to forty (40) pounds.

CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT

All MCI Locations

  • Must be authorized to work in the country where the job is based.

Subject to the program and location of the position

  • Must be willing to submit up to a LEVEL II background and/or security investigation with a fingerprint. Job offers are contingent on background/security investigation results.
  • Must be willing to submit to drug screening. Job offers are contingent on drug screening results. (Does not apply in Canada)

REASONABLE ACCOMMODATION

Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), it is the policy of MCI and its affiliates to provide reasonable accommodations when requested by a qualified applicant or employee with a disability unless such accommodations would cause undue hardship. The policy regarding requests for reasonable accommodation applies to all aspects of employment. If reasonable accommodations are needed, please contact Human Resources.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

At MCI and its subsidiaries, we embrace differences and believe diversity is a benefit to our employees, our company, our customers, and our community. All aspects of employment at MCI are based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. MCI maintains a work environment free from discrimination, one where employees are treated with dignity and respect. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling MCI's commitment to a diverse and equal opportunity work environment.

MCI does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances. MCI will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements.

MCI will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. We adhere to these principles in all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, promotion, benefits, social and recreational programs, and discipline. In addition, it is the policy of MCI to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where an employee works.

ABOUT US

MCI helps customers take on their CX and DX challenges differently, creating industry-leading solutions that deliver exceptional experiences and drive optimal performance. MCI assists companies with business process outsourcing, staff augmentation, contact center customer services, and IT Services needs by providing general and specialized hosting, software, staff, and services.

In 2019, Marlowe Companies Inc. (MCI) was named by Inc. Magazine as Iowa’s Fastest Growing Company in the State of Iowa and was named the 452nd Fastest Growing Privately Company in the USA, making the coveted top 500 for the first time. MCI’s subsidiaries had previously made Inc. Magazine's List of Fastest-Growing Companies 15 times, respectively. MCI has ten business process outsourcing service delivery facilities in Georgia, Florida, Texas, New Mexico, California, Kansas, Nova Scotia, South Africa, and the Philippines.

Driving modernization through digitalization, MCI ensures clients do more for less. MCI is the holding company for a diverse lineup of tech-enabled business services operating companies. MCI organically grows, acquires, and operates companies that have synergistic products and services portfolios, including but not limited to Automated Contact Center Solutions (ACCS), customer contact management, IT Services (IT Schedule 70), and Temporary and Administrative Professional Staffing (TAPS Schedule 736), Business Process Management (BPM), Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), Claims Processing, Collections, Customer Experience Provider (CXP), Customer Service, Digital Experience Provider (DXP), Account Receivables Management (ARM), Application Software Development, Managed Services, and Technology Services, to mid-market, Federal & enterprise partners. MCI now employs 10,000+ talented individuals with 150+ diverse North American client partners across the following MCI brands: MCI BPO, MCI BPOaaS, MarketForce, GravisApps, Gravis Marketing, MarchEast, Mass Markets, MCI Federal Services (MFS), OnBrand24, The Sydney Call Center, Valor Intelligent Processing (VIP), BYC Aqua, EastWest BPO, TeleTechnology, and Vinculum.

DISCLAIMER

The purpose of the above job description is to provide potential candidates with a general overview of the role. It's not an all-inclusive list of the duties, responsibilities, skills, and qualifications required for the job. You may be asked by your supervisors or managers to perform other duties. You will be evaluated in part based upon your performance of the tasks listed in this job description.

The employer has the right to revise this job description at any time. This job description is not a contract for employment, and either you or the employer may terminate employment at any time, for any reason.

raw.excerpt: MissionThe mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
raw.description:
Mission

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,
leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.

We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.

What You’ll Do:

  • Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.
  • Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.
  • Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.
  • Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have:

  • A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.
  • Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.
  • Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.
  • Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.

What We Offer

  • A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products
  • A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive
  • Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity
  • The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry
  • Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture
  • The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more
  • An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain

The Portugal Based Salary range for this role is: 30,000-65,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.

Think you’re a good fit for this job?

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace.

Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

raw.description:
Job Summary:

Reporting to the Portfolio CFO with five direct reports, the Corporate Controller leads consolidated management reporting, financial integration of acquisitions, intercompany management, and process improvement projects, and acts as the escalation point for technical IFRS queries. The ideal candidate is a qualified accountant with 5+ years' experience (audit plus industry, acquisition accounting, and NetSuite/Blackline preferred).

Job Description:

Areas of Responsibility:

  • Oversee review and compilation of various month end deliverables prepared by the portfolio businesses
  • Assist in the integration of acquired companies’ financial reporting and processes, including system implementation, business combination accounting and opening balance sheet audits
  • Review of journal entries and account reconciliations for the Portfolio and some businesses being integrated, as required
  • Managing all intercompany relationships between the Portfolio and other affiliated entities, including overseeing documentation, entries and reconciliations
  • Working with Finance teams of the businesses and group finance leads on longer-term projects to drive efficiencies or more accurate management reporting
  • Act as an escalation point for technical IFRS accounting queries arising from businesses and groups
  • Monitor timely completion of local external audits as required
  • Track Debt covenant compliance and propose actions where appropriate
  • Assist in systems implementations and best practice sharing where appropriate for NetSuite and supporting modules.
  • Ensure compliance at a local level of control processes, reconciliations and financial reporting through Blackline and our global peer review process.

Profile

  • The right candidate is a qualified accountant, with at least 5 years’ experience, potentially having worked in a large audit firm plus industry experience.
  • Solid audit experience essential
  • Excellent technical accounting skills, including acquisition accounting (we complete multiple acquisitions each year)
  • Preferably brings experience in risk management, systems improvement and managing finance change — for example system implementations, process redesign and post-acquisition integration
  • Comfortable working to tight deadlines and willing to get into the detail
  • Confident Excel skills
  • Portuguese or Spanish skills an advantage

Your personality

  • Enjoy a fast-changing environment, which provides great opportunities for future growth
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, combined with an engaging personality, allowing you to clearly specify what you need and encourage a dispersed team to provide timely and high quality responses
  • Motivated to do great work and to bring out the best in the people around you
  • Motivated to seek new knowledge and enjoys continuous learning and knowledge sharing
  • A natural collaborator who builds trust across teams and helps a dispersed, multi-entity finance community deliver together
  • Willing to go out of your way to help our Portfolio businesses
  • Positive, curious, humble and above all eager to learn and provide value to the finance community in the Portfolio
  • Flexible and adaptable with ability to work flexible hours across time zones where necessary
  • Always open, honest, reliable, and trustworthy

Practical

  • Some travel is required. Plan on 1–2 trips per year of up to a week, worldwide, typically for corporate events and best-practice sharing. As the role is remote, we also ask for roughly quarterly visits to the office — downtown Toronto or Mississauga — to collaborate in person with the team, many of whom are local; you are welcome to come in more often if you prefer.
  • Role will be fully remote

Worker Type:

Regular

Number of Openings Available:

1

title: Head of Solutions Engineering
description: At Offchain, we aren’t just building products: we’re leading a movement.

raw.title: Head of Solutions Engineering
raw.excerpt: At Offchain, we aren’t just building products: we’re leading a movement.
raw.description:
At Offchain, we aren’t just building products: we’re leading a movement.

As pioneers in blockchain scalability and security, we're at the forefront of transforming how the world interacts with decentralized applications. We're laying the foundation that will define the next generation of digital commerce, governance, and human interaction. This involves tackling real-world challenges that come with scaling blockchain technology, without compromising on its core principles: decentralization, security and transparency.

At the center of this vision is our people. Our team is made up of thinkers and doers that embrace new challenges and seek solutions that push existing boundaries. If you’re energized by solving unprecedented problems, and believe in the role that decentralized systems will play in creating a more equitable digital future, then we want to hear from you.

Why Offchain?

Offchain is setting the pace for the entire Ethereum ecosystem. We built the Arbitrum stack that powers Arbitrum One, the most widely adopted Ethereum scaling solution that exists today.

Arbitrum’s ecosystem is undergoing tremendous growth with hundreds of projects and dApps on Arbitrum One today. Over 100 different teams have used Offchain technology to build their own Arbitrum chains. Major players in the space, Robinhood, BlackRock, Ethena Labs, Securitize, Aave, and Apechain are all using the Arbitrum stack.

Arbitrum’s thriving ecosystem wouldn’t exist without our advanced technology stack. Arbitrum, Prysm, ZeroDev. These aren’t just product names. These are tools that are actively reshaping what's possible on Ethereum and advancing its core infrastructure.

To top it all off? We’re backed by $124 million in funding. We’ve demonstrated consistent execution with billions in secured value, thousands of supported projects, and infrastructure processing millions of transactions seamlessly.

The Role

    As part of the Product team at Offchain, you will work with leaders in the blockchain space to solve novel technical, economic, and social challenges. This is a senior player-coach role where you’ll lead client-facing technical strategy while staying hands-on with code, integrations, prototypes, and implementation details. You’ll work directly with leading application teams to improve their experience using Arbitrum technology, accelerate their growth, and help bring ambitious onchain products to market. You’ll also collaborate closely with engineering and third-party teams across the Arbitrum ecosystem, and company leaders including our CTO and Head of Product.

What you'll do:

  • Lead strategic client engagements by partnering directly with customers to develop bespoke solution concepts, guide onboarding and adoption, and build long-term partnerships that drive success on Arbitrum.

  • Proactively identify, contribute to, and advocate for strategic partnerships with promising application teams, fostering an ecosystem of the most engaging on-chain experiences.

  • Work directly with the Product team to relay and incorporate feedback from projects and the developer community into our roadmap, and help shape the go-to-market strategy of new products, especially for the developer audience.

  • Work alongside our engineering and research teams to improve our overall platform, from core protocol customizations to application-layer improvements, based on our work with clients.

  • Own developer success across leading application teams in the Arbitrum ecosystem, working alongside builders to solve challenges involved in using and integrating with Arbitrum technology, and accelerating their development.

What you'll need:

  • Direct experience working with fintech companies or financial institutions to improve, modernize, or transform core infrastructure.

  • 8+ years of experience in technical roles, ideally across solutions engineering, software engineering, infrastructure, architecture, or similar functions.

  • 4+ years of experience leading, managing, and developing high-performing technical teams.

  • Strong experience designing scalable, reliable systems and translating complex technical requirements into practical implementation plans.

  • A strong fundamental understanding of blockchain technology, including how decentralized networks, smart contracts, rollups, and onchain infrastructure operate.

  • Proven experience working directly with clients in professional or commercial settings, with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly, connect them to business objectives, and guide customers through complex implementation decisions.

  • Passion for and understanding of blockchain technologies

  • Strong collaboration skills with both internal and external teams

  • Experience writing Rust, Solidity or Golang.

Perks:

  • Remote-first global workforce + NY office

  • Professional reimbursement program (facilitates industry conference attendance, certifications, and more)

  • Medical, dental & vision coverage (US + some other countries)

  • 401k retirement plan + company match (US only)

  • Wellness stipend

  • Home office set up / ergonomic equipment program

Attention Offchain Job Seekers:

This role cannot be performed in California, or Colorado.

Please be advised that there has been a rise in fraudulent recruiter activities, particularly within the Web3 space. If you would like to confirm whether someone is an Offchain employee or the legitimacy of an offer you received, please email

At Offchain, we are committed to building a welcoming and supportive workplace for all employees, regardless of their background or identity. We strive to create an environment where everyone feels valued and has an equal opportunity to succeed and thrive. We encourage candidates from all walks of life to apply and join our team.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
