Em primeiro lugar, queremos te contar um pouco mais sobre quem somos. Vamos lá?

Muito prazer, nós somos a Aurum! 🖤

Somos uma empresa consolidada no mercado de softwares jurídicos. Utilizamos as tecnologias mais inovadoras para uma nova forma de advogar. Nosso trabalho ajuda milhares de pessoas advogadas a gerenciarem melhor suas tarefas e aumentarem sua produtividade no dia a dia. Legal, né?

Quer saber um segredo? Nós só conseguimos fazer tudo isso porque temos as melhores pessoas aqui. 😎

E como chamamos essa galera? #PessoasÁureas. Hoje somos mais de 200 pessoas espalhadas em todo o Brasil e também contamos com o apoio dos nossos escritórios em Florianópolis (SC) e São Paulo (SP).Não importa onde estamos, a nossa cultura é a mesma, sempre guiada pelos nossos valores.

Aliás, com o apoio de pessoas tão incríveis, valores fortes e uma culturamassa, a gente já conquistou 10 vezes o selo doGreat Place to Work™e em 2025 ficamos bem posicionados em todos os três rankings que participamos.

E sabe o que buscamos nas pessoas que vão se juntar ao nossO Time?

Estamos em busca de profissionais que valorizem autonomia, responsabilidade, trabalho em time, aprendizado constante, colaboração, comunicação, e claro, proximidade e transparência! Se você se identifica com esse tipo de ambiente, já estamos começando a darmatch! 🥰

Consideramos única e especial cada pessoa do nosso time, por isso todas são bem vindas, temos um ambiente seguro para os áureos e áureas se expressarem do jeito que são.

📌Dentro do time Produto&Tecnologia Astrea sua missão será:Ser a referência técnica da equipe, garantindo a qualidade e a evolução contínua dos projetos, ao mesmo tempo em que lidera e orienta os desenvolvedores de menor senioridade, promovendo as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento, sendo guardião dos padrões e processos e gerenciando o backlog de débitos técnicos.

👉Ah, uma informação importante sobre essa vaga:o modelo de trabalho é 100%Remoto!

Agora dá uma olhada nas principais responsabilidades da vaga:

1. Gestão da Entrega e Fluxo

  • Apoiar a pessoa de produto na fase de solução e viabilidade técnica das funcionalidades/bugs/tarefas refinando de forma granular para repasse ao time.
  • Gestão de Impedimentos: ter proatividade e iniciativa ao perceber impedimento ou travas no time (dúvida de negócio ou bloqueio técnico).
  • Acompanhar o progresso das pessoas do time tecnicamente para direcionar e agir preventivamente se identificado risco de atraso.

2. Liderança Técnica e Arquitetura

  • Definição de Solução em parceria com outros Seniores, bater o martelo na arquitetura a ser implementada.
  • Guardião dos Padrões, garantindo que o time esteja seguindo os direcionamentos de código, testes e documentação definidos pela empresa.
  • Code Review, atuando como última barreira de qualidade em PRs críticos ou arquiteturais.
  • Cultura de Documentação, criar e manter atualizada a documentação técnica (ADRs - Architecture Decision Records, RFCs, Diagramas de Arquitetura, API Docs/Swagger).
  • Descentralização de conhecimento, implementar e orientar processos de "troubleshooting" (Runbooks) para que qualquer membro do time consiga resolver incidentes conhecidos.
  • Documentação de legado, mapeando e documentando fluxos críticos de sistemas legados à medida que interage com eles.
  • Mentorar e desenvolver tecnicamente os Devs Plenos e Juniores (Pair Programming, Tech Talks).

3. Interface com Produto e Negócio

  • Viabilidade Técnica: analisar as demandas em conjunto com as pessoas do produto, avaliando viabilidade, propondo alternativas (MVPs) e negociando prazos com a coordenação.
  • Negociação de Débito, ser o guardião da saúde do produto em parceria com o time de performance, expondo os débitos técnicos necessários a serem trabalhados.

Para participar desta seleção, nossa expectativa é de que você tenha:

  • Domínio de Ecossistemas Modernos: Proficiência avançada em React ou AngularJs para Front End. Desejável conhecimentos em Java, Kotlin, Gradle, Jersey, Datastore, Cloud SQL para Backend e Arquitetura, compreendendo profundamente o ciclo de vida, hooks e gerenciamento de estado complexo (Redux,Query).
  • Fundamentos Sólidos: Expertise em TypeScript, ES6+, CSS-in-JS (Styled Components, Tailwind) e semântica HTML.
  • Performance e Otimização: Conhecimento em estratégias de cache, enfileiramento de eventos, processamento de dados de forma massiva.

  • Comunicação Assertiva: Habilidade de comunicação clara e eficaz para alinhar expectativas e negociar prazos com diferentes áreas (técnicas e de negócio);
  • Visão de Produto: Tradução de requisitos de negócio para requisitos técnicos, não só executar, mas entender qual o problema que será resolvido e o objetivo;
  • Organização: Forte capacidade de organização, planejamento e gestão de tarefas e projetos.
  • Resolução de conflitos: temos incidentes frequentes e coordenações em processo de desenvolvimento, é necessário saber mediar esses cenários;
  • Pensamento Sistêmico: capacidade de entender como os serviços se integram para evitar gargalos arquiteturais;
  • Iniciativa e Proatividade: processos em fase de criação, é necessária a contribuição dessa pessoa para identificação de débitos técnicos, melhorias, sugestões.

É um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Conhecimentos backend: Java, Kotlin, Gradle, Jersey, Datastore, Cloud SQL para Backend e Arquitetura, compreendendo profundamente o ciclo de vida, hooks e gerenciamento de estado complexo (Redux,Query).
  • Arquitetura de Software: Capacidade de desenhar micro-frontends, sistemas de design (Design Systems) e decidir entre estratégias de renderização (SSR, SSG, CSR).

  • Testes e Qualidade: Implementação de pirâmide de testes (Unitários, Integração e E2E com Cypress ou Playwright).

  • Ferramental e CI/CD: Configuração de bundles (Webpack, Vite), pipelines de automação e conhecimento básico de Cloud (AWS, GCP ou Firebase).

Informações adicionais

E dá uma olhada no que oferecemos às pessoas áureas:

  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição:R$ 1.300 mensais no cartão flexível, sem desconto em folha.
  • Auxílio Home Office:R$ 135,00 mensais, sem desconto em folha.

  • Auxílio Creche:Para filhos(as) até 5 anos de idade.

Pronunciation: a:rine [uh-reen]. Noun: Arine is a name of Basque origin meaning "light." Arine illuminates the possibilities with medication management to deliver comprehensive economic and health outcomes.

Based in San Francisco, Arine is a rapidly growing healthcare technology and clinical services company with a mission to ensure individuals receive the safest and most effective treatments for their unique and evolving healthcare needs.

Frequently, medications cause more harm than good. Incorrect drugs and doses costs the US healthcare system over $528 billion in waste, avoidable harm, and hospitalizations each year. Arine is redefining what excellent healthcare looks like by solving these issues through our software platform (SaaS). We combine cutting edge data science, machine learning, AI, and deep clinical expertise to introduce a patient-centric view to medication management, and develop and deliver personalized care plans on a massive scale for patients and their care teams.

Arine is committed to improving the lives and health of complex patients that have an outsized impact on healthcare costs and have traditionally been difficult to identify and address. These patients face numerous challenges including complicated prescribing issues across multiple medications and providers, medication challenges with many chronic diseases, and patient issues with access to care. Backed by leading healthcare investors and collaborating with top healthcare organizations and providers, we deliver recommendations and facilitate clinical interventions that lead to significant, measurable health improvements for patients and cost savings for customers.

Why is Arine a Great Place to Work?:

Outstanding Team and Culture - Our shared mission unites and motivates us to do our best work. We have a relentless passion and commitment to the innovation required to be the market leader in medication intelligence.

Making a Proven Difference in Healthcare - We are saving patient lives, and enabling individuals to experience improved health outcomes, including significant reductions in hospitalizations and cost of care.

Market Opportunity - Arine is backed by leading healthcare investors and was founded to tackle one of the largest healthcare problems today. Non-optimized medications therapies which cost the US 275,000 lives and $528 billion annually.

Momentum That Matters - In just over eight years, Arine has grown into one of the fastest-growing healthcare AI companies, serving more than 45 million members through partnerships with leading health plans nationwide. Recognized on the Inc. 5000 list for two consecutive years, we're combining rapid growth with meaningful impact on the quality, cost, and outcomes of care.

The Role:

Arine is seeking a Senior Product Manager to join our dynamic team of software and clinical professionals. In this role, you will report into the product team and own the clinical infrastructure behind every Arine program.

What You’ll be Doing:

  • Evolving our core clinical recommendation engine into a scalable service with clear interfaces and guardrails, making recommendations usable across the platform and by external partners
  • Expanding the clinical data inputs that power personalized recommendations for patients and providers
  • Building a repeatable framework for launching new clinical programs, from defining target populations and goals through piloting and scaling

raw.description:
WSP jest wiodącą na świecie firmą inżynieryjną, specjalizującą się w infrastrukturze, transporcie, ochronie środowiska, energii i budynkach.

Mamy jasną wizję tego, w jaki sposób chcemy pomóc uczynić świat lepszym miejscem, wspierając społeczności i to, co jest naprawdę ważne dla naszej przyszłości.

Wyobraź sobie lepszą przyszłość dla nas wszystkich - i lepszą przyszłość dla Ciebie.

Do naszego zespołu Infrastruktury poszukujemy Projektanta Hydrotechnicznego (Branża Mechaniczna)

Będziesz realizować projekty hydrotechniczne dla rynku szwedzkiego, współpracując z multidyscyplinarnymi zespołami WSP. W tej roli będziesz uczestniczyć w projektowaniu stalowych elementów i urządzeń mechanicznych obiektów hydrotechnicznych, takich jak wrota, zamknięcia czy inne konstrukcje związane z gospodarką wodną. W zależności od doświadczenia obejmiesz rolę Inżyniera lub Starszego Inżyniera, wspierając realizację projektów na różnych etapach ich rozwoju.

Możliwość pracy zdalnej lub hybrydowej w naszym biurze w Warszawie lub Krakowie.

Twoje zadania

  • Projektowanie stalowych elementów oraz urządzeń mechanicznych dla obiektów hydrotechnicznych.

  • Opracowywanie dokumentacji projektowej i technicznej.

  • Wykonywanie analiz technicznych oraz dobór rozwiązań konstrukcyjnych i mechanicznych.

  • Współpraca z zespołami projektowymi w Polsce i Szwecji.

  • Koordynacja rozwiązań z projektantami innych branż.

  • Udział w realizacji projektów zgodnie z wymaganiami klienta, normami oraz harmonogramem prac.

O zespole

Dołączysz do zespołu infrastrukturalnego WSP, który realizuje projekty mostowe i transportowe dla klientów w Polsce i za granicą. Współpracujemy na co dzień z zespołami WSP w Szwecji i Finlandii, wykorzystując nowoczesne narzędzia projektowe oraz środowisko BIM.

Projektujemy nowe obiekty mostowe, modernizacje istniejącej infrastruktury oraz opracowujemy rozwiązania wspierające optymalizację kosztową inwestycji. W swojej pracy korzystamy m.in. z programów SOFiSTiK, Robot Structural Analysis, BRIGADE, Mathcad, Tekla i Revit.

Wybrane projekty

  • Östlänken (Szwecja) - jedna z największych inwestycji kolejowych realizowanych w Szwecji.

  • Klara City View (Sztokholm, Szwecja) - projekt wielobranżowy realizowany w centrum Sztokholmu.

  • Most Kirjalansalmi (Finlandia) - jeden z najbardziej rozpoznawalnych projektów mostowych realizowanych przez WSP w Finlandii.

Kogo szukamy?

Niezbędne kwalifikacje

  • Wykształcenie wyższe techniczne (mechanika i budowa maszyn, inżynieria mechaniczna, budownictwo lub kierunki pokrewne).

  • Doświadczenie w projektowaniu konstrukcji stalowych, elementów mechanicznych lub urządzeń dla infrastruktury technicznej.

  • Umiejętność opracowywania dokumentacji projektowej i technicznej.

  • Znajomość języka angielskiego.

  • Umiejętność pracy w międzynarodowym środowisku projektowym.

  • Dobra znajomość narzędzi projektowych CAD.

Mile widziane

  • Doświadczenie przy projektach hydrotechnicznych.

  • Znajomość wrót, zamknięć, śluz lub innych urządzeń hydrotechnicznych.

  • Uprawnienia projektowe.

  • Doświadczenie w pracy na projektach międzynarodowych.

  • Znajomość modelowania 3D i środowiska BIM.

Co oferujemy?

  • Rozwój w międzynarodowym biurze projektowym

  • Możliwość realizacji prestiżowych projektów

  • Opiekę medyczną

  • Dofinansowanie do karty Multisport

  • Dostęp do platformy wellbeing (w tym 5 bezpłatnych konsultacji z psychologiem, prawnikiem i/lub doradcą finansowym rocznie)

  • Dofinansowanie lekcji językowych, kursów i szkoleń

Nasz proces rekrutacji:

  • Analiza CV.

  • Krótka rozmowa telefoniczna z rekruterem.

  • Spotkanie online lub w biurze z kierownikiem zespołu.

  • Możliwe dodatkowe spotkanie techniczne.

Prosimy o CV w języku angielskim!

Pracuj z WSP.

Z nami możesz.

#WeAreWSP

raw.description:
Fuse is an AI-first energy company on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system.

We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber.

We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers, we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers.

We're hiring a Senior/Lead Backend Engineer to build the core digital infrastructure for a next-generation energy company. You'll work closely with product across the full back-end and engineer backend systems that are second to none.

Responsibilities

  • Own systems end-to-end, from design and architecture through to production, with a high degree of autonomy as an individual contributor. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Working on one of the core data challenges in energy: settlement data can arrive months after delivery, requiring systems that support continuous recalculation as new data becomes available.
  • Developing our real-time billing engine, including per-customer ordering and idempotency, audit trails, and pricing based on half-hourly meter data.
  • Building and extending our trading and hedging systems, covering forward markets, portfolio optimisation, and reconciliation against exchanges we trade on directly.
  • ...and more.

Requirements

  • Demonstrable excellence as a software engineer
  • 3+ years of software engineering experience, with requirements varying by role level, from individual contributor to lead.
  • Proven ability to define and build complex systems
  • Hands-on experience shipping highly available production systems
  • Clear communication
  • Bonus: infrastructure as code (e.g. AWS CDK); experience in the energy sector; experience shipping consumer-facing products

Benefits

  • Fully expensed tech to match your needs

Location: United States

Remote | Part-Time

Compensation: Competitive Compensation

Our client, a high-growth data and trend intelligence platform supporting top global consumer brands in beauty, wellness, and food & beverage, is seeking a talented Product Designer (Part-time, Contract) to shape the UX/UI of its core analytics dashboard and AI-powered product suite.

As the platform evolves around cutting-edge LLM features—including AI assistants, automated report builders, and inline data summaries—this role will focus on turning complex, dense trend data into clear, actionable, and intuitive digital experiences for brand innovation, product marketing, and agency teams.

This is a fully remote, part-time contract opportunity (~20 hours per week). Candidates must be located in US Central Time (UTC−6) or US Eastern Time (UTC−5) and available during core collaboration hours (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM Eastern Time).

Key Responsibilities

  • Product & Experience Ownership: Partner closely with the Frontend Lead and cross-functional team members from initial discovery to launch, determining product direction, feature specifications, and UX/UI deliverables (written proposals, user flows, wireframes, and full Figma specs).
  • Problem Discovery & Solutions: Proactively identify user pain points through usage data, customer feedback, and research calls. Frame fuzzy problems into clear proposals and strategic design solutions without requiring micro-management.
  • AI Feature & UX Design: Design seamless user experiences for generative AI capabilities (chat interfaces, automated reports, and inline summaries). Define visual and structural treatments for AI confidence levels, data attribution, loading states, error handling, and insight tone.
  • Design System Stewardship: Own and elevate the Figma design system principles, collaborating with frontend engineering to align design assets with React component libraries for a unified single source of truth.
  • AI Quality Evaluation: Assist in setting benchmarks for high-quality AI outputs and reviewing user feedback loops to continually improve LLM-driven features over time.

Requirements

    • Experience: 2+ years of hands-on product design experience with proven work shipped in production environments.
    • Strategic Mindset: Strong product intuition with a focus on defining what to build and why, beyond visual design.
    • Portfolio: A portfolio demonstrating strong problem-framing capabilities, including at least one case study starting from an unstructured or ambiguous problem.
    • Domain Interest/Experience: Background in or enthusiasm for data-dense software, such as analytics platforms, dashboards, or reporting tools.
    • Design Systems: Familiarity with contributing to and scaling component libraries and design systems in Figma.
    • AI & Modern Workflow: Strong interest or hands-on experience with AI/LLM products and fluency in integrating AI tools into daily design workflows.
    • Contractor & Remote Discipline: Proven ability to self-manage time, deliverables, and asynchronous communication in a remote, fast-paced environment.
    • Technical/Surface Exclusions: Note that this role strictly focuses on product UX/UI in Figma and does not require writing production code, marketing/brand design, or API/infrastructure design.
  • Nice to Have
    • Previous experience as a founding or solo product designer.
    • Experience designing AI/LLM features or evaluating generative output quality.
    • Expertise in data visualization techniques.
    • Exposure to consumer packaged goods (CPG), beauty, or market research industries.

Benefits

raw.description:
Alignment Health is breaking the mold in conventional health care, committed to serving seniors and those who need it most: the chronically ill and frail. It takes an entire team of passionate and caring people, united in our mission to put the senior first.We have built a team of talented and experienced people who are passionate about transforming the lives of the seniors we serve. In this fast-growing company, you will find ample room for growth and innovation alongside the Alignment Health community. Working at Alignment Health provides an opportunity to do work that really matters, not only changing lives but saving them. Together.

Alignment Health is seeking a Clinical Pharmacist I to join the pharmacy Team. A Clinical Pharmacist I is a remote, full-production managed care pharmacy role supporting Medicare Part D members. The position primarily supports Part D prior authorization and coverage determination / appeal reviews, along with Medication Therapy Management (MTM) activities. The pharmacist applies clinical judgement, plan benefits, and CMS requirements to deliver timely, compliant coverage decisions and medication reviews.

As a Clinical Pharmacist I, you will review coverage determinations and appeals to ensure clinical appropriateness and compliance with CMS regulations and plan benefits for Alignment Health Plan (AHP) members. This role serves as a subject matter expert in Part D coverage determinations, redeterminations, and Part C organizational determinations. In addition, the Clinical Pharmacist I conducts Medication Therapy Management (MTM) activities, including comprehensive medication reviews (CMRs) and targeted interventions, with a focus on high-risk members to improve adherence, reduce high-risk medication utilization, and enhance overall quality of care for AHP members. The Clinical Pharmacist I supports additional managed care functions and projects as assigned.

What You Should Know

- Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time
- Weekend Rotation: Rotational weekend coverage is required, currently approximately every 4–5 weeks, based on business needs and case volume
- Location: Fully remote
- Licensure: Active, unrestricted pharmacist license in at least one U.S. state required
- Required Experience: Minimum one year of health plan, PBM, or managed-care pharmacy experience
- Highly Preferred: Medicare Part D prior authorization, coverage determination, appeals/redetermination, or pharmacy utilization management experience
- Additional Relevant Experience: Medication Therapy Management, CMR/TMR, formulary exceptions, B vs. D determinations, quantity limits, step therapy, and other Medicare Part D pharmacy operations

Job Responsibilities:

  • Drive Accurate and Timely Part D Coverage Decisions: Review and render Part D coverage determination and appeal requests, applying clinical judgment against plan benefits and CMS requirements to render compliant decisions. Collaborate with medical directors by providing appropriate clinical information needed to perform clinical reviews per the guidelines.
  • Deliver Medication Therapy Management Services: Conduct comprehensive medication reviews via telephone for members enrolled in the MTM program, identifying drug therapy problems, optimizing regimens for complex patients, and developing actionable medication action plans. Perform the Care for Older Adults Medication Review (COA-MDR) to support Stars quality measure performance and proactively improve outcomes for the plan's senior population.
  • Advance Pharmacy Quality and Compliance Initiatives: Participate in pharmacy quality improvement projects aligned with Medicare Star Ratings, HEDIS measures, and internal clinical standards. Support the identification of gaps in care and contribute clinical expertise to initiatives that improve member safety metrics, adherence rates, and overall plan performance.
  • Ensure Regulatory and Documentation Integrity: Maintain appropriate records of all clinical reviews, coverage determinations, and consultations in accordance with CMS timelines and organizational standards. Adhere to all regulatory frameworks governing Medicare Part D, including CMS guidelines on coverage determinations, appeals, and grievances (CDAG).
  • Other duties and projects not listed above

Job Requirements:

Experience:

  • Required: Minimum of 1 year of experience working at a health plan, Pharmacy Benefit Manager (PBM), or in a managed care pharmacy setting.
  • Preferred: Demonstrated experience applying clinical decision-making in a regulated, compliance-driven healthcare environment (enterprise-scale preferred). Exposure to Medicare Part D operations, formulary management, or utilization management strongly expected.

Education:

  • Required: Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy or a related health science field
  • Preferred: Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD), Master's degree, or PhD in Pharmacy. Equivalent combination of relevant education and demonstrated clinical experience will be considered

Licensure:

  • Required: Active and unrestricted pharmacist license in at least one U.S. state required.

Skills & Competencies:

  • Part D Regulatory & Formulary Knowledge (Intermediate): In-depth understanding of CMS Medicare Part D coverage determination and appeal processes, CDAG timelines, and formulary exception criteria.
  • Medication Therapy Management (Intermediate): Proficiency in conducting CMR and TMR reviews; familiarity with MTM platforms and documentation requirements.
  • Clinical Decision-Making & Evidence Application (Intermediate): Ability to evaluate clinical literature, formulary criteria, and prescribing guidelines to make compliant, defensible coverage decisions.
  • Pharmacy Benefit Management Systems (Intermediate): Experience navigating PBM adjudication platforms, pharmacy management software, and claims-related systems.
  • Healthcare Regulatory Compliance (Intermediate): Working knowledge of CMS regulations, HIPAA, and Medicare Advantage plan compliance requirements.
  • Medical Documentation & Reporting (Intermediate): Ability to comprehend, interpret, and produce pharmacy-related reports, clinical correspondence, and coverage decision letters.
  • Data Interpretation & Basic Analytics (Basic): Competence with mathematical calculations, statistical interpretation, and using data to support quality and operational decision-making.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience specifically in CDAG (coverage determinations, appeals, and grievances) within a Medicare Advantage health plan environment.
  • Previous Medication Therapy Management experience, including CMR delivery and documentation in an MTM platform
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) — an asset in serving diverse Medicare Advantage member populations.

Other:

  • Standard work schedule: Monday through Friday, 8 AM – 5 PM PST, with availability for rotational weekend shifts as needed.

Essential Physical Functions:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

1. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee regularly is required to stand, walk, sit, use hand to finger, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls; and reach with hands and arms.

2. The employee frequently lifts and/or moves up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.

Pay Range: $113,332.00 - $169,999.00

Pay range may be based on a number of factors including market location, education, responsibilities, experience, etc.

raw.description:
Who we are:

Tinuiti is the largest independent full-funnel marketing agency in the U.S. across the media that matters most, with $4 billion in digital media under management and more than 1,200 employees. Built for marketers who demand growth and accountability, Tinuiti unites media and measurement under one roof to eliminate waste—the biggest growth killer of all—and scale what works. Its proprietary technology, Bliss Point by Tinuiti, reveals the truth around growth and waste, and how to capitalize on it. With expert teams across Commerce, Search, Social, TV & Audio, and more, Tinuiti delivers measurable results with brutal simplicity: Love Growth. Hate Waste.


We support 100% remote work for this role!


We’d love to hear from you if:

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you qualify, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

As an Insights Lead Analyst, Commerce, you will be Tinuiti’s hands-on analytics specialist for Amazon and Commerce data. You will use Amazon Marketing Cloud, Amazon Advertising, Amazon retail data, and related Commerce platforms to develop advanced analyses, custom reporting, testing approaches, and actionable insights that help Client Leads and Commerce teams make stronger decisions.

Amazon is the core platform for this role. You will build deep expertise across Amazon Marketing Cloud, Amazon Advertising, and Amazon retail data, while applying your analytical skills to other retail-media platforms—including Walmart Connect and Scintilla—as client and business needs require.

You will work closely with Client Leads, Commerce Media, Commerce Operations, and other internal delivery teams through high-quality analysis, client-ready narratives, and specialized platform expertise. You will participate in client discussions when technical or analytical depth is needed.


Key responsibilities

Client‑Centric

  • Partner with Client Leads and Commerce Leads to understand client objectives, performance questions, strategic moments, and analytical priorities.
  • Support Client and Commerce Leads with accurate data narratives, technical explanations, reporting, and client-ready recommendations.
  • Partner with Commerce Media and Commerce Operations teams to ensure insights inform planning, optimization, investment, and retail decisions.
  • Join client discussions, business reviews, and technical readouts when specialized Commerce expertise is needed.
  • Identify recurring analytical needs, risks, and growth opportunities that should be addressed through stronger analysis, testing, reporting, or measurement.

Product‑Led

  • Use Amazon Marketing Cloud, Amazon Advertising, Vendor Central, BI tools, dashboards, and relevant Commerce data environments to support insight generation and decision-making.
  • Build AMC queries and analyses across audiences, campaign performance, new-to-brand outcomes, path-to-purchase behavior, and other custom client questions.
  • Maintain working expertise in Amazon platform capabilities, retail data, and relevant Commerce environments such as Walmart Connect and Scintilla.
  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting, dashboarding, documentation, automation, and Commerce insight-delivery workflows.
  • Use approved AI and automation tools thoughtfully to improve data interrogation, pattern detection, and efficiency while validating outputs rigorously.

Data & Measurement‑Driven

  • Query, validate, join, and interpret Amazon advertising and retail data across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, Amazon DSP, and other relevant Commerce data sources.
  • Develop advanced and custom reporting, dashboards, visualizations, and performance narratives across key Commerce outcomes, including new-to-brand, share of voice, market share, total sales, and ASIN/SKU performance.
  • Translate Commerce data into clear findings and recommendations: what happened, why it matters, and what should happen next.
  • Design and analyze platform-specific tests, forecasts, scenarios, segmentation, and campaign evaluations that inform media, audience, product, and retail decisions.
  • Build practical, account-specific analytical solutions—including lightweight models, scripts, and prototypes in SQL, Python, R, or approved tools—when they answer a defined Commerce business question.
  • Maintain strong documentation and quality assurance across data sources, logic, methodologies, reporting, and analysis.

The Tinuiti Way

  • Maintain a holistic understanding of how Commerce media, marketplace dynamics, retail data, product performance, and client business goals fit together.
  • Keep analytical work focused on business questions, measurement judgment, and decision support—not reporting or technical complexity for its own sake.
  • Partner with Econometrics, Data Science, Client Reporting, and technical teams when work requires formal model development, enterprise-scale reporting, productionization, or data-infrastructure changes.
  • Contribute reusable Commerce query logic, reporting approaches, analytical learnings, and platform best practices that strengthen the broader Insights and Commerce practices.
  • Stay current on Amazon platform changes, Commerce measurement practices, analytics tools, AI, and retail-media trends.

Owner Mindset

  • Take accountability for the quality, accuracy, timeliness, and usefulness of Commerce analyses, reporting, dashboards, and recommendations.
  • Prioritize effectively across Client Leads, Commerce teams, clients, and analytical workstreams.
  • Ask better questions, challenge assumptions, and turn broad requests into practical analytical approaches.
  • Surface data-quality issues, methodology limitations, missing inputs, and performance risks early, with a clear recommendation for next steps.
  • Improve workflows, documentation, automation, and analytical rigor over time.

Professional & Technical Qualifications

  • 5–7 years of experience in Commerce analytics, retail media, e-commerce analytics, marketing analytics, business intelligence, or a related field.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Amazon Marketing Cloud, including SQL querying, audience analysis, campaign analysis, and custom analytical approaches.
  • Strong experience with Amazon Advertising and Amazon retail data, including Sponsored Ads, Amazon DSP, Vendor Central, and related Commerce performance metrics.
  • Strong SQL proficiency and experience with BI/visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker Studio, or similar.
  • Strong understanding of Commerce measurement, including new-to-brand, share of voice, market share, product-level performance, total sales, forecasting, testing, and incrementality concepts.
  • Practical Python and/or R experience is preferred, particularly for custom analysis, forecasting, exploratory work, or lightweight modeling.
  • Strong data storytelling, documentation, quality-control, organization, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Experience supporting Client Leads and Commerce account teams; direct client-facing experience is helpful but not the primary requirement.
  • Comfort using AI tools responsibly to improve analytical efficiency and insight generation.

The hiring salary range for this role is $100,000 - $120,000. We also offer an incentive pay program (RevShare) comprising a monthly variable revenue payment opportunity and a discretionary annual performance bonus.

Hiring salaries are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, parity with other team members, and alignment with market data. We will provide more information on our benefits, incentive pay, and equity upon request. Disclosure as required by the Colorado Equal Pay for > Equal Work Act, C.R.S. § 8-5-101 et seq.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.


Benefits:


Unlimited PTO: At Tinuiti, we believe you deserve time to rest, recharge, and enjoy life unplugged. When you prioritize time for yourself, you're able to bring your best self to work. That’s why we offer unlimited paid time off, a fully remote environment, and flexibility to take the time you need, when you need it. On top of that, we provide 20 paid holidays, including multiple long weekends, to ensure you have dedicated time to step away and disconnect. We're proud to offer above-industry standard work-life balance, consistently rated as one of the most loved benefits by Tinuitians year after year.

Ready to Make a Real Impact? Join e-STORAGE!

Who We Are

Welcome to e-STORAGE, a proud member of the Canadian Solar Inc. (NASDAQ: CSIQ) family! We’re leading the way in designing, building, and integrating advanced battery energy storage systems for utility-scale projects. Our mission? To accelerate the world’s renewable energy transition and create a more sustainable, resilient energy future for everyone.

With our innovative SolBank lithium-iron phosphate battery technology and comprehensive project services, we’re not just building products we’re powering communities and making a difference worldwide.

Position Title: Sr. Requirements Engineer

Department: Engineering

Entity: e-Storage

Location: US - Texas/ Arizona

Reports To: Technical Requirements Manager, eStorage


Position Summary:


We are looking for a motivated Senior Requirements Engineer to specialize in EMS controls and Power Conversion Systems for utility-scale battery energy storage systems. The candidate will develop technical requirements aligned with business goals and objectives.

As part of the engineering team, the Sr. Requirements Engineer will create control system and power conversion system specifications that meet all project requirements, guide control system technologies, and implement processes for global utility-scale energy storage solutions. Familiarity with power systems, utility scale inverters, utility generation, protection and transmission, modern industrial networks, and utility communication protocols is required.


Responsibilities:


  • Develop Technical Requirements: Create and maintain technical requirements for battery energy storage control systems and Power Conversion Systems (PCS) in line with company goals and industry standards.
  • Cyber security: Develop a set of security requirements and templates.
  • Review Project-Specific Requirements: Carefully review and ensure project-specific requirements for control systems and Power Conversion Systems are met.
  • Negotiate and Develop Requirements Management: Develop comprehensive requirements management strategies tailored to specific client needs and industry requirements.
  • Track Applicable Standards: Monitor applicable standards and analyze their implications on our products, communicating these to the R&D, commercial, and engineering teams.
  • Certification Testing Solutions: Assist in finding solutions to challenges related to certification testing.
  • Examine Test Samples: Read and understand schematics, wiring diagrams, and operational instructions to examine test samples.
  • Conduct Risk Assessments: Identify potential compliance risks and vulnerabilities within our products, developing strategies to mitigate these risks and ensure adherence to relevant laws, regulations, and standards.
  • Regular Reporting: Report regularly to the business team and relevant stakeholders to ensure transparency and accountability.
  • Utilize and maintain AI tools for developing technical requirements.
  • Utilize and maintain version control tools to make sure the requirements are traceable, auditable, and change-managed throughout the lifecycle.

Required Qualifications and Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in the design and implementation of global compliance standards for products such as SCADA and EMS, batteries, electrical systems, HVAC, inverters, or other industrial products.
  • Knowledge of UL & IEC requirements. Knowledge of NERC-CIP cyber security requirements.
  • Experience with regional and global regulatory requirements.
  • Knowledge of battery-related standards such as IEC62619, UL1973, IEC62933-5-1/-2, UL9540, UL9540A, NFPA855, ISO-27019​
  • Proven success in working independently, handling multiple tasks, and determining priorities in a team environment, balanced by an ability to collaborate effectively across multiple disciplines or functional groups.
  • Deep understanding of battery systems.
  • Participation in compliance or standard-related councils is a plus.

Key Competencies:

  • Experience with technical requirements drafting
  • Strong technical and analytical abilities
  • Results-driven, with a focus on execution
  • Excellent communication and negotiation abilities

What It’s Like to Work Here

At e-STORAGE, you’re more than just an employee—you’re part of a team that values your ideas, your background, and your unique perspective. We believe that a culture of equity, diversity, and inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s the secret to our success. Here, you’ll find:

  • Integrity: We do what’s right, always.

  • Innovation: We encourage fresh thinking and bold ideas.

  • Quality: We take pride in delivering excellence, every time.

  • Customer Focus: We listen, we care, and we deliver.

  • Sustainability: We’re passionate about protecting our planet for future generations.

Why You’ll Love Working With Us

  • Join a global leader in renewable energy, backed by over 23 years of Canadian Solar experience.

  • Work on projects that matter—helping to build a cleaner, greener world.

  • Thrive in a supportive, collaborative environment where your growth is our priority.

  • Enjoy a competitive salary and a generous benefits package.

Want to join here is what we are looking For

  • The right mix of education, experience, and skills for the role.

  • Great communication, teamwork, and problem-solving abilities.

  • A true commitment to safety, ethics, and sustainability.

Your Rewards

We offer a competitive salary, performance bonuses, and a comprehensive benefits package—including health coverage, retirement plans, paid time off, and more.

raw.description:
Overview

Certara accelerates the potential of bringing medicines to market and to patients using biosimulation software, technology, and services to transform traditional drug discovery and development. Our clients include more than 2,400 biopharmaceutical companies, academic institutions, and regulatory agencies across 70 countries.

Our goal is to enable the life sciences industry’s use of data, modeling, and analytics to make better decisions across the various phases of discovery and drug development. Our software and scientists incorporate modern advances in scientific understanding, drug development experience, data analysis, and AI resulting in significant opportunities to decrease the cost and increase the probability of success for new drug approval and commercialization.


Responsibilities

Responsibilities

We are seeking a commercially minded attorney to support our U.S. legal contracting function. You will negotiate a broad portfolio of life sciences and technology agreements, advise business teams in practical terms, and help deliver a disciplined, scalable contracting experience through clear templates, playbooks, and escalation standards.

You will have meaningful ownership of matters appropriate to your experience, with senior support for novel, high-risk, or strategically significant issues. Legal owns the contracting framework and legal terms. Commercial Operations continues to populate and execute order forms and task orders within Legal-approved templates.

  • Draft, review, and negotiate master services agreements, commercial and service agreements, SaaS and software license agreements, data privacy agreements and DPAs, vendor and consulting agreements, reseller agreements, development/developer agreements, and amendments, escalating novel or high-risk issues as appropriate.
  • Manage assigned matters from intake through signature, maintaining clear status, required approvals, and organized matter records.
  • Apply Legal playbooks, templates, approval thresholds, and fallback positions consistently; identify recurring issues that should be addressed through updated guidance, templates, or process improvements.
  • Advise business stakeholders in plain language and collaborate closely with Sales, Finance, Privacy, Security, Procurement, and Commercial Operations.
  • Review revisions that introduce legal or complex commercial terms, including revisions to evaluation agreements, and route matters for senior escalation when needed.
  • Support Legal ownership of order form and task order templates, including quality checks and controlled self-service.
  • Respect the operating boundary: Commercial Operations populates and executes order forms and task orders; Legal owns the framework, legal terms, templates, and escalations.
  • Contribute to knowledge management, training, metrics, template maintenance, playbook updates, and alternative legal talent/provider coordination.
  • Balance contract velocity and risk using sound judgment, strong organization, and responsive stakeholder communication.

Qualifications

• Juris Doctor (or equivalent law degree) and active membership in good standing in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.
• Approximately 1–3 years of relevant commercial transactions experience at a law firm, in-house legal department, or comparable environment.
• Strong foundational drafting and negotiation skills, particularly for MSAs, services agreements, SaaS/software licenses, SOW-related frameworks, and privacy/data-processing terms.
• Experience with life sciences, pharmaceutical, biotech, health technology, software, data, or professional-services transactions is strongly preferred.
• Working familiarity with privacy and regulated-data issues; exposure to HIPAA and GDPR is preferred.
• Sound judgment about when to resolve an issue independently and when to escalate.
• Strong organization, attention to detail, responsiveness, and comfort managing multiple matters and deadlines.
• Interest in contract playbooks, template maintenance, knowledge management, and process improvement.

How success will be measured

• Assigned agreements progress promptly, accurately, and in line with Legal playbooks and approval requirements.
• Escalations are timely and well framed, with clear facts, options, and recommended paths.
• Matter status, approvals, key dates, and supporting records remain accurate and complete.
• Templates and repeatable guidance are applied consistently, and recurring issues are surfaced for improvement.
• Business partners receive practical, clear, and responsive support.

Certara bases all employment-related decision on merit, taking into consideration qualifications, skills, achievement, and performance. We treat all applicants and employees without regard to personal characteristics such as race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, nationality, marital status, pregnancy, physical or mental condition, genetic information, military service, or other characteristic protected by law.

XTG Senior Project Engineers will research solutions, coordinate information with partners and vendors, and support technical troubleshooting during in-process installations, owning the outcomes of the final product of our largest and most complex AV Integration projects. This role will support the Simulation (Medical, Racing, Flight) Center of Excellence for XTG (Experience Technology Group) with emphasis on Medical Simulation systems for capture, recording, processing, and distribution of audiovisual content within a business context. WHO WE ARE AVI-SPL is a digital enablement solutions provider who transforms how people and technology connect to elevate experiences, create new value, and enable organizations to thrive and grow. We are the largest provider of collaboration technology solutions, which include our award-winning managed services. Our highly certified industry experts and innovation leaders share a vision to help people work smarter and live better. We believe that success starts with a sound team and that an inclusive and diverse workplace moves us all forward. XTG is a global team that develops, designs, and supports experiential projects in partnership with AVI-SPL regional offices. WHAT YOU’LL DO As part of XTG (Experience Technology Group), Senior Project Engineers provide post-sales support to bring immersive and experiential projects to life in partnership with AVI-SPL offices around the globe. This engineering role will provide additional details about how a design approach will be built and configured to uphold the vision of the XTG pre-sales team and our growing network of creative partners. XTG Senior Project Engineers will research solutions, coordinate information with partners and vendors, and support technical troubleshooting during in-process installations, owning the outcomes of the final product. This particular role will have an additional emphasis on Medical Simulation systems for capture, recording, processing, and distribution of audiovisual content within a business context. Working under the guidance of Senior Analysts and Program Managers, this role supports the financial-analytics functions of the team by maintaining cost trackers, gathering financial data, and assisting with cost/benefit assessments.

Job Title:

Inpatient Medical Coder 4

Department:

Health System Shared Services | MIM CDI and Coding

Coding services assigns diagnosis and procedural codes to inpatient and outpatient medical records to facilitate the reimbursement and data collection for the individual business units of the OSU Health System. ICD-9-CM and ICD-10-CM/PCS diagnoses and procedure codes are applied to inpatients and CPT-4 procedure codes are applied to all outpatients treated within the OSU Health System that are not captured through the charge description master. Medical record abstract data is assigned based on information reviewed for accuracy in IHIS during the coding process. This position is responsible for training medical record coding specialists and coding some or all the following types of records: inpatient, emergency department, ambulatory surgery, Talbot, outpatient clinic, pain block and ancillary areas. The Lead Medical Records Coding Specialist will also participate in hospital’s trauma registry.


Position Summary

The position is responsible for training and supporting new medical record coding specialists. The Lead Coder’s responsibilities also include auditing the coding of records, assuring inpatient and outpatient coding policies and procedures reflect practice, ensuring the integrity of information in the electronic medical record, and monitoring completion of coding activities. This position also codes medical records and other documents at the conclusion of the patient’s visit. This requires selection of appropriate admitting diagnosis, principal and secondary diagnoses, principal procedure and secondary procedures; assigning accurate ICD-9, ICD-10 and/or CPT-4 codes; sequencing the diagnoses and procedures codes; and abstracting information including admission source, type, disposition, admitting, attending and procedure attending physicians. Codes are selected in the Encoder Software following review of information in the electronic medical record system, IHIS. Information abstracted and coded is interfaced to IHIS Resolute

2-Year College Degree in Health Information Management or equivalent combination of education and experience

Accredited as a Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA) or Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT) or Certified Coding Specialist (CCS) by the American Health Information Management Association, or Certified Outpatient Coder (COC) by AAPC or CPC with CHONC. Minimum of two years academic medical coding experience. 4 years of relevant experience required. 6 or more years of relevant experience preferred.

SUB-FUNCTION: Inpatient Medical Coding

raw.description:
About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About The Role

After becoming one of the fastest growing startups in the United States ($0 → $17B), Rippling is ready to up-level our operations to scale to $5B in ARR over the next couple years. We need someone who can take us from 1 to 10—and beyond, on a global scale.

Support Operations manage a global support organization of more than 1,000 employees with a lean team of 10. Our goal isn't just to support the business, but to automate the friction out of it. We are looking for an AI-Native Program Manager to force-multiply our global Support organization through better knowledge management. You will own the internal and external Knowledge roadmap, executing on three core pillars:

  • External Knowledge Scaling & Deflection: Drive the expansion and continuous improvement of our external-facing help center, elevating both the quantity and quality of public articles to maximize customer self-service and boost ticket deflection rates.
  • Internal Knowledge & Agent Efficacy: Overhaul the structure, clarity, and depth of our internal Confluence space to power high-performance agent-assist tools, ensuring customer support teams have immediate access to accurate, actionable insights.
  • AI-First Continuity & Governance: Champion an AI-first approach to data structuring, establishing automated or highly efficient workflows that keep our entire knowledge ecosystem exhaustive, perfectly formatted for LLM consumption, and consistently up to date.

Reporting to the Director of Support Operations, you will be responsible for setting the internal Knowledge roadmap and executing against it to improve Support quality and efficiency.

What You'll Do

  • Architect the Dual-Purpose Knowledge Strategy: Completely overhaul and organize our internal Confluence instance for product, process, and policies. You will establish the frameworks, templates, and structures that make our data instantly readable for humans and optimized for AI chunking/ingestion.
  • Empower Support Leads as an AI Knowledge Consultant: Work side-by-side with Customer Support Leads to map out top-tier deflection opportunities. You will help them translate messy product updates and tribal knowledge into clear, structured, and accurate documentation.
  • Build the Knowledge Expansion Engine: Create and scale "text cleaning" and content generation loops for continuity and governance. You will build workflows that automatically capture insights from resolved tickets, Slack threads, and Jira bugs, converting them into polished internal and external knowledge articles.
  • Optimize AI Deflection & Accuracy: Directly diagnose where our customer-facing AI bots and internal agent-assist tools get confused. You will ruthlessly refine content layouts, semantic keywords, and underlying data structures to eliminate AI hallucinations and boost automated deflection rates.

Qualifications

  • The "Scrappy" Information Architect: You have 5 – 7 years of experience in Knowledge Management, Technical Writing, Support Operations, or Information Architecture at enterprise scale. You think in data hierarchies, taxonomies, and cross-functional structures.
  • AI-First Operator: You approach problems with an AI-first mindset, instinctively looking to automate tasks and streamline manual processes before building traditional workflows. You have a proven track record of using generative AI, LLMs, and automation platforms to eliminate administrative overhead, auto-tag documentation, and orchestrate smart information pipelines.
  • Independent Orchestrator: You are comfortable operating entirely alone as the sole builder of this roadmap. You excel at partnering with busy Support Leads, extraction of complex information, and turning it into organized systems without needing an active development team.
  • Data & System Literate: You know how to measure the direct ROI of knowledge. You can track support ticket trends, query SQL, analyze deflection metrics, and pinpoint exactly where information gaps are impacting customer satisfaction.
  • Technical Requirements:
    • Expert-level knowledge infrastructure experience (Confluence, JIRA, Salesforce Knowledge).
    • Deep familiarity with prompt engineering and the LLM landscape (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini).
    • Expertise in SQL/Snowflake to wrangle data and generate insights
    • (Preferable) Expert in text automation and parsing skills (e.g., Zapier, regex, AI content pipelines).
    • (Preferable) Understanding of text chunking, embedding models, and vector retrieval actually work. You know how formatting choices (like clean Markdown or structural HTML) directly affects an AI's ability to pull the right answer

Lynker Corporation is seeking to hire a qualified candidate to support a contract with NOAA Research Office of Ocean Exploration and Research (OER). These are full-time positions that may be performed on-site or remotely, with anticipated travel in support of meetings, workshops, and field activities. Hiring for these positions will be contingent on contract award. Lynker will be operating under its Propel joint venture, a NOAA ProTech Oceans 2.0 prime contract holder. The contractor shall provide technical and administrative services for the creation, management, and refinement of educational materials and digital content. The contractor shall provide technical and administrative services for the development, implementation, and expansion of education and outreach strategies.

Responsibilities

Duties of the Education/Outreach Product Development, Strategy, and Programmatic Growth Support will include the following:

  • Content Management and Gap Analysis: Establishing, curating, and maintaining a storage management system for all historic and current education content; identifying gaps in current content and priorities for the development of new materials.
  • Education Product Development: Planning, coordinating, and executing the development of education products—including coordinating the technical inputs of external partners—that meet contemporary classroom needs, standards, and instructional methods.
  • Brand Identity and Graphic Design Services: Coordinating the development of a unique brand identity for NOAA Ocean Exploration for education products produced in print and shared online; performing the graphic design of new educational materials and performing technical reviews of the work of external partners.
  • Translation and Evaluation Coordination: Executing education and outreach product translations, including consulting and coordinating with regional language and local dialect experts and performing technical reviews of work completed by external partners; identifying resource evaluation needs and coordinating the workflow of external evaluators in coordination with the COR and/or applicable TPOC(s).
  • Education Strategy and Implementation: Executing education strategy development and implementation to advance the NOAA Ocean Exploration and NOAA Education Strategic Plans; analyzing the education landscape and educator needs; performing evaluation of current education product development, educator training, and ocean exploration education communication approaches; identifying gaps in current education offerings; and formulating novel promotion and outreach approaches to expand the reach and utility of NOAA Ocean Exploration education offerings.
  • Promotion and Communications Strategy: Coordinating the development and execution of a promotion strategy for sharing NOAA Ocean Exploration expedition updates and discoveries, education products, and educator and student opportunities to a national educator audience (and international where relevant) using communications tools such as, but not limited to email, social media, NOAA Ocean Exploration and Deep Ocean Education Project websites, conference presentations, and educator newsletters; providing prompt updates for the NOAA Ocean Exploration website as education products and educator opportunities arise; strategically growing the ocean education audience.
  • Educational Outreach Material Development: Planning, developing, maintaining, and executing lists of educational outreach materials and needed supplies, and related activities to achieve NOAA Ocean Exploration outreach and engagement priorities; initiating and planning projects, including requirements and resourcing needs documents, that lead to innovative, new approaches to communicating information about ocean exploration to education-specific audiences.

Overview

Our Substation Group is at the forefront of the energy transition, tackling real-world challenges as the grid evolves. With the rapid growth of smart home technology, electric vehicles, battery energy storage, and renewable energy sources, we’re facing a new era of power systems—one defined by multi-directional power flows, advanced data acquisition, and dynamic load management. Join us as we help redefine how energy is delivered, managed, and sustained for generations to come.

Due to continued growth, our Power Delivery group is seeking a Substation Engineer –Physical Design in one of the following office locations:

  • Dallas, TX
  • Houston, TX
  • Orlando, FL
  • Tampa, FL
  • Palm Beach Gardens, FL
  • Overland Park, KS
  • Kennesaw, GA
  • Covington, LA (Hybrid)
  • Remote

Responsibilities

Imagine a day where you’re designing the backbone of the power grid—drafting substation layouts, running protection and grounding analyses, and fine-tuning relay settings that keep energy flowing safely. You collaborate with engineers across disciplines, solve real-world challenges, and see your designs come to life in the field. Every detail you contribute will help power entire communities—safely, reliably, and sustainably.

  • Substation Design & Drafting: Develop electric substation drawings, including General Arrangements, Elevations, Conduit Plans/Details, Grounding Plans/Details, Foundation Plans, Lightning Protection plans, and control building layouts. Work closely with the Civil Engineering department to develop substation foundation and structure detail drawings
  • Engineering Analysis & Calculations: Perform substation design calculations and analysis such as ground grid analysis and design, lightning protection, voltage drop, and conduit fill
  • Technical Documentation & Specifications: Develop technical equipment and construction specifications and work scopes
  • Collaboration & Quality Assurance: Work closely with peers to ensure accurate and on-time delivery of electrical design that meets client and industry standards, specifications, and good engineering practices
  • Field Support: Providing on-site technical support for select ENERCON clients during construction and commissioning as required

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering from an ABET-accredited university
  • Minimum of 6 years of experience in Substation engineering, with a primary focus on executing substation physical design projects
  • Familiarity with substation physical design parameters and associated information needed to complete design
  • Experience with MicroStation and AutoCAD
  • Strong familiarity with NESC, IEEE, and other applicable codes and standards
  • Willingness to enter energized electric substations with proper training and PPE
  • Must be self-driven in time management to meet deadlines and provide accuratedeliverables, with the ability to communicate effectively with both internal and external stakeholders
  • Must be proficient with typical office software including Microsoft Windows and Office suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

Preferred Qualifications

  • AutoCAD Electrical design experience

The Presales Solutions Engineer – SecOps/SIEM is a customer-facing security expert who takes a consultative approach to helping customers design and implement effective security operations solutions. This role requires a strong understanding of how SIEM and SecOps technologies support broader business and security goals.

At SHI International, the engineer serves as a subject matter expert in SIEM platform engineering, including log source onboarding, detection and correlation rule development, content management, performance tuning, and integration with the broader security operations ecosystem such as SOAR, EDR/XDR, threat intelligence, and ticketing platforms. Skill Level Requirements

  • Experience working in identity management and security solutions.

  • Deep technical identity governance and security knowledge, including but not limited to Security Operations, SIEM, SOAR, TIP, Dark Web scanning, CLM/PKI, and BAS controls.

  • Excellent presentation skills, including the ability to run demos on security operations products

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication.

  • Exceptional relationship-building acumen with a passion for technology

Other Requirements

  • Completed Bachelor’s Degree or relevant work experience required

  • 3-5 years of experience in a similar role

  • 5+ years experience in a technical cybersecurity role

  • 3+ years experience in Security Pre-Sales Consulting

  • Ability to travel to SHI, Partner, and Customer Events

FirstChoice is currently seeking a Regional Business Development Director to join our growing team. The Regional Business Development Director will focus on developing new business for FirstChoice. The Business Development Director is responsible for recruiting, prospecting, relationship development, and will be the opportunity creator for the region. This individual will be naturally curious learning about agency owners and their businesses, comfortable initiating new relationships, disciplined about follow-up, and persistent in developing opportunities over time. They are responsible for developing and executing the new member growth strategy of the assigned territory/Region. Business Development Director serves as the region’s primary new-business development leader, with accountability for expanding FirstChoice’s membership by recruiting quality independent agencies, growing regional membership, assisting with developing carrier and strategic partnerships, and aggregating premium.

This is a remote-based position. The ideal candidate will live in either OH, MI, IN, IL, WI, MN, KY, TN, or WV.

Success in this role requires a highly proactive, relationship-driven approach to business development with the ability to identify and develop opportunities while building trusted relationships. The Business Development Director will develop and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective members in Salesforce through direct prospecting, email campaigns, referrals, carrier and strategic partner relationships, industry events, conferences, and other market-development activities. The Business Development Director is expected to create opportunities and be the first point of contact for all FirstChoice Web lead inquiries in the Region. They will continually expand FirstChoice’s network by initiating conversations with agency owners and other key industry stakeholders.

This individual will work in close partnership with the Regional Vice President and Regional Relationship Directors to ensure the region has a coordinated team selling strategy for approval and onboarding of all new members. The Business Development Director will introduce and actively transition the relationship to the appropriate Regional Relationship Director throughout the relationship building process.

Responsibilities:

  • Leverages strategic partnerships to expand market reach and generate qualified prospective member referrals.

  • Collaborates with the Regional Vice President and Regional Relationship Director to initiate new prospective members.
  • Utilizes Salesforce to plan, log, and execute sales strategies.
  • Participates in team-selling environment with colleagues.

  • Supports MarshBerry and individual branding with an active LinkedIn presence & contributing to MarshBerry and industry presentations.
  • Other special projects, tasks or duties as assigned by Management.

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Management, Risk Management, Finance, Marketing, Sales or another related field. MBA or master’s preferred.
  • Insurance designations or licenses are a plus such as P&C license, CIC, CPCU.

raw.excerpt: About Fable Global enterprises work with Fable to make products more accessible for over one billion people who live with disabilities.
raw.description:
About Fable

Global enterprises work with Fable to make products more accessible for over one billion people who live with disabilities. Our customers include global leaders like Walmart, Slack, and Shopify. Fable was featured on the Forbes Accessibility 100 list in 2025, awarded Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies in Design, and has received accolades from global entities like the World Summit Awards and the UN-endorsed Zero Project.

About the role

Fable is seeking a Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager to own customer retention and drive sustained product usage across a portfolio of enterprise accounts. Working with leading global brands, you will help customers achieve meaningful business outcomes and make Fable an integral part of how they design, build, and improve their products.

A critical part of this role is building trusted relationships with senior leaders across accessibility, design, product, UX, engineering, and research. You will proactively engage these leaders, understand their priorities, and connect Fable’s value to their strategic goals. By cultivating executive sponsorship and relationships beyond a single champion, you will strengthen customer commitment, broaden adoption across teams, and secure support for continued investment in inclusive research.

You will own the customer journey from onboarding and adoption through renewal, with direct accountability for retention and long-term customer value. This means actively growing platform usage, helping customers establish consistent accessibility research practices, and ensuring they can demonstrate the impact of their investment. You will use product usage data and customer insights to identify churn risks early, address barriers to adoption, and lead action plans that improve engagement and protect renewals.

Success in this role is measured by customer retention, renewal performance, and the depth and consistency of product usage across your portfolio. You will also identify expansion opportunities grounded in demonstrated value, strong stakeholder relationships, and customer needs.

This role directly advances Fable’s mission to empower people with disabilities to participate, contribute, and shape society by helping customers embed inclusive practices throughout product development.

We welcome applicants based in the Greater Toronto areas who can work within North American time zones.

Responsibilities

Product adoption & usage

    • Own adoption and sustained product usage across your portfolio, helping customers embed Fable into their product development and research workflows.
    • Build and execute shared success plans with measurable usage goals, business outcomes, milestones, and clear ownership. Provide strategic guidance and enablement that turn these plans into consistent accessibility research practices.
    • Proactively analyze usage and engagement to identify adoption barriers and churn risks. Lead targeted action plans to reengage customers, deepen feature adoption, and broaden usage across teams.

Retention & commercial management

    • Own customer retention and the renewal process from planning through signature, with accountability for gross revenue retention (GRR) and net revenue retention (NRR) targets.
    • Build compelling renewal business cases that connect product usage and research outcomes to customer priorities. Identify expansion opportunities grounded in demonstrated value and customer needs, partnering with Sales to advance them.
    • Prepare and manage renewal proposals and order forms, coordinating with Legal, Security, Finance, and Sales to navigate contract and procurement requirements.
    • Maintain accurate renewal forecasts, proactively manage timelines and risks, and lead commercial conversations that protect customer relationships and deliver sustainable outcomes for Fable.

Senior leadership relationships & advocacy

    • Build trusted relationships with senior leaders across accessibility, design, product, UX, engineering, and research, understanding their priorities and connecting Fable’s value to their strategic goals.
    • Cultivate executive sponsorship and relationships beyond a single champion to strengthen account resilience, expand adoption, and secure support for continued investment.
    • Lead business reviews that demonstrate customer impact, align stakeholders on progress, and secure clear commitments to address adoption barriers and support renewal.
    • Develop customer advocates and identify opportunities for references, case studies, and sharing meaningful accessibility outcomes.

Cross functional alignment & support

    • Partner with Platform Support and Innovation teams to resolve issues, remove adoption barriers, and deliver a consistent customer experience.
    • Coordinate with Sales, Product, Marketing, and Finance on account plans and actions that improve usage, retention, and growth.
    • Translate customer feedback, usage patterns, and renewal insights into actionable input for product and roadmap discussions.
    • Improve Customer Success processes, playbooks, and engagement strategies using lessons from your portfolio to strengthen adoption and retention at scale.

Requirements

Key qualifications and assets

    • 4+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar customer-facing SaaS role.
    • 3+ years of managing enterprise customer relationships.
    • Experience supporting renewals, commercial discussions, and cross-functional deal coordination.
    • Experience using or experimenting with AI for research, preparation, follow-ups, analysis, or workflow automation.
    • Demonstrated ability to adapt and evolve ways of working with AI tools to drive new approaches, improve processes, and increase day-to-day efficiency.
    • Experience working in a startup or scale-up environment.
    • Proficiency with CRM and CS platforms such as HubSpot
    • Willing to learn about accessibility and follow inclusive design practices  

Our values

To lead, listen first
You amplify voices that are less often heard and create space for those voices to grow. The quality of an idea doesn't correlate with the loudness of someone's voice.

The brain is a muscle
If you're going to do something, you will do it well. Practice often and rest when needed. Give your mind what it needs to thrive.

Unlearn to learn
What did we learn growing up, and what do we need to unlearn? It's essential to understanding our personal bias and position so that we can grow.

Benefits

What’s in it for you?
At Fable, you’ll join a collaborative and mission-driven environment where you’ll work with people who care deeply about building a more inclusive digital world. We offer benefits such as stock options, career growth opportunities, professional development support, health and dental coverage, and more.

Accessibility accommodations

Fable is an inclusive workplace. If you are facing any accessibility requirements or concerns regarding the hiring process or employment with us, please fill out this form or email us at and include the subject line “Accessibility accommodation for Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager (CSM).”

Pay range

$115,000 – $150,000 On-target earnings, the salary band is designed to reflect the range of skills and experience needed for the position and is subject to change. The final salary is based on relevant skills, experience, and internal equity. This posting reflects an existing vacancy. Artificial intelligence (AI) tools may be used to support part of the recruitment and selection process. However, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring managers.
