raw.description:
About Us

Stellar Personnel is a premier hospitality staffing agency in Canada. Our clientele encompasses a diverse range of industries, including catering firms, corporate offices, sports and event venues, restaurants, hotels, retirement homes, and more. Our primary objective is to provide staffing solutions to these businesses, filling various roles such as dishwashers, cooks, chefs, servers, bartenders, cashiers, runners, shippers/receivers, administrative staff, and any other job positions as per the client's requirements.

Position Overview

Stellar Personnel is seeking a proactive, organized, and results-driven Staffing Coordinator to oversee daily staffing operations, ensure client shifts are filled efficiently, and maintain strong relationships with clients and personnel.

This role goes beyond scheduling. The Staffing Coordinator is responsible for managing assigned client accounts, anticipating staffing needs, resolving operational issues, identifying opportunities to grow accounts, and ensuring a high standard of client service.

Key Responsibilities

  • Shift Fulfillment: Manage daily client staffing requests and ensure shifts are filled with qualified, reliable personnel on time.

  • Client Management: Communicate directly with clients to understand their needs, provide updates, resolve concerns, and maintain strong relationships.

  • Staff Coordination: Confirm staff availability, monitor attendance and reliability, and manage last-minute cancellations and replacements.

  • Account Growth: Identify opportunities to increase shift coverage, expand existing accounts, and improve client retention.

  • Issue Resolution: Address staffing challenges and client concerns promptly, escalating critical issues when necessary.

  • Workflow Compliance: Maintain accurate staffing records, track KPIs, follow established procedures, and ensure smooth shift handovers.

  • Team Collaboration: Work closely with recruitment and other staffing coordinators to address staffing gaps and deliver quality service.

Qualifications and Requirements

  • At least3 years of experience in recruitment, staffing coordination, or workforce management, preferably within a staffing agency.

  • Proven experience communicating directly with clients, candidates, and other stakeholders.

  • Strong understanding of recruitment, candidate screening, staff availability, scheduling, and shift fulfillment.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage client accounts, prioritize competing demands, and resolve staffing challenges independently.

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, decision-making, and time-management skills.

Schedule and Availability Requirements:

  • Must be available 7 days a week, between 6:00 AM and 12:00 PM EST. Must be flexible, as work schedules may change based on operational requirements.

  • The work schedule consists of 5 days per week, with 2 days off.

  • Availability on weekends and holidays may be required.

raw.excerpt: Carpenter Technology Corporation is a leading producer and distributor of premium specialty alloys, including titanium alloys, nickel and cobalt based superalloys, stainless steels, alloy steels and tool steels.
raw.description:
Carpenter Technology Corporation is a leading producer and distributor of premium specialty alloys, including titanium alloys, nickel and cobalt based superalloys, stainless steels, alloy steels and tool steels. Carpenter’s high-performance materials and advanced process solutions are an integral part of critical applications used within the aerospace, transportation, medical and energy markets, among other markets. Building on its history of innovation, Carpenter’s wrought and powder technology capabilities support a range of next-generation products and manufacturing techniques, including novel magnetic materials and additive manufacturing.

Director, Strategic Sourcing (MRO)

Position Summary

Carpenter Technology is seeking an experienced and results-driven Director, Strategic Sourcing (MRO) to lead the development and execution of enterprise-wide sourcing strategies across a complex, high-value Maintenance, Repair, and Operations (MRO) spend portfolio of approximately $500 million. This strategic leadership role is responsible for driving cost transformation, supplier performance, supply continuity, operational reliability, and total cost of ownership (TCO) improvements across manufacturing and maintenance operations.

The Director will collaborate closely with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Finance, Supply Chain, EHS, Legal, and Plant Leadership to optimize sourcing strategies, deliver measurable business value, strengthen supplier partnerships, and support operational excellence. The successful candidate will combine deep MRO category expertise with strong commercial acumen, financial rigor, and leadership capability in a complex industrial manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Category Management & Sourcing Leadership

  • Develop and execute multi-year sourcing strategies for MRO materials, spare parts, OEM and aftermarket components, maintenance consumables, facility services, and maintenance engineering services.
  • Lead complex sourcing initiatives including RFIs, RFPs, RFQs, e-auctions, negotiations, and supplier selection processes.
  • Identify opportunities to standardize specifications, consolidate spend, optimize supplier networks, and reduce total cost of ownership.
  • Utilize spend analytics, market intelligence, benchmarking, and should-cost modeling to develop data-driven category strategies.
  • Align sourcing strategies with plant reliability, production requirements, maintenance schedules, and operational objectives.

Value Creation & Cost Optimization

  • Lead large-scale sourcing programs including:
  • Multi-year strategic agreements
  • Global supplier selection initiatives
  • Dual-sourcing and risk mitigation strategies
  • Integrated service contracts and performance-based agreements
  • Drive measurable cost savings and cost avoidance through:
  • Demand management
  • Specification optimization
  • Supplier consolidation
  • Inventory optimization
  • Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) and consignment programs
  • Develop and execute initiatives that improve working capital, productivity, and procurement ROI.

Supplier Relationship Management

  • Build and manage strategic relationships with distributors, OEMs, service providers, contractors, and engineering partners.
  • Establish supplier performance scorecards focused on cost, quality, service, delivery, innovation, lead time, and risk management.
  • Lead supplier reviews, corrective action programs, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Evaluate supplier capabilities, financial health, geographic coverage, and business continuity preparedness.

Financial Performance & Governance

  • Deliver annual savings, cost avoidance, and value creation targets.
  • Partner with Finance to validate, track, and report realized savings and procurement impact.
  • Develop sourcing levers and commercial strategies that maximize long-term value creation.
  • Ensure contract compliance, procurement governance, and adherence to company sourcing policies.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with Operations and Plant Leadership to support reliability and uptime objectives.
  • Collaborate with Maintenance and Engineering teams to optimize spare parts strategies and maintenance service models.
  • Work with Supply Chain teams to improve inventory performance and working capital efficiency.
  • Partner with EHS and Legal teams to ensure contractor compliance and risk management standards are met.
  • Serve as a trusted business advisor for strategic sourcing and supplier selection decisions.

Continuous Improvement & Digital Transformation

  • Drive sourcing process improvements and procurement best practices across sites and business units.
  • Leverage ERP, procurement, and analytics platforms to improve spend visibility and sourcing effectiveness.
  • Champion digital procurement initiatives, supplier performance management tools, and automation opportunities.
  • Promote preferred supplier programs and category management excellence.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 8–12 years of progressive procurement and sourcing experience.
  • Proven experience managing large and complex sourcing portfolios, preferably exceeding $200 million in annual spend.

Extensive experience sourcing:

  • MRO materials and consumables
  • Maintenance engineering services
  • Industrial service contracts
  • Capital equipment support and spare parts
  • Demonstrated success leading complex negotiations and strategic supplier partnerships.
  • Strong financial, analytical, and contract management skills.
  • Experience working within manufacturing, industrial, metals, aerospace, energy, chemical, or heavy industry environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA or advanced degree
  • Professional certifications such as:
  • CPSM (Certified Professional in Supply Management)
  • CPM (Certified Purchasing Manager)
  • CSCP (Certified Supply Chain Professional)
  • Experience with SAP, Coupa, Ariba, Oracle, or other large-scale procurement and ERP platforms.
  • Experience leading global sourcing initiatives and supplier transformation programs.
  • Knowledge of reliability-centered maintenance (RCM), asset management practices, and maintenance operations.

Carpenter Technology Company offers a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package including life, medical, dental, vision, flexible spending accounts, disability coverage, 401k with company contributions as well as many other options to employees.

Carpenter Technology Corporation’s policy is to fully and effectively maintain a program of equal employment opportunity and nondiscrimination for all employees, to employ affirmative action for all protected classes, and to recruit and develop the best qualified persons available regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, political affiliation or any other characteristic protected by law. The Company also will recruit, develop and provide opportunities for qualified persons with disabilities and protected veterans.

About Integrate

Integrate is a B2B demand orchestration platform that helps enterprise marketing teams capture, validate, and activate leads across every channel — turning fragmented demand generation into a unified, measurable pipeline.

We’re Hiring: Lead Data Analyst – Technical Delivery Team

Department: Technical Delivery
Experience: 6+ Years
Qualification: Engineering Graduates Only
Location: Work From Home
Shift: US Shift – 6:00 PM to 3:00 AM IST
Notice Period: Immediate Joiners to 30 Days

Job Description

We are looking for skilled, analytical, and client-oriented Lead Data Analyst with strong SQL expertise and a good understanding of Python and Spark. This role focuses on translating customer business, reporting, and data-analysis requirements into accurate, scalable technical solutions.

You will work closely with Customer Success Managers within the Technical Delivery team to understand requirements and develop custom reports, dashboards, widgets, data models, configurations, and other platform-based solutions. You will also collaborate with Product Engineering and Design teams to evaluate technical approaches, resolve platform challenges, and ensure smooth execution.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys combining data analysis, SQL, technical problem-solving, client communication, and cross-functional collaboration to deliver effective solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Engage directly with clients and Customer Success Managers to understand business, reporting, and technical requirements and translate them into clear, actionable specifications.
  • Ability to manage the team of junior data analysts
  • Act as a bridge between clients, Customer Success, and internal engineering teams to ensure seamless communication and successful execution.
  • Build custom reports, dashboards, widgets, data models, and other platform-based solutions to address customer business and data-analysis needs.
  • Write, analyze, and optimize SQL queries against complex relational data models to support reporting, data analysis, and customer requirements.
  • Use Python and Spark, where appropriate, to support data transformation, reporting, and specialized technical solutions.
  • Configure platform features, workflows, integrations, and reporting components based on defined requirements.
  • Analyze source data and existing configurations to identify the most effective and scalable implementation approach.
  • Partner with stakeholders to clarify requirements, assess technical feasibility, identify dependencies, and define implementation approaches.
  • Collaborate with Product Engineering and Design teams to investigate platform limitations, troubleshoot technical issues, document requirements, and validate fixes or workarounds.
  • Test and quality-check reports, dashboards, widgets, data models, and configurations before delivery.
  • Create technical documentation, solution notes, data-lineage documentation, and reusable implementation patterns.
  • Manage multiple solution requests, prioritize effectively, communicate progress and risks, and follow issues through to resolution.
  • Ensure all deliverables align with customer expectations, business objectives, and technical requirements.

Required Qualifications and Skills

  • 6+ years of relevant experience.
  • Engineering graduates only.
  • Strong SQL skills are mandatory, including the ability to write and optimize queries against complex relational data models.
  • Good knowledge of Python and Spark.
  • Ability to read and understand technical documentation, including data-lineage diagrams, entity-relationship diagrams (ERDs), and business-process flows.
  • Strong analytical, logical reasoning, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.
  • Ability to explain technical concepts and issues clearly to both business and technical audiences.
  • Comfortable interacting directly with clients, understanding their requirements, and discussing technical solutions.
  • Strong stakeholder management, coordination, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple requests, prioritize competing tasks, and take ownership of issues through resolution.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment while collaborating with distributed teams.

Preferred Skills (Good to Have)

  • Experience with version-control systems such as GitHub or Bitbucket.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and databases such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP), BigQuery, or Snowflake.
  • Familiarity with marketing technology platforms and integrations, including Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, Google Ads, LinkedIn, or Eloqua.
  • Experience in B2B marketing, marketing operations, revenue operations, or business intelligence.
  • Familiarity with business intelligence and reporting platforms such as Microsoft Power BI, Looker, or Tableau.
  • Experience with SaaS platforms, data integrations, reporting solutions, or technical support.

What Will Help You Succeed

  • A curious, methodical, and analytical approach to problem-solving.
  • The ability to translate complex data concepts into practical solutions and clear explanations.
  • Comfort investigating ambiguous issues, forming hypotheses, testing solutions, and documenting findings.
  • Strong ownership, proactive communication, and organization when managing competing priorities.
  • A customer-first mindset and a commitment to delivering reliable, high-quality solutions.
  • An interest in growing a career in data analytics, technical delivery, technical support, customer success, or revenue technology.

Why Join Integrate?

  • Work on a technically challenging B2B SaaS product supporting marketing and revenue operations.
  • Gain exposure to customer data models, marketing technology, integrations, analytics, and business processes.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Product, Engineering, Implementation, Account Services, and Business Intelligence.
  • Build a career at the intersection of data, technology, and customer outcomes.
  • Join a collaborative environment that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous improvement.

Important: Strong SQL expertise is a critical requirement for this role. Candidates must also possess good communication skills and be comfortable working in the US shift (6:00 PM to 3:00 AM IST).

Confidential Employer.

raw.description:
About the Role

We are looking for an Embedded Python Data & Automation Engineer to take ownership of an existing Python environment, maintain production systems, improve automations and data pipelines, and develop internal tools and integrations.

Key Responsibilities

  • System Transition & Knowledge Absorption: Shadow the departing programmer and take ownership of the existing Python codebase.
  • Production Support & Maintenance: Troubleshoot live issues, maintain existing systems, and ensure system stability.
  • Data Pipelines & Automations: Maintain, debug, and improve data pipelines and scheduled automations.
  • API & Integration Ownership: Maintain and extend APIs, third-party integrations, authentication flows, and webhooks.
  • Technical Debt: Identify fragile systems, undocumented dependencies, and technical risks and improve them over time.
  • Documentation: Create and maintain system documentation, workflow diagrams, dependency maps, and operating procedures.
  • Internal Tooling: Build practical automation tools and internal software based on business needs.
  • Engineering Practices: Use Git, pull requests, automated testing, changelogs, and staged deployments.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3+ years of professional Python experience in a data-focused environment.
  • Experience building or maintaining production data pipelines and automations.
  • Strong experience with APIs, integrations, authentication, and webhooks.
  • Experience working with an existing or legacy codebase.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
  • Familiarity with Git, pull requests, testing, and deployment workflows.
  • Strong written English and technical documentation skills.
  • Ability to work with meaningful overlap with US business hours.

Typical Day

Your day begins with a check on overnight automations and any open production issues. You spend focused blocks working through the current system — reading existing code, running tests, tracing integrations, and filling in documentation gaps. Early in the engagement, a meaningful portion of your time is in handover sessions with the departing programmer. As the transition matures, that time shifts toward new development: building automations, improving pipeline reliability, or scoping a new internal tool with the client. You communicate primarily over Slack and participate in planning sessions and check-ins that align with US business hours. You raise flags early, document as you go, and push changes through staging rather than directly to production.

Interview Process

  • Video Interview Screening
  • Client Interview
  • Offer Stage

Staff Accountant, Data & Compliance

100% Remote within California, Must reside in California

We are seeking a Staff Accountant, Data & Compliance to join FoundationCCC in its mission of benefiting, supporting, and enhancing the California Community Colleges—the largest and most diverse system of higher education in the nation. Together, we are building stronger communities by getting students and colleges the resources they need to succeed and expanding pathways to economic and social mobility across California. Join us as we continue this important work to uphold the value of community colleges in building a brighter future.


What You’ll Do


The Staff Accountant assists with a variety of accounting and related duties in support of the Finance Department. This position performs basic accounting functions as they relate to assigned portfolios of work. The Staff Accountant works closely on large projects that are tied to state and federal funding. Handles data reconciliation and assists in the fiscal desk reviews of subrecipients tied to government funding. The nature of the work requires a strong knowledge of basic accounting principles and business procedures; excellent organizational, interpersonal and communication skills; extreme accuracy and attention to detail; and a background in federal grant compliance.

  • Provide subject matter expertise on federal compliance as it pertains to government grants, including the Code of Federal Regulations Uniform Administrative Requirements (2 CFR 200) and specific guidance pertaining to individual programs
  • Help prepare financial statements and quarterly government reports (SF-425)
  • Complete fiscal desk reviews of subrecipients (community colleges, nonprofit organizations, and rural health organizations), including review of financial controls, expense backup documentation, and compliance with federal guidance
  • Gather data and information across a suite of systems to support accurate and timely reporting

Attributes for Success


  • Knowledge of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP)
  • Relevant BA/BS, equivalent work experience, or a combination of both.
  • Minimum of two (2) + years of related work experience in finance or accounting.
  • Experience with federal grants compliance.
  • Ability to interpret and apply accounting theory to transactions.
  • Strong analytical skills.
  • Ability to effectively present information and answer questions for Foundation customers, partners, and management.
  • Our work holds great weight and responsibility, and the opportunity to impact the lives of millions of individuals in California
  • FoundationCCC blends the impact of a non-profit, the culture of an entrepreneurial start-up, and the scale of a state agency

What we Offer


FoundationCCC is fully committed to a “remote-first” philosophy, and recruits and hires talent across the state in fully remote positions, where virtual work is possible. Our headquarters are located in Downtown Sacramento, just blocks from California’s State Capitol.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, generous PTO, and paid holidays
  • Medical, dental, and vision plans, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts (HSA), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and Wellness offerings
  • CalPERS retirement program and optional 403(b) and 457 Retirement plans
  • Carrot reproductive health and fertility support
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness certified employer

$75,000.00 - $80,000.00

Account Manager, Customer Success (West)

Full-Time, Remote / Salary, Exempt / Includes Benefits, PTO, Flexible Schedule, Equity

Steno is growing! We're looking for an Account Manager to join our Customer Success team, the people who make sure every law firm we partner with feels like they're in the best possible hands. You'll be the go-to person for your firms, the one they trust to get it right, and the glue between our clients, Account Executives, and the teams behind every deposition. We're a diverse team from all over the country (and beyond) and we're crazy about redefining the boundaries of an outdated industry.

Who are you?

You're the person clients are relieved to hear from. You remember that one firm wants the exhibits sent a certain way and that another always needs things yesterday, and you handle both without breaking a sweat. You're detail-obsessed, calm when a deposition is on the line, and happiest when you've spotted a problem before anyone else knew it existed. You like owning things through to the finish, you love building real relationships, and you know how to balance a busy inbox with the bigger picture. In this role, you'll be both a trusted relationship owner and an operational partner, working side by side with Account Executives, Scheduling, Operations, Production, and Billing. This role reports to the Customer Success leadership team.

If you're looking for a company that offers support, guidance, an abundance of killer giphys, and unlimited potential to grow into your best self, you can bet we'd love to have you too.

On a regular basis you will

  • Be the primary day-to-day contact for your assigned firms, delivering white-glove, personalized service shaped around each firm's preferences and workflows
  • Partner with Account Executives to stay aligned on account priorities, client concerns, and opportunities to grow and improve the relationship
  • Review and coordinate deposition orders through daily quality checks, making sure jobs are entered accurately and tied to the right firm and location
  • Triage scheduling, rescheduling, and cancellation requests, routing them to the right teams and following through until they're done
  • Spot urgent and expedited requests, communicate the urgency clearly, and rally internal teams to meet client deadlines
  • Own first-line issue resolution, managing tickets with clear documentation, prioritization, and follow-up, and escalating high-impact issues to the right people
  • De-escalate tough conversations with empathy and professionalism, then confirm the fix landed and the client is happy
  • Keep clients informed with proactive updates and get ahead of questions before they become concerns
  • Share what you're seeing, from recurring errors and ticket trends to shifts in client sentiment, with AEs and leadership, and help fix root causes
  • Educate clients on Steno's products, services, and best practices, and flag opportunities for firms to get even more from our technology
  • Pitch in on scheduling inboxes and ticket queues during high-volume periods, and join our after-hours coverage rotation for urgent, last-minute deposition needs

You're gonna crush it if

  • You have 3+ years of experience in account management, customer success, or customer service, preferably in the legal industry
  • You have a client-first mindset and a track record of delivering responsive, dependable, high-touch service
  • You're known for your attention to detail and can catch discrepancies in job details, firm and location assignments, scheduling information, and documented preferences
  • You communicate clearly and confidently in writing and by phone, including through difficult conversations
  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment, prioritizing competing deadlines and urgent requests without dropping the ball
  • You think critically, dig into root causes, and know when to escalate
  • You're comfortable moving between multiple platforms and using data to spot trends and make decisions
  • You take ownership, hand off cleanly, and see issues through to resolution
  • You're adaptable, collaborative, and energized by a changing workload
  • You're located and available to work core business hours in the Pacific Timezone
  • You're available to participate in after-hours coverage when needed

Compensation & Benefits

  • Pay - $75,000-$85,000
  • Premium Medical, Dental, & Vision Coverage – options for you and your family, with 100% of premiums covered for some plans – well above industry benchmarks
  • Wellness/Mental Health - shared benefits to be used among employees and families
  • Flexible Paid Time Off - allowing employees to find balance in their lives
  • Options of Equity - we know our success is nothing without our team
  • Access to a company-provided 401(k) account
  • A home office setup and a monthly stipend to offset internet and phone costs

Application Information

  • Steno is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on any characteristics that are protected under the law. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.
  • Applicants needing special assistance or accommodations for interviews or website access should contact us at .
  • Steno personnel will always have either a steno.com email address or will contact you via Rippling Recruiting. Act with caution if asked for personal information. Background checks, for example, are only conducted after an offer is extended.
  • Information provided to Steno, such as professional credentials and skills, educational and work history, the results of technical skills assessments or working exercises, and other information that may be included on a resume or application, is collected and stored in our system. Still, we never disclose or sell your personal information.

POSITION OVERVIEW

MCI is one of the fastest-growing tech-enabled businesses services companies in the US, delivering Customer Experience (CX), Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) and technology solutions across multiple industries and countries worldwide. Our team use people, technology and innovation to help organizations improve customer experience and business performance.

Join our team as a Remote Inbound Call Center Representative, where you'll be the first point of contact for customers seeking assistance. This role is ideal for individuals who excel at problem-solving and delivering exceptional customer service all from the comfort of home.

To be considered for this role, you must complete a full application on our company careers page, including all screening questions and a brief pre-employment test.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES

Key Responsibilities:

  • Answer incoming calls promptly and professionally.
  • Assist customers with inquiries.
  • Provide accurate information about products and services.
  • Document customer interactions in the system.
  • Escalate complex issues to appropriate departments.

CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS

WONDER IF YOU ARE A GOOD FIT FOR THIS POSITION?

All positive, and driven applicants are encouraged to apply. The Ideal candidates for this position are highly motivated and dedicated and should possess the below qualities:

  • Must be 18 years or older.
  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • Previous customer service or call center experience preferred.
  • Strong communication and active listening skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace.

COMPENSATION DETAILS

WANT AN EMPLOYER THAT VALUES YOUR CONTRIBUTION?

At MCI, we believe that your hard work deserves recognition and reward. Our compensation and benefits packages are designed to be competitive and to grow with you over time. Starting compensation is based on experience, and we offer a variety of benefits and incentives to support and reward our team members.

What You Can Expect from MCI:

We understand the importance of balance and support, which is why we offer a variety of benefits and incentives that go beyond a paycheck. Our team members enjoy:

  • Paid Time Off: Earn PTO and paid holidays to take the time you need.
  • Health Benefits: Full-time employees are eligible for supplemental health coverage through Blue Cross.
  • Life Insurance: Access life insurance options to safeguard your loved ones.
  • Supplemental Insurance: Accident and critical illness insurance
  • Career Growth: With a focus on internal promotions, employees enjoy significant advancement opportunities.
  • Paid Training: Learn new skills while earning a paycheck.
  • Fun, Engaging Work Environment: Enjoy a team-oriented culture that fosters collaboration and engagement.
  • Casual Dress Code: Be comfortable while you work.

Compensation & Benefits that Fit Your Life

MCI takes pride in tailoring our offerings to fit the needs of our diverse team across subsidiaries and locations. While specific benefits and incentives may vary by geography, the core of our commitment remains the same: rewarding effort, providing growth opportunities, and creating an environment where every employee feels valued.

If you’re ready to join a company that recognizes your contributions and supports your growth, MCI is the place for you. Apply today!

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

This job operates in a professional office environment. While performing the duties of this job, the employee will be largely sedentary and will be required to sit/stand for long periods while using a computer and telephone headset. The employee will be regularly required to operate a computer and other office equipment, including a phone, copier, and printer. The employee may occasionally be required to move about the office to accomplish tasks; reach in any direction; raise or lower objects, move objects from place to place, hold onto objects, and move or exert force up to forty (40) pounds.

CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT

All MCI Locations

  • Must be authorized to work in the country where the job is based.

Subject to the program and location of the position

  • Must be willing to submit up to a LEVEL II background and/or security investigation with a fingerprint. Job offers are contingent on background/security investigation results.
  • Must be willing to submit to drug screening. Job offers are contingent on drug screening results. (Does not apply in Canada)

REASONABLE ACCOMMODATION

Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), it is the policy of MCI and its affiliates to provide reasonable accommodations when requested by a qualified applicant or employee with a disability unless such accommodations would cause undue hardship. The policy regarding requests for reasonable accommodation applies to all aspects of employment. If reasonable accommodations are needed, please contact Human Resources.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

At MCI and its subsidiaries, we embrace differences and believe diversity is a benefit to our employees, our company, our customers, and our community. All aspects of employment at MCI are based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. MCI maintains a work environment free from discrimination, one where employees are treated with dignity and respect. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling MCI's commitment to a diverse and equal opportunity work environment.

MCI does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances. MCI will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements.

MCI will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. We adhere to these principles in all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, promotion, benefits, social and recreational programs, and discipline. In addition, it is the policy of MCI to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where an employee works.

ABOUT US

MCI helps customers take on their CX and DX challenges differently, creating industry-leading solutions that deliver exceptional experiences and drive optimal performance. MCI assists companies with business process outsourcing, staff augmentation, contact center customer services, and IT Services needs by providing general and specialized hosting, software, staff, and services.

In 2019, Marlowe Companies Inc. (MCI) was named by Inc. Magazine as Iowa’s Fastest Growing Company in the State of Iowa and was named the 452nd Fastest Growing Privately Company in the USA, making the coveted top 500 for the first time. raw.description:
About OneEnergy Renewables

OneEnergy’s mission is to make clean energy the #1 source of electricity for consumers and utilities. We develop solar energy and battery energy storage (BESS) projects across the United States in community solar, distributed generation, and large utility scale project segments. Our diverse project pipeline, multiple locations across the US, and unique multidisciplined team sets us apart.

We are a dynamic and innovative renewable energy industry company committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving positive change in our industry.

About the role

The Sr. BESS Manager, owns OneEnergy's battery energy storage engineering function and is accountable for standing it up as a repeatable, institutional capability. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role for an engineer who has not only designed DG and utility-scale BESS systems but has carried multiple BESS projects through full construction and commissioning cycles. The role mirrors and integrates with OER's established PV processes, tools, and standards; builds the BESS equivalents where they do not yet exist, and operates across Development, Preconstruction, Finance, and Engineering. Reporting to the VP of Engineering and directing future Associate Engineers, the position demands strong interdepartmental coordination, personal initiative, and the judgment to make sound decisions on equipment, cost, and layout designs.

What you'lldo:

  • Define and maintain BESS design standards, templates, and workflows (SLDs, layouts, equipment specifications) and keep them current with the team's latest PV standards.
  • Establish and enforce a workflow for tracking BESS status, tiering, and prioritization across all company strategies.
  • Lead DG and utility-scale BESS plant design; review and approve high-voltage substation, medium-voltage collection, and BESS plant drawing packages at each design stage.
  • Lead design and modeling discussions across the engineering team and outside consultants.
  • Lead BESS CAPEX methodology: match each commercial opportunity to equipment sizing, guarantees, and warranties, and develop equipment and EPC cost estimates.
  • Drive equipment selection and pricing through collaboration with the Preconstruction Team
  • Own relationships with key BESS integrators, equipment providers, and contractors.
  • Maintain safety standards and keep all documentation current with the latest NFPA 855, NEC (including Article 706, Energy Storage Systems), NESC, and UL 9540 / UL 9540A requirements.
  • Lead BESS RFP responses, coordinating internal resources and vendor-provided technical details and assumptions, and reusing and escalating prior material for fast turnarounds.
  • Provide feedback on System Impact and Feasibility Studies as needed.
  • Serve as the bridge across Development, Preconstruction, Finance, and Engineering, handing off finalized equipment selection and quantities to Engineering for SLDs and layouts.
  • Act as an extension of the Development team on community outreach, permitting, and strategic pipeline planning.

Qualifications

  • Degree in electrical, mechanical, or a related engineering field.
  • PE license, or a clear and near-term path to licensure.
  • 6+ years in professional engineering, construction, or land development, with a substantial and recent portion focused on battery energy storage.
  • Demonstrated experience taking multiple DG and/or utility-scale BESS projects through full construction and commissioning cycles.
  • Direct experience selecting, sizing, and procuring BESS equipment across multiple OEMs and integrators.
  • Strong familiarity of NEC (including Article 706), NESC, NFPA 855, and UL 9540 / UL 9540A as applied to energy storage systems.
  • Experience leading RFP responses and interconnection and permitting interactions with utilities and AHJs.
  • Experience managing internal engineering resources and direct reports, with comfort switching between management and hands-on design work.
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills with offtakers, contractors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Proficiency establishing equipment specifications to generate final submittals.
  • Strong attention to detail, high integrity, and proven organizational capacity to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • A willingness to contribute to a culture that thrives on building trust and holding one another accountable.
  • A “roll up your sleeves and let’s get the job done right” attitude, with demonstrated qualities of integrity, credibility, and professional responsibility.
  • Ability to travel and access sites of varying terrain, and an acceptable driving record and active driver's license.

Compensation:

Salary range: $130,000-$200,000, depending on location and experience

OneEnergy’s compensation packages are dependent on an array of factors including, but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, licensure and certifications, geographic location, and other organizational needs. We provide generous Paid Time Off (six weeks/year) and an impactful Volunteer Time Off Program. We offer robust employee benefits including comprehensive medical coverage, 401(k) matching retirement plan, life insurance, wellness incentives, and more.

We recognize an equitable energy transition requires the participation of diverse communities, groups, and institutions. OneEnergy is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against otherwise qualified applicants on the basis of actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex, marital status, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or handicap, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

raw.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist

raw.description:
Who We Are

Catalyst Capital Holdings is the group behind Decentralized Masters, Inflection Club, Legacy, Future Finance, and Beyond Members Club - a fast-growing, bootstrapped ecosystem spanning DeFi education, private co-investment, and membership communities. Each entity operates with its own brand, hiring managers, and pace, but shares a single People & Culture function.

That function is small, lean, and stretched across five businesses at once - which is exactly the problem this role exists to solve.

Our Impact

Across the group, we have built and scaled teams from the ground up while empowering thousands of members and investors globally. We hire fast, we hire often, and we hire across very different functions - sales, ops, tech, finance, investment, and executive support - sometimes all in the same week.

Our Vision

We want every entity in the group to hire with the same rigor: structured, scorecard-first, and fast enough that a great candidate never slips away while we figure out process. Getting there requires a dedicated recruiter who can operate across the whole group, not just one company's pipeline.

Are You Ready?

This is a build role inside a lean team - you will run full-cycle recruiting for multiple businesses at once, with real autonomy and a direct line to the person who owns People & Culture for the entire group.

The Role

The People & Culture Specialist reports directly to the People & Culture Manager and covers two things across every Catalyst Capital Group entity (Decentralized Masters, Inflection Club, Legacy, Future Finance, and Beyond Members Club): full-cycle recruiting and People Operations and HR administration.

You will run multiple concurrent searches for different hiring managers while also keeping the group’s people admin accurate, compliant, and on time. Expect roughly 60% recruiting and 40% People Ops, shifting week to week with hiring volume. You are the connective tissue that keeps quality and process consistent across all five businesses.

What You'll Own

1. Full-Cycle Recruiting Execution

  • Run requisitions end to end: intake with the department lead, job description and scorecard build in Workable, sourcing, screening, structured interview logistics, through to offer.
  • Run searches concurrently across multiple entities and role types without dropping quality standards.

2. Sourcing & Pipeline

  • Source directly via LinkedIn, Workable, free and Web3-specific job boards, and outbound headhunting rather than waiting on inbound applicants.
  • Build and maintain warm talent pipelines for recurring, high-volume role types (setters, closers, mentors, VAs) so new reqs open with a head start.
  • Screen for CV fraud and AI-tailored application patterns - a known and recurring issue across recent hiring cycles.

3. Cross-Entity Coordination

  • Partner with department leads and hiring managers across all five entities, each with different hiring maturity and norms.
  • Enforce the group's standard hiring process - approval, structured interview sequence (Loom review, Talent Team interview, Hiring Manager interview, exercises and assessments, etc.)

4. Systems & Reporting

  • Maintain Workable pipeline hygiene: accurate stages, notes, and candidate status across every open requisition.
  • Maintain a live recruiting report for the People & Culture Manager - time-to-fill, pipeline volume, and source effectiveness by entity.
  • Coordinate a minimum of two reference checks per hire before any offer is extended.

5. Offer Support

  • Draft first-pass offer language aligned to each entity's comp structure and route for sign-off before it goes to the candidate.

6. Onboarding & Offboarding

  • Run the new-hire process end to end: contracts, pre-start paperwork, tool and system access, equipment, Day 1 and Week 1 schedule.
  • Run offboarding: access removal, equipment return, final admin, and exit documentation.
  • Keep one consistent onboarding experience across all entities.

7. HR Administration & Records

  • Maintain accurate contractor records, org charts, and entity assignments in our HRIS and shared drives.
  • Prepare and issue employment and contractor agreements, amendments, and role or comp change letters from approved templates.
  • Collect and prepare inputs for payroll and contractor invoicing, and coordinate with Finance on accuracy and timing.
  • Arranging of Birthday gifts, gifts for special occasions, and company swag for all team members.

8. Policy, Compliance & Team Member Support

  • Maintain the handbook, policies, and People & Culture templates, and keep them current.
  • Be the first point of contact for contractor questions on policy, leave, payroll, and tooling.
  • Escalate industrial relations issues to the People & Culture Manager promptly.
  • Keep records audit-ready and handle all personal data with strict confidentiality.

9. People Reporting

  • Maintain a live headcount and people dashboard: joiners, leavers, open roles, and entity splits.
  • Flag admin backlogs and compliance gaps to the People & Culture Manager.

Requirements

What You Need

    • 3+ years in recruiting and/or HR operations, with at least 2 years of full-cycle recruiting across multiple business units, brands, or portfolio companies at once.
    • Hands-on experience with HR administration: onboarding and offboarding, contracts, employee records, and payroll or contractor inputs. Experience with remote, international, or contractor-heavy teams is a plus.
    • Comfortable running several concurrent searches across functions while keeping admin work on schedule, without a coordinator behind you.
    • Fluent with an ATS (Workable strongly preferred) and an HRIS (BambooHR), and confident building structured interview scorecards.
    • High attention to detail and sound judgment with confidential information.
    • Experience partnering directly with a People & Culture leader and with hiring managers across multiple entities.
    • Excellent written English and comfortable working async across time zones, with availability for EST hours or overlap with both EST and CET.

Nice to Have

    • Recruiting or HR experience in Web3, DeFi, fintech, or membership/education businesses.
    • Experience in a holding company or group structure with multiple P&Ls.
    • Familiarity with Testlify or similar assessment tools.
    • Working knowledge of employment practices for contractors and employees across multiple countries, or experience with an employer-of-record provider.
    • Familiarity with Google Workspace, Slack, and ClickUp.

Benefits

What we offer you

  • Competitive salary
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Team off-sites
  • Fully remote with a very supportive team.

Position Overview

The Chief Sales Officer (CSO) is responsible for leading the organization's global sales strategy, revenue generation, and business development initiatives. The CSO oversees sales operations, client acquisition, account management, and sales performance across all channels and markets. This role is focused on driving sustainable revenue growth, strengthening customer relationships, and building high-performing sales teams aligned with the company's strategic objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Strategy & Revenue Growth

  • Develop and execute enterprise-wide sales strategies to achieve revenue and growth targets.
  • Identify new business opportunities, customer segments, and market expansion initiatives.
  • Drive revenue generation through strategic sales planning and execution.

Business Development & Client Acquisition

  • Lead customer acquisition and business development initiatives across target markets.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, partners, and stakeholders.
  • Develop strategic partnerships and sales channels to expand market reach.

Sales Operations & Performance Management

  • Oversee sales operations, pipeline management, forecasting, and performance tracking.
  • Establish sales KPIs, targets, and reporting frameworks.
  • Monitor conversion rates, sales productivity, and revenue performance.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing sales teams and regional sales leaders.
  • Build a results-oriented and customer-focused sales culture.
  • Drive training, coaching, and professional development initiatives.

Customer Relationship Management

  • Ensure exceptional customer engagement and account management practices.
  • Strengthen client retention and long-term relationship strategies.
  • Collaborate with customer success and service teams to improve customer experience.

Market Intelligence & Competitive Analysis

  • Analyze market trends, customer behavior, and competitor activities.
  • Use market insights to refine sales strategies and identify growth opportunities.
  • Support product and marketing teams with customer feedback and market intelligence.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with marketing, product, operations, finance, and customer success teams.
  • Ensure alignment between sales initiatives and organizational objectives.
  • Collaborate on go-to-market strategies and revenue optimization initiatives.

Digital Sales & Innovation

  • Drive adoption of CRM systems, sales automation tools, and digital sales strategies.
  • Leverage analytics and technology to improve sales efficiency and scalability.
  • Explore innovative approaches to customer acquisition and engagement.

Reporting & Executive Engagement

  • Provide regular sales performance reports and strategic insights to executive leadership and the Board.
  • Present forecasts, growth plans, and market opportunities.
  • Support strategic decision-making through data-driven analysis.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, or related field; MBA preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of experience in sales leadership, business development, or revenue management roles.
  • Proven track record of achieving revenue growth and leading high-performing sales organizations.
  • Strong experience in B2B sales, enterprise sales, or strategic account management.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Strong leadership and people management skills.
  • Strategic sales and business development expertise.
  • Excellent negotiation and relationship-building abilities.
  • Analytical and data-driven decision-making capabilities.
  • Strong communication and executive presentation skills.
  • Customer-focused and results-oriented mindset.

Performance Metrics

  • Revenue growth and sales target achievement.
  • Customer acquisition and retention rates.
  • Pipeline growth and conversion performance.
  • Sales team productivity and performance.
  • Expansion into new markets and customer segments.

About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

Staff Technical Program Manager, Advanced Technology Group

Pinterest Technical Program Managers deliver critical and strategic outcomes by directing and scaling engineering effort across organizational and functional boundaries.

Pinterest is looking for a highly technical, experienced Staff TPM to join the Advanced Technology Group (ATG), a research-driven engineering organization advancing Pinterest's ML/AI capabilities. You'll partner directly with senior product and engineering leaders to turn ambitious AI strategy into shipped, reliable, and widely adopted capabilities. This is a high-visibility role spanning research, ML platform, infrastructure, safety, and product teams.

What you'll do:

  • Lead complex, multi-workstream programs across ML research, platform engineering, infrastructure, safety/compliance, and product, aligned under one roadmap, metrics, and governance.
  • Partner closely with the VPs of Product and Engineering to translate strategy into workstreams, staffing, milestones, and clear decision-making.
  • Drive the path from research to production: model development, evaluation, release management, serving capacity, and adoption by product teams.
  • Define and track metrics and guardrails (quality, cost, reliability, adoption, cycle time) and use them to drive decisions.
  • Run technical design and decision forums; identify risks and tradeoffs early and align senior leaders on a path forward.
  • Build operating mechanisms (planning, reviews, intake, launch readiness, post-mortems) that scale across teams working at different paces.
  • Use AI tooling to automate tracking, reporting, and program insights.
  • Communicate status, risks, and decisions to executives and cross-functional partners, tailoring technical depth to the audience.

What we're looking for:

  • Minimum 8 years in technical program management, engineering, or related roles, with a track record of leading org-level, multi-team ML/AI or platform programs.
  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.
  • Deep technical understanding of ML/AI systems (training and post-training, evaluation, model serving, GPU capacity, release management) and platform engineering. You can read design docs and challenge assumptions.
  • Experience with LLM/multimodal model adoption, such as adapting open-source models, evaluation frameworks, and migrating workloads between model providers, is a strong plus.
  • Proven ability to partner with VP and Director-level leaders in Product and Engineering and influence strategy and prioritization.
  • Experience designing planning processes and governance (annual and multi-half planning) across several organizations.
  • Strong analytical skills: SQL, dashboards, and using data from experiments and evaluations to drive decisions.
  • Comfort with high ambiguity, rapidly changing technology, and cross-functional work with Legal, Privacy, and Safety partners.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, including nuanced technical concepts for executive audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and scale processes, and to use AI tools to automate program management.

In-Office Requirement Statement:

  • We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.
  • This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times/quarter and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country.

Relocation Statement:

  • This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

At Pinterest we believe the workplace should be equitable, inclusive, and inspiring for every employee. In an effort to provide greater transparency, we are sharing the base salary range for this position. The position is also eligible for equity. Final salary is based on a number of factors including location, travel, relevant prior experience, or particular skills and expertise.

Information regarding the culture at Pinterest and benefits available for this position can be found here.

About NeoReach

NeoReach is a creator-technology company and influencer marketing leader trusted by Fortune 500 brands, global enterprises, and disruptive startups to deliver campaigns that move culture and drive business outcomes.

We combine agency expertise with proprietary creator-data infrastructure, performance tools, and AI-enabled workflows. Our ecosystem includes Influencers.com, a platform helping creators grow their businesses and unlock new opportunities.

We’re seeking an experienced engineer to strengthen our data infrastructure and build practical AI-powered tools.

Role Overview

The Senior Data & AI Engineer will connect business systems, improve data quality, and develop reliable tools that help teams work efficiently and make better decisions.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role, owning work from discovery through deployment. You will work directly with product leadership and collaborate with engineering and business teams to deliver focused solutions with measurable impact.

The initial engagement will prioritize a defined data integration and an AI-enabled workflow, with scope and milestones established at kickoff.

Key Responsibilities

Data Infrastructure and Integrations

  • Assess existing data sources and workflows to identify gaps and opportunities
  • Build integrations connecting APIs, databases, and business applications
  • Standardize records, resolve duplicates, and establish consistent data definitions
  • Implement validation, monitoring, and error handling

AI Tools and Automation

  • Build tools for research, information retrieval, analysis, and recurring workflows
  • Connect AI applications to approved internal systems and data
  • Use AI coding tools to accelerate development while maintaining quality and reliability
  • Evaluate accuracy, usefulness, and cost, with appropriate access controls and human review

Product Development and Delivery

  • Translate business requirements into realistic technical milestones

💼 B2B Software Sales Representative
🌍 Philippines, South Africa, Latin America

About Our Client

Our client is a fast-growing, early-stage B2B SaaS company serving field service and operations businesses. Sales has been founder-led to date, and this is the first dedicated sales hire, giving the right person real influence over how the sales function is built. The company sells both software subscriptions and professional services and onboarding packages.

About the Role

We're looking for a B2B Software Sales Representative to be the first dedicated sales hire, owning the entire sales funnel end to end: inbound lead response, outbound prospecting, discovery, demo, proposal, and close. This is not an appointment-setting role.

You'll be the single sales seat reporting directly to the founder, with full ownership of pipeline, CRM hygiene, SOP execution, and closing. If you're a proven closer who can work independently, follow a documented process without being micromanaged, and take genuine ownership of revenue outcomes in an early-stage environment, this role is a strong fit.

Responsibilities

  • Own the complete sales cycle from research and outreach through qualification, demo, proposal, close, and handoff to onboarding
  • Respond to inbound leads immediately via call, email, and SMS as defined in the sales SOP, as speed to lead is a hard expectation
  • Run structured discovery conversations covering pain, current tools, decision process, timeline, and budget signals
  • Lead product demos with support from the customer success team
  • Send proposals and quotes, chase signatures, and confirm kickoff details for every won deal
  • Close both software subscription plans and professional services and onboarding packages
  • Research target accounts, build call lists, and run a consistent cold and warm outbound motion alongside inbound response
  • Own CRM management day to day, including pipeline stages, tags, sequences, and logging every touch, keeping next steps, close dates, and notes current
  • Provide light weekly reporting on activity, pipeline, wins, losses, and blockers
  • Feed product and marketing teams with call insights, including ICP feedback, common objections, and feature requests
  • Help refine scripts, talk tracks, and ICP definitions as sales scales from founder-led to team-led
  • Handle objections and negotiate within approved pricing guidelines, escalating edge cases to leadership

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience closing, or strongly contributing to closing, B2B software or high-consideration sales (not appointment setting only)
  • Excellent spoken English with the confidence and presence to lead live demos and discovery calls independently
  • Self-directed, high-ownership mindset, comfortable being the only salesperson reporting directly to a founder
  • Strong CRM discipline, with the ability to follow a documented sales SOP consistently without being reminded
  • Reliable availability during US business hours with strong outbound phone skills

Nice to Have

  • Spanish language skills for communicating with Spanish-speaking clients
  • Experience selling to SMB, field service, or trade service businesses
  • Prior experience as an early or first sales hire at a startup
  • Familiarity with CRM tools such as HubSpot or GoHighLevel

Work Schedule

  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This position operates on a full-time basis, with dedicated hours to ensure alignment with the team and delivery of quality work
  • Availability during US business hours

Compensation & Time Off

  • Compensation paid in USD
  • Paid bi-monthly on the 15th and 30th
  • Additional financial incentives for professional services closings
  • Paid Time Off according to company policy
  • Holidays observed according to company guidelines

Application Requirements

Please submit:

  • An updated resume
  • A 1–2 minute Loom video introducing yourself, describing your full-cycle B2B sales experience, and walking through a deal you owned from first contact through close, including how you ran discovery and handled objections

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

Are you energized by leading B2B sales teams and turning customer needs into new business growth?

About our Team

Elsevier is a global information analytics company advancing science and health. For more than 140 years, our content and technology have helped researchers, educators, and healthcare professionals make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Elsevier is part of RELX, a global provider of information-based analytics and decision tools.

Elsevier Healthcare Education combines evidence-based content with digital learning, assessment, and enterprise platforms. Our Medical Education portfolio supports MD, DO, and PA programs through Osmosis, Clinical Key Student, Complete Anatomy, Clinical Cases, test preparation, and other learning resources.


About the Role

The National Sales Manager, Medical Education drives new business growth and market expansion across North American MD, DO, and PA programs. This leader develops strategies to acquire institutional customers and expand Elsevier’s footprint through upselling and cross-selling.

The manager leads and develops a high-performing B2B sales team, setting clear expectations for pipeline development, forecasting, execution, and quota achievement. The role partners with Academic Success Managers (ASMs) and cross-functional teams to turn customer needs and market opportunities into sustainable growth.

raw.description:
¿Qué es?

Es un profesional especializado en el diseño, desarrollo y liberación de arneses eléctricos (conjuntos de cables, conectores y componentes) para sistemas de bajo voltaje (LV) y alto voltaje (HV) en aplicaciones industriales, especialmente en la industria automotriz. Su trabajo garantiza que los sistemas eléctricos sean seguros, eficientes y compatibles con los requisitos de manufactura y calidad.

¿Cómo lo hace?

Utiliza herramientas como Siemens Capital Essentials y CATIA para crear dibujos de manufactura 2D, listas de cables, definiciones de conectores y librerías de componentes.

Colabora con proveedores, fabricantes de contratos (CM) y equipos multifuncionales para asegurar que los diseños cumplan con estándares como IPC/WHMA-A-620, ISO 26262 y USCAR-21/USCAR-2.

Resuelve problemas técnicos durante la instalación, debugging y validación de arneses, asegurando que los sistemas funcionen correctamente en entornos reales.

Participa en procesos de APQP, PPAP y gestión de ECRs para garantizar la calidad y trazabilidad de los diseños.

¿Por qué es importante?

El trabajo del Ingeniero de Arneses Eléctricos es crítico para la electrificación de vehículos y sistemas industriales, ya que:

Asegura la integración técnica entre componentes eléctricos y mecánicos.

Minimiza riesgos de fallos eléctricos en producción masiva.

Optimiza la manufacturabilidad y reduce costos en proyectos de alta complejidad.

Es clave en industrias como automotriz, aeroespacial, energía y robótica, donde la confiabilidad de los sistemas eléctricos es esencial.

Requirements

Experiencia: Mínimo 5 años en diseño de arneses eléctricos (LV/HV), creación de dibujos de manufactura 2D, listas de cables, definiciones de conectores y librerías de componentes en Siemens Capital Essentials.

Herramientas: Dominio de CATIA V5/V6 (rutado 3D) y Siemens Capital Essentials (dibujos 2D, librerías de componentes, símbolos).

Conocimientos técnicos:

Interpretación de esquemas eléctricos lógicos y físicos.

Protocolos de comunicación CAN, LIN, SAE J1939.

Restricciones físicas: protección térmica, durabilidad a vibración, selección de materiales (plásticos, calibres de cobre).

Rutado de cables en interfaces dinámicas (cadenas portacables, radios de curvatura, alivio de tensión, separación LV/HV).

Procesos de calidad: APQP, PPAP, ECRs.

Gestión: Seguimiento de BOM, manejo de proveedores y experiencia en industrialización.

About this Position

The Associate Systems Engineer (ASE) is responsible for supporting client environments and end users while also assisting with implementation projects. The ASE configures the equipment and software to meet client business needs and documents the solution for ongoing support. This position will provide first level technical support and main level ticket tracking in an efficient and effective manner.

The primary role focus is to decrease time to resolution and increase revenue by acting as a project resource and the initial technical resource for service tickets.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

  • College degree from an accredited four-year institution or relevant technical experience.

Customer Requirements

This job may require access to customer information, systems, and/or premises. As a result, this job may require customer approval for such access as an essential job function.

Core Values

It’s More Than a Career, It’s a Mission.

Our people are the foundation of our success. By joining our growing team at Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI), a subsidiary of McKesson, you will have the opportunity to become part of one of the largest community-based cancer programs to advance oncology treatments and improve outcomes for cancer patients across the globe. We look for mission-driven candidates who have a desire to advance the fight against cancer and make a difference in the lives of patients diagnosed with cancer every day.

Our Mission

People who live with cancer – those who work to prevent it, fight it, and survive it – are at the heart of every decision we make. Bringing the most innovative medical minds together with the most passionate caregivers in their communities, we are transforming care and personalizing treatment. Through clinical excellence and cutting-edge research, SCRI is redefining cancer care around the world.


Job Description

Our Reconciliation Specialist is responsible for the reconciliation of client receivables in accordance with contractual agreements. Includes review of all Clinical Trial revenues and expenses, as well as interaction with various departments in order to determine the validity of charges and payments received from sponsors.


This is a remote position based in the US; relocation assistance and visa sponsorship are not available.


Duties include and are not limited to:

  • Reconcile in detail clinical trial receivables to ensure final billing to pharmaceutical companies is accurate and timely
  • Reconcile Sarah Cannon financial study data across multiple sources.
  • Review and interpret contracts and budgets
  • Work with operations and other departments to resolve variances
  • Respond to requests for information from Corporate, Internal Audit, Operations and Management
  • Perform Analysis of contracted revenue triggers to determine eligibility for reimbursement.
  • Ensure that all processing and reporting deadlines are consistently achieved.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications include:

  • Bachelor's Degree required
  • 1-2 years' work experience in Accounting or Finance in a medical, clinical trial research or healthcare-related environment
  • Experience with Microsoft products including above average use of Excel and financial accounting systems such as Quickbooks.
  • Knowledge of research techniques to analyze and evaluate financial data and information.

About Sarah Cannon Research Institute

Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI) is one of the world’s leading oncology research organizations conducting community-based clinical trials. Focused on advancing therapies for patients over the last three decades, SCRI is a leader in drug development. In 2022, SCRI formed a joint venture with former US Oncology Research to expand clinical trial access across the country. It has conducted more than 850 first-in-human clinical trials since its inception and contributed to pivotal research that has led to the majority of new cancer therapies approved by the FDA in the past decade. SCRI’s research network brings together more than 1,300 physicians who are enrolling patients into clinical trials at more than 200 locations in 20+ states across the U.S. Please click here to learn more about our research offerings.

We care about the well-being of the patients and communities we serve, and that starts with caring for our people. That’s why we have a Total Rewards package that includes comprehensive benefits to support physical, mental, and financial well-being. Our Total Rewards offerings serve the different needs of our diverse colleague population and ensure they are the healthiest versions of themselves. For more information regarding benefits through our parent company, McKesson, please click here.

As part of Total Rewards, we are proud to offer a competitive compensation package. This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets. In addition to base pay, other compensation, such as an annual bonus or long-term incentive opportunities may be offered.

In light of these scams, please bear the following in mind:

Senior Defined Contribution Retirement Plan Administrator -Large Plans(Remote)

About Prime Pensions

Prime Pensions, Inc. is a nationally recognized actuarial, consulting, and retirement plan administration firm serving employers across the United States since 1975. We specialize in 401(k), profit sharing, cash balance, and defined benefit retirement plans, delivering customized solutions backed by exceptional service, technical expertise, and attention to detail.

Prime Pensions has been recognized as one of the nation's leading defined contribution plan administrators and has been named a Best Place to Work in New Jersey by NJBIZ.

This position is fully remote and will support our Prime Pensions Northwest (PPNW) office.

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Defined Contribution Retirement Plan Administrator to join our Large Plan Services Team. This role provides consulting and administration services to large 401(k) and profit sharing plan clients with complex plan design, recordkeeping, compliance testing, and demographic data needs.

The consultant coordinates with plan sponsors and their service providers on ongoing administration, plan design, regulatory matters, and issue resolution while maintaining high standards of accuracy, communication, quality control, and client service.

Key Responsibilities

    Plan Consulting and Administration

    • Serve as a senior consultant and administrator for large 401(k), profit sharing, and other defined contribution plan clients.
    • Address complex plan design, recordkeeping, compliance testing, and participant demographic data requirements.
    • Advise on single-employer and multiple-employer plan administration, regulatory requirements, and evolving industry practices.
    • Research and resolve complex administrative and regulatory issues, escalating matters as appropriate.

    Compliance and Regulatory Support

    • Perform and review required compliance testing and recommend remedial measures when results are unfavorable.
    • Analyze controlled group matters and their effect on plan administration and compliance.
    • Support plan changes arising from mergers and acquisitions, including implementation and coordination requirements.
    • Coordinate applicable regulatory filings and maintain accurate supporting records.

    Recordkeeping, Data, and Quality Management

    • Work with defined contribution plan recordkeeping systems and supporting administration software.
    • Collect, analyze, reconcile, and validate payroll, human resources, census, and related client data from decentralized systems.
    • Track assigned work in designated Company systems, meet established deadlines, and review deliverables for completeness and accuracy.
    • Apply strong mathematical, research, problem-solving, and quality-control skills to complex client matters.

    Client and Service Provider Coordination

    • Coordinate with plan sponsor contacts and client service providers at all levels regarding ongoing administration, plan design, and regulatory matters.
    • Collaborate with auditors, financial advisors, plan counsel, senior management, and other stakeholders.
    • Communicate technical information clearly and provide responsive, professional client service.

Required Qualifications

    • 8 or more years of defined contribution plan industry experience.
    • Extensive experience supporting large 401(k) and profit sharing plans with complex design, recordkeeping, compliance testing, and demographic data requirements.
    • Strong knowledge of regulatory, compliance, recordkeeping, administrative, filing, and communication requirements for single-employer and multiple-employer defined contribution plans.
    • At least two years of experience working effectively from a remote, non-office-specific location.
    • Experience coordinating with plan sponsors, auditors, financial advisors, plan counsel, senior management, and other service providers.

Preferred Qualifications

    • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, or a related field.
    • Relevant ASPPA or IRS-recognized credential, such as QKA, QPA, CPC, ERPA, EA, or CPA.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work environment
  • Competitive compensation of $90,000 - $115,000 annually based on experience and qualifications
  • Professional development and continuing education support
  • Collaborative team culture with strong technical support and peer review
  • Opportunity to work with a respected, established leader in the retirement plan industry
  • Company-sponsored benefits available to eligible full-time employees, including: Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Health Savings Account (HSA), subject to eligibility.
  • Life insurance.
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer contributions.
  • Paid time off.
  • Professional development opportunities.
  • All benefits are subject to applicable plan terms, eligibility requirements, and Company policies.

Why Prime Pensions?

At Prime Pensions, quality matters. Our reputation has been built on accuracy, responsiveness, and personalized service. We foster a collaborative environment where team members support one another, share expertise, and take pride in delivering exceptional results for our clients.

If you are an experienced retirement plan professional seeking a long-term opportunity with a respected firm and a strong remote culture, we encourage you to apply.

Position Type: Full-Time

Work Location: Remote
