Shape how trusted clinical content evolves for the next generation of AI-enabled clinical decision support.

At Wolters Kluwer Health, the UpToDate suite is grounded in rigorous, evidence-based clinical knowledge. As AI changes how clinicians search, interpret, and apply that knowledge, our content strategy mustevolveso contentremainsauthoritative, traceable, structured, and ready for responsible AI-powered experiences.

As Director, Product Management, Content Strategy & AI Readiness, you will be a senior individualcontributorproduct leader responsible for defining product strategy related to content standards, structure, metadata, feedback loops, and AI readiness. You will partneracrossProduct, Editorial, Clinical, Editorial Operations, Engineering, AI, and Analytics to translate content needs into clear priorities, platform requirements, and measurable outcomes. This role helps ensure clinician editors and contributors have workflows and capabilities that allow them to focus on high-value work: clinical insight, evidence synthesis, content creation, and expert curation.

What You'll Do

  • Define the content product strategyrequiredto support responsible AI-enabled clinical decision support experiences.

  • Establish roadmap priorities for improving content readiness for search, retrieval, answer generation, source grounding, and user workflows.

  • Translate content standards, quality expectations, editorial needs, and AI-readiness requirements into scalable product priorities and platform requirements.

  • Lead the evolution of content rubrics and standards in partnership with clinical, editorial, product, and AI teams.

  • Build feedback loops thatidentifycontent gaps, quality issues, user pain points, and opportunities to improve content usefulness.

  • Define requirements for content structure, tagging, taxonomy, metadata, source traceability, and authoring workflows.

  • Partner with Editorial Operations, editorial platform, and engineering teams toidentifyworkflow and tooling needs that make structured content creation, curation, review, and maintenance easier and more scalable.

  • Drive alignment across product, editorial, clinical, engineering, AI, commercial, and leadership stakeholders.

  • Communicate content strategy, priorities, tradeoffs, and impact clearly to senior and executive stakeholders.

What You'll Bring

  • 10+ years of experience in product management, content product, platform product, editorial strategy, knowledge management, taxonomy, healthcare content, or related areas.

  • Demonstrated ability to set product strategy, influence executive stakeholders, and lead complex cross-functional initiatives as an individual contributor.

  • Strong understanding of content quality, editorial workflows, structured content, metadata, taxonomy, or knowledge systems.

  • Ability to translate complex content and platform needs into product requirements, prioritization frameworks, and measurable outcomes.

  • Strong analytical skills and ability to define metrics, feedback loops, and decision frameworks.

  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills across product, editorial, clinical, technical, commercial, and executive audiences.

Preferred Background

  • Experience with healthcare, clinical, regulatory, orprofessional-informationcontent.

  • Experience with AI-enabled search, question answering, retrieval, content platforms, editorial tooling, or knowledge graphs.

  • Familiarity with responsible AI, source grounding, content evaluation, or human-in-the-loop review workflows.

What Success Looks Like

  • Content strategy is clearly connected to product quality, clinician trust, customer value, and responsible AI.

  • Cross-functional teams are aligned on the content capabilities and workflow improvements needed to support AI-ready clinical knowledge.

  • Content standards and rubrics become clearer, more measurable, and easier to operationalize.

  • Content is increasingly structured andmaintainedin ways that improve AI-enabled product experiences.

  • Clinician editors and contributors have clearer workflows and enabling capabilities that help them focus on expert judgment, evidence synthesis, content quality, and clinical insight.

Hybrid

Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with Brisbane business hours (approx. 9 AM - 5 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration, but as a contractor, you’ll have flexibility in how you manage your time.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: A training organisation delivering nationally recognised hospitality training across Brisbane and the Gold Coast. The business is focused on improving student outcomes and modernizing its internal processes through AI, with a growing focus on streamlining compliance documentation, assessment mapping, policies, and training strategies.

Role Overview: You will be our first dedicated AI developer and the technical owner of a five-tool suite in addition to other tools as they evolve to streamline and support the management of the training organisation. Each tool takes national training package data, combines it with our own context and materials, and produces audit-ready drafts that our team reviews and finalizes.

This is a hands-on build role with real ownership. You will shape the architecture, choose the right models and services, write the code, test accuracy against human experts, and deliver polished tools our non-technical staff use every day

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the technical design, build, testing and release of all five tools
  • Engineer prompts, retrieval pipelines and structured outputs that keep every claim grounded in source documents
  • Build evaluation sets with our compliance team, and measure accuracy against human reviewers
  • Create high-quality document exports using proper Word styles, templates and branding
  • Manage hosting, security, data handling and costs, with clear reporting on usage and spend
  • Translate VET and compliance requirements into practical features, asking sharp questions along the way
  • Document everything clearly so the suite stays maintainable and fully owned by 1 Education
  • Spot new automation opportunities across the business and bring ideas to the table

What You Will Build

Tool 1

Assessment Tool Mapper (TOP PRIORITY)

Validates an assessment tool against every requirement of the units in a cluster, with evidence and reasoning for each decision.

  • Ingest assessment tools (Word, PDF) and pull unit requirements from training.gov.au, recording the release version used
  • Rate every performance criterion, performance evidence, knowledge evidence, foundation skill and assessment condition as Fully, Partially or Not Covered
  • Cite the exact evidence location (document, section, question, page) with a short quote, plus a rationale and suggested fix for each gap
  • Track required volumes such as "on at least 3 occasions" and route context-dependent items to a human reviewer
  • Produce a colour-coded validation report (Word, PDF, optional Excel matrix) with executive summary, gap list, cross-unit matrix and reviewer sign-off
  • Target 85%+ agreement with experienced human validators, with every rating linked to real document text

Tool 2

Assessment Tool Generator

Generates a complete, compliant assessment pack for one or more units, ready for a qualified assessor to review.

  • Knowledge questions across multiple formats, each with a model answer, acceptable response range and satisfactory benchmark
  • Observation checklists linked to performance criteria and evidence, with assessor instructions, resources and S / NYS outcomes
  • Full pack structure: cover sheet, student and assessor instructions, reasonable adjustment guidance, marking guide, results summary and appeals note
  • Context settings for industry, job role, workplace type and learner level, with single-question regeneration and version history
  • Mapping matrix showing 100% coverage, with output that passes the Tool 1 validator with every item covered

Tool 3

Training and Assessment Strategy (TAS) Generator

Turns a guided questionnaire into a detailed, audit-ready TAS written to the Standards for RTOs 2025.

  • Pull qualification packaging rules, core and elective units, AQF level and nominal hours, and check elective choices against packaging rules
  • Design a branching, save-as-you-go questionnaire with help text and examples that an RTO representative completes unaided
  • Generate a tailored TAS with delivery schedule, amount of training rationale, assessment strategy, RPL, learner support and validation
  • Map content to the 2025 Outcome Standards, holding the Standards as editable reference data with a recorded version
  • Export a clean Word document with styles, clickable contents, well-behaved tables and versioned headers and footers

Tool 4

Learner Guide Generator

Creates contextualized learning resources in print, slide and online formats, aligned to the matching assessment tool.

  • Cover every element, performance criterion, knowledge evidence item and foundation skill, tailored to industry and job role
  • Read the assessment tool and produce an alignment matrix linking unit requirement, learning content and assessment item
  • Output a print-ready and screen-friendly Word Learning Guide, a PowerPoint deck per unit with speaker notes, and SCORM 1.2 / 2004 packages
  • Interactive knowledge checks and completion tracking in SCORM, accessible to WCAG 2.1 AA and tested on a live platform
  • Cite legislation and codes of practice for reviewer verification, with section-level regeneration and version history

Tool 5

Procedure and Policy Generator

Produces a consistent suite of RTO policies, procedures and forms mapped to every clause of the 2025 Standards and Queensland SAS requirements.

  • Capture the RTO profile and real operating practice through guided questions, so documents reflect how the business actually runs
  • Generate policies, step-by-step procedures (roles, timeframes, decision points, records) and every linked form and template
  • Apply one master template for identical styles, numbering, version control and terminology across the suite
  • Build a master compliance matrix by clause and by document, with gap flagging, plus an Excel document register
  • Flow edits through related documents, forms and the matrix, with change logs and approval sign-off

Shared Platform Foundations
All five tools share a common core. Building this well once is where your senior judgement makes the biggest difference.

  • Training package data. Reliable retrieval from training.gov.au web services and data feeds, with release-version tracking and manual unit upload as an override.
  • Reference data. The 2025 Standards and SAS requirements held as versioned, editable data, so updates flow through without a rebuild.
  • Accuracy and hallucination control. Evidence-linked outputs, structured generation, evaluation sets and repeatable results, so the same inputs give consistent outputs.
  • Human in the loop. Every output treated as a draft, with clear flags for items needing human input and easy reviewer edits before finalizing.
  • Document generation. Professionally styled Word, Excel, PDF, PowerPoint and SCORM outputs with RTO branding.
  • Privacy and security. Australian hosting where possible, transparent data handling and model providers configured so RTO content stays out of model training.
  • Ease of use. A clean, simple web interface built for non-technical trainers and compliance staff.
  • Ownership and handover. Full documentation, with 1 Education owning all code, prompts, templates and accounts.


Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of software development experience, including 2+ years building production applications on large language models
  • Strong Python and/or TypeScript, with experience building full-stack web applications
  • Hands-on work with LLM APIs (Claude, OpenAI or similar), retrieval-augmented generation, structured outputs and document parsing
  • A proven approach to accuracy and hallucination control, including evaluation and regression testing
  • Experience generating well-formatted Word, Excel and PDF files programmatically (e.g. python-docx, docx, openpyxl)
  • Cloud deployment experience (AWS, Azure or GCP), with sound security and data privacy practices
  • A portfolio of AI document-analysis, document-generation or compliance tools you have built and shipped
  • Excellent written and spoken English, and confidence explaining technical choices to a non-technical owner

Highly Regarded

  • Experience in Australian VET, education or another regulated, compliance-heavy sector
  • Working knowledge of training.gov.au, units of competency or the Standards for RTOs
  • SCORM 1.2 / 2004 packaging and LMS testing experience
  • PowerPoint generation (e.g. python-pptx) and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility
  • UX design skills for guided questionnaires and wizard-style interfaces
  • Agentic AI workflows and tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or similar AI-assisted development


How We Will Measure Success

  • Tool 1 ratings agree with an experienced human validator on 85%+ of items, with every rating citing real document text
  • Generated assessment packs map 100% of unit requirements and pass the Tool 1 validator in full
  • TAS, learner guides and policy suites are judged audit-ready by a compliance consultant with only light editing
  • Word, Excel and PowerPoint exports open and edit cleanly, with styles, contents and tables intact
  • SCORM packages import and track completion on the test platform
  • Our team uses the tools independently, turning hours of work into minutes


Why You Will Love This Role

  • Greenfield ownership of a meaningful AI product suite, from architecture to release
  • Direct access to the business owner and quick decisions
  • Clear, well-scoped briefs for every tool, with room to shape the solution
  • Work that helps students build real careers in hospitality
  • A long-term pipeline of work, with more AI projects ready once this suite is live


Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

raw.description:
POSITION OVERVIEW

MCI is looking for Manitoba work at home customer service, help desk, technical support, and sales representatives to support April demand. In these roles, you will handle inbound customer inquiries, or troubleshoot basic technical issues, and assist customers in adding or removing products and services.

All it takes to get started is for you to complete an easy online application and an informal interview with a talent acquisition specialist. If you do not have your equipment, MCI will provide it. You will need a home broadband connection.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES

WHAT DOES A WORK AT HOME CONTACT CENTER REPRESENTATIVE DO?

This position supports customer service, technical support, and customer sales interactions. This role requires you to interact with hundreds of customers each week across the country to resolve support issues, sell new products and services, and ensure best in class customer experience. In addition to being the best in the business when it comes to customer interactions, you will need to be confident, fully engaged, a team player, and dedicated to bringing a positive and enthusiastic outlook to work each day.

Our entry-level Contact Center Representatives are responsible for the following tasks:

  • Listen to customers, understand their needs, and resolve customer issues
  • Utilize systems and technology to complete account management tasks
  • Recognize sales opportunity and apply sales skills to upgrade
  • Explain and position the products and processes with customers
  • Appropriately escalate customer dissatisfaction with managerial team
  • Ensure first call resolution through problems solving and effective call handling

CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS

WONDER IF YOU ARE A GOOD FIT?

MCI provides all new employees with world-class training, so all positive, driven, and confident applicants are encouraged to apply. Ideal candidates for this position are highly motivated, energetic, and dedicated.

Qualifications

  • Must be 18 years of age or older
  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Excellent organizational, written, and oral communication skills
  • The ability to type swiftly and accurately (20+ words a minute)
  • Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook)
  • Basic understanding of Windows operating system
  • Highly reliable with the ability to maintain regular attendance and punctuality
  • The ability to evaluate, troubleshoot, and follow-up on customer issues
  • An aptitude for conflict resolution, problem solving and negotiation
  • Must be customer service oriented (empathetic, responsive, patient, and conscientious)
  • Ability to multi-task, stay focused and self-manage
  • Strong team orientation and customer focus
  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment where change and ambiguity prevalent
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to build relationships with your team and customers

COMPENSATION DETAILS

WANT AN EMPLOYER THAT VALUES YOUR CONTRIBUTION?

At MCI, we believe that your hard work deserves recognition and reward. Our compensation and benefits packages are designed to be competitive and to grow with you over time. Starting compensation is based on experience, and we offer a variety of benefits and incentives to support and reward our team members.

What You Can Expect from MCI:

We understand the importance of balance and support, which is why we offer a variety of benefits and incentives that go beyond a paycheck. Our team members enjoy:

  • Paid Time Off: Earn PTO and paid holidays to take the time you need.
  • Health Benefits: Full-time employees are eligible for supplemental health coverage through Blue Cross.
  • Life Insurance: Access life insurance options to safeguard your loved ones.
  • Supplemental Insurance: Accident and critical illness insurance
  • Career Growth: With a focus on internal promotions, employees enjoy significant advancement opportunities.
  • Paid Training: Learn new skills while earning a paycheck.
  • Fun, Engaging Work Environment: Enjoy a team-oriented culture that fosters collaboration and engagement.
  • Casual Dress Code: Be comfortable while you work.

Compensation & Benefits that Fit Your Life

MCI takes pride in tailoring our offerings to fit the needs of our diverse team across subsidiaries and locations. While specific benefits and incentives may vary by geography, the core of our commitment remains the same: rewarding effort, providing growth opportunities, and creating an environment where every employee feels valued.

If you’re ready to join a company that recognizes your contributions and supports your growth, MCI is the place for you. Apply today!

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

This job operates in a professional office environment. While performing the duties of this job, the employee will be largely sedentary and will be required to sit/stand for long periods while using a computer and telephone headset. The employee will be regularly required to operate a computer and other office equipment, including a phone, copier, and printer. The employee may occasionally be required to move about the office to accomplish tasks; reach in any direction; raise or lower objects, move objects from place to place, hold onto objects, and move or exert force up to forty (40) pounds.

CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT

All MCI Locations

  • Must be authorized to work in the country where the job is based.

Subject to the program and location of the position

  • Must be willing to submit up to a LEVEL II background and/or security investigation with a fingerprint. Job offers are contingent on background/security investigation results.
  • Must be willing to submit to drug screening. Job offers are contingent on drug screening results. (Does not apply in Canada)

REASONABLE ACCOMMODATION

Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), it is the policy of MCI and its affiliates to provide reasonable accommodations when requested by a qualified applicant or employee with a disability unless such accommodations would cause undue hardship. The policy regarding requests for reasonable accommodation applies to all aspects of employment. If reasonable accommodations are needed, please contact Human Resources.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

At MCI and its subsidiaries, we embrace differences and believe diversity is a benefit to our employees, our company, our customers, and our community. All aspects of employment at MCI are based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. MCI maintains a work environment free from discrimination, one where employees are treated with dignity and respect. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling MCI's commitment to a diverse and equal opportunity work environment.

MCI does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances. MCI will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements.

MCI will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. We adhere to these principles in all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, promotion, benefits, social and recreational programs, and discipline. In addition, it is the policy of MCI to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where an employee works.

ABOUT US

MCI helps customers take on their CX and DX challenges differently, creating industry-leading solutions that deliver exceptional experiences and drive optimal performance. MCI assists companies with business process outsourcing, staff augmentation, contact center customer services, and IT Services needs by providing general and specialized hosting, software, staff, and services.

In 2019, Marlowe Companies Inc. (MCI) was named by Inc. Magazine as Iowa’s Fastest Growing Company in the State of Iowa and was named the 452nd Fastest Growing Privately Company in the USA, making the coveted top 500 for the first time. MCI’s subsidiaries had previously made Inc. Magazine's List of Fastest-Growing Companies 15 times, respectively. MCI has ten business process outsourcing service delivery facilities in Georgia, Florida, Texas, New Mexico, California, Kansas, Nova Scotia, South Africa, and the Philippines.

Driving modernization through digitalization, MCI ensures clients do more for less. MCI is the holding company for a diverse lineup of tech-enabled business services operating companies. MCI organically grows, acquires, and operates companies that have synergistic products and services portfolios, including but not limited to Automated Contact Center Solutions (ACCS), customer contact management, IT Services (IT Schedule 70), and Temporary and Administrative Professional Staffing (TAPS Schedule 736), Business Process Management (BPM), Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), Claims Processing, Collections, Customer Experience Provider (CXP), Customer Service, Digital Experience Provider (DXP), Account Receivables Management (ARM), Application Software Development, Managed Services, and Technology Services, to mid-market, Federal & enterprise partners. MCI now employs 10,000+ talented individuals with 150+ diverse North American client partners across the following MCI brands: MCI BPO, MCI BPOaaS, MarketForce, GravisApps, Gravis Marketing, MarchEast, Mass Markets, MCI Federal Services (MFS), OnBrand24, The Sydney Call Center, Valor Intelligent Processing (VIP), BYC Aqua, EastWest BPO, TeleTechnology, and Vinculum.

DISCLAIMER

The purpose of the above job description is to provide potential candidates with a general overview of the role. It's not an all-inclusive list of the duties, responsibilities, skills, and qualifications required for the job. You may be asked by your supervisors or managers to perform other duties. You will be evaluated in part based upon your performance of the tasks listed in this job description.

The employer has the right to revise this job description at any time. This job description is not a contract for employment, and either you or the employer may terminate employment at any time, for any reason.

raw.description:
Join Grifin and Revolutionize How People Invest

Grifin is a first-of-its-kind investing platform that brings investing into everyday life. Fresh off our Series A fundraise and backed by top-tier investors, we’re scaling rapidly to bring effortless, personalized investing to millions. Our mobile app automatically helps users invest in the companies where they shop - whether they’re grabbing coffee at Starbucks or paying for their Netflix subscription. By making investing simple, human, and fun, Grifin empowers people to build healthy financial habits over time. With customization options and a seamless user experience, we’re on a mission to make investing more accessible to everyone.

Our Users Love Us

Since our public launch in 2021, we've helped hundreds of thousands of people invest using our proprietary Stock Where You Shop™ technology. With over 1 million downloads and thousands of five-star reviews, our app is resonating with users around the country.

Your Opportunity - Build Technology that Improves Lives

As an experienced Full Stack Engineer, you’ll join our lean but fast-growing team and contribute to developing key product features that will one day be used by millions of individuals and families. As an early team member, you’ll have amazing opportunities to help shape the culture of the engineering organization, drive best practices, and explore new ways of solving challenging problems at scale. You’ll work closely with product and design to understand the needs of our customers and represent their voice in how we architect our solutions.

What Excites Us About You

  • You have 5+ years in professional software engineering
  • You have 3+ years building mobile apps, preferably with React Native.
  • You are proficient with MongoDB or similar noSQL databases.
  • You are experienced in ExpressJS for server-side logic.
  • You are familiar with AWS (ECS, EC2, Step Functions, Lambda, SQS).
  • You are skilled in building and securing REST APIs.
  • You are able to integrate APIs into mobile applications.
  • You have a passion for mentoring and uplifting the engineering team.
  • Previous startup success as a founder or very early stage team member. You’ve been a part of a successful acquisition or scaled from a Series A to IPO.
  • You’re a yes person - there is always a way to accomplish the task at hand. You believe everything is solvable.

What Motivates You

  • You love a challenge and you don’t just show up for the wins. You’re in it for the hard parts too.
  • You’re interested in learning new things and can pick them up quickly.
  • You’re a curious, scrappy, highly-motivated innovator excited about working in a fast-paced early-stage startup.
  • You’re an avid team player.
  • You’re gritty and persistent.
  • You question everything and believe that innovation comes from trying new things.
  • You trust your gut, validate with data, and love operating as an owner.

Our Perks and Benefits

  • Equity ownership with the opportunity to grow stake as we scale.
  • Fully remote by design.
  • Company laptop (MacBook Pro).
  • Home office setup allowance.
  • Unlimited PTO.
  • Multiple medical Insurance plans available.
  • Monthly health & wellness allowance.
  • Annual professional development allowance.

Our Commitment

Inclusion is one of our core values. We are fully invested in hiring and growing a diverse team of high performers. We’re committed to creating a positive and connected work environment for all. We believe that uniqueness in ideas, experiences, and backgrounds makes us a better Grifin. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.

To paraphrase Warren Buffett: when hiring, we look for intelligence, initiative, and integrity. But we also seek passionate, mission-driven people who are ready to think big and move fast. If that sounds like you, even if you don’t check every box—we want to hear from you.

Our client is a global aviation software company, and its EMEA team is growing fast. About 20 roles are open right now, mostly in Poland, with more in Sweden and Denmark. They need one person to own everything that happens between a signed offer and a new hire’s first day.

The process already exists. Your job is to run it well, at volume, so every new hire is ready to work on day one.

What you’ll do

  • Prepare employment agreements in Polish and English

  • Start background checks early enough that start dates hold

  • Set up new hires in the HRIS and create employee IDs

  • Work with IT to get laptops and system access ready before day one

  • Work day to day with the client’s HR team

What you’ll need

  • 2+ years in HR administration, onboarding, or HR operations at an international company

  • Fluent written and spoken Polish and English. You’ll draft contracts in both.

  • Hands-on experience with HRIS data entry and employment paperwork

  • Careful, accurate handling of personal data under GDPR

Nice to have

  • Onboarding experience in Sweden or Denmark

  • Workday or SuccessFactors

  • A background in shared services or at an employer of record (EOR)

Good to know

This is a transactional, high-volume role in an established process. It suits someone who likes getting details right every time. It won’t suit someone looking to redesign HR processes.

You’ll be contracted through Chapter 2, a specialist talent consultancy. You’ll have our team behind you, and when this engagement ends, we’ll work with you on your next one.

PLN 8,000–12,000 gross/month (employment contract) or equivalent B2B rate. Final rate depends on experience and contract type.

raw.title: Software Engineer, AI Data - Vilnius, Lithuania
raw.excerpt: MissionThe mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
raw.description:
Mission

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,
leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.

We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.

What You’ll Do:

  • Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.
  • Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.
  • Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.
  • Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have:

  • A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.
  • Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.
  • Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.
  • Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.

What We Offer

  • A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products
  • A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive
  • Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity
  • The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry
  • Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture
  • The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more
  • An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain

The Lithuania Based Salary range for this role is: 30,000-90,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.

Refer them!

  • Manage water, wastewater, and stormwater projects from development of project proposals through completion, providing environmentally friendly and cost-effective solutions
  • Oversee all aspects of project delivery, including scope, budget, schedule, and client relationships
  • Coordinate contracts, purchase orders, and project documentation with clients and subcontractors

  • Advanced proficiency with engineering, computational, and modeling software (Revit, AutoCAD, MicroStation, etc.) as well as Microsoft Office

  • Strong leadership, organization, and multitasking skills
  • Effective verbal and written communication abilities
  • Knowledge of Deltek Vision preferred

raw.excerpt: Medicaid Drug Rebate Supervisor Job DescriptionJoin Conduent and help strengthen Medicaid drug rebate operations.
raw.description:
Medicaid Drug Rebate Supervisor

Job Description

Join Conduent and help strengthen Medicaid drug rebate operations. We are seeking an experienced Medicaid Drug Rebate Supervisor to lead a team of rebate professionals, deliver accurate and timely results, and support high-quality service for our state Medicaid clients. This role is ideal for a collaborative leader who combines deep MDRP knowledge with a commitment to operational excellence, compliance, and continuous improvement.

Position Summary

The Medicaid Drug Rebate Supervisor oversees day-to-day Medicaid Drug Rebate Program (MDRP) operations across Conduent Medicaid accounts. The role is accountable for accurate and timely rebate invoicing, payment processing, reconciliation, dispute resolution, and accounts receivable activities while ensuring compliance with CMS requirements, state contractual obligations, audit standards, and performance commitments.

The Supervisor leads a team of rebate analysts and specialists, serves as a subject matter expert, supports client relationships, and drives process improvements that strengthen quality, service, and financial outcomes.

Work Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time. Occasional evening or weekend work may be required during quarterly invoicing cycles or other critical business periods.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Operational Leadership

  • Supervise and coordinate the daily activities of Medicaid Drug Rebate Analysts and Specialists.

  • Manage workload distribution and resource planning to ensure timely completion of quarterly and ongoing rebate activities.

  • Monitor team productivity, quality, and adherence to established procedures and deliver on client service-level agreements.

  • Provide coaching, mentoring, and professional development to team members.

  • Conduct performance evaluations and support employee growth initiatives.

Rebate Invoicing and Payment Administration

  • Oversee quarterly Medicaid drug rebate invoicing processes.

  • Ensure accurate calculation, validation, freezing, and generation of rebate invoices.

  • Review utilization, NDC, labeler, and rebate data to ensure invoice accuracy.

  • Monitor manufacturer payment receipt, allocation, and reconciliation activities.

  • Ensure accurate application of principal and interest payments at the NDC level.

  • Oversee accounts receivable tracking and collection activities.

Compliance and Audit Management

  • Ensure compliance with CMS Medicaid Drug Rebate Program requirements and state contractual obligations.

  • Develop and maintain analyst standard operating procedures and update project-specific operational guides at least annually.

  • Maintain audit-ready documentation and support federal, state, and internal audits.

  • Review quality assurance reports, exception reports, and reconciliation findings.

  • Implement corrective actions for identified compliance or operational issues.

  • Monitor evolving CMS regulations and communicate impacts to staff and leadership.

Dispute Resolution

  • Oversee manufacturer dispute management and resolution activities.

  • Review supporting documentation for disputed utilization, unit adjustments, and rebate calculations.

  • Coordinate with manufacturers, states, and internal stakeholders to resolve discrepancies.

  • Monitor dispute aging and ensure timely resolution.

Reporting and Analytics

  • Develop and review operational, financial, and performance reports.

  • Track rebate collections, outstanding receivables, invoice accuracy, and team productivity metrics.

  • Identify trends, risks, and opportunities for process improvements.

  • Present operational updates and performance metrics to management and clients.

Client and Stakeholder Support

  • Serve as a primary operational contact for Account Managers, state agencies, and internal leadership.

  • Participate in client meetings and support contract deliverables.

  • Assist with implementation of new programs, enhancements, and regulatory changes.

  • Collaborate with pharmacy, finance, compliance, and technology teams.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Healthcare Administration, Finance, Accounting, Pharmacy, or related field.

  • 5+ years of Medicaid Drug Rebate Operations experience.

  • 2+ years of leadership, supervisory, or team lead experience.

  • Pharmacy Technician certification or equivalent pharmacy operations experience preferred.

  • Knowledge of Medicaid Drug Rebate Program regulations and CMS requirements.

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and data analysis tools.

  • Experience with accounts receivable, reconciliations, and financial reporting.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams and manage multiple priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Medicaid rebate administration systems, MMIS platforms, or rebate processing solutions.

  • Knowledge of pharmacy claims processing, NDCs, URAs, AMP, and rebate calculations.

  • Experience supporting state Medicaid agencies.

  • Lean, Six Sigma, or another operational excellence certification.

Flexible Work

At Conduent, we value flexibility and the individual contributions of our associates. This position is designed for remote work, enabling you to deliver results from a home-based work environment while maintaining effective collaboration with colleagues and clients.

Working for You

  • Health and welfare benefits are designed to support you and your family, with eligibility beginning on your first day.

  • Retirement savings programs to help you plan for your financial future.

  • Employee discounts on merchandise, services, travel, and more.

  • Career Growth Opportunities: We help you thrive, so together, we can grow. We provide opportunities to advance your career with a vast portfolio of businesses and a global footprint.

  • Paid Training: Earn while you learn and continue to grow with access to award-winning learning platforms throughout your Conduent career.

  • Paid time off: We provide attractive paid time off packages designed for you to enjoy your life away from work.

  • Great Work Environment: We are proud of our award-winning culture and the recognition we’ve received for our diversity efforts.

Join Us at Conduent, we are one team, one mission. We understand that our success is directly related to the success of our associates. We strive to create a culture where you can: Bring your authentic self to work Grow and thrive, both personally and professionally Make a difference with our clients, in our communities, and with the millions of people we support When you join Conduent, you are engaged in creating the future - both our company’s and your own. With more than 60,000 associates across 24 countries, we will provide you the opportunity to grow with a team of people who will challenge and inspire you to be the best.

Pay Transparency Laws in some locations require disclosure of compensation and/or benefits-related information. For this position, actual salaries will vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. In addition to base pay, this position, based on business need, may be eligible for a bonus or incentive. In addition, Conduent provides a variety of benefits to employees including health insurance coverage, voluntary dental and vision programs, life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, paid holidays, and paid time off (PTO) or vacation and/or sick time. The estimated salary range for this role is $60-75k.

raw.description:
The Investment Manager Services Division (IMS) at SEI is growing rapidly and is seeking new members on our Private Equity & Hedge Fund Accounting Teams. Our primary goal is to provide exceptional customer service, accounting and administration services to our hedge and private equity fund customers. As a Fund Accounting Manager, you will be responsible for the accounting operations and resolution of accounting issues for clients.


What you will do:

  • As the main contact for clients, we will need you to demonstrate your expertise in the area of offshore and domestic fund accounting and administration for alternative funds.
  • You will manage the delegation of funds to your team, coordinate/onboard new fund set ups, serve as a liaison between clients and internals teams, and work closely with all parties to provide accurate and thorough accounting packages.
  • As the record keepers for the fund, you and your team will be involved in the coordination and support of various year-end audit engagements in accordance with GAAP accounting standards.
  • We will need you to perform due-diligence to ensure clients are in compliance with government laws and regulations.
  • You will be required to adhere to our Anti-Money Laundering policies and procedures when reviewing all fund transactions.
  • As a Fund Accounting Manager, you are responsible for ensuring your team is in compliance with our department’s rules and regulations designed to stop the practice of generating income through illegal actions.
  • You and your team will generate and reconcile all accounting reporting, such as month-end valuation reports.
  • You will review and approve month-end valuations prior to distribution to client with a goal of 100% accuracy. In addition, you will authorize wire payments from fund’s escrow accounts.
  • You will correspond with investment managers and regarding day-to-day inquiries, including questions on transactions associated with the fund(s), administration servicing planning and reporting of funds and financial statements. Client engagement and a dedication to quality service is a must for success.
  • You will connect with investment managers, transfer agents, and sales and service teams to resolve open issues and questions, getting in touch with internal technology support and vendor support when necessary to resolve any production issues or system support queries.
  • You will conduct performance appraisals, monthly one-on-ones with your supervisors and analysts and provide career pathing and training.
  • You will also ensure staffing requirements are met by assessing resource requirements, interviewing candidates and hiring employees.
  • You will provide and champion a team environment to include individual development, promotions and disciplinary action.
  • You will support the new business development and relationship teams for prospect calls, client visits and presentations.
  • You will facilitate the on-boarding of new and converted clients by gathering client requirements, submitting any custom requests and communicating key deliverables to your team members.
  • We want you to succeed and look for future solutions! Through attending and participating in various IMS and corporate professional development sessions, you will acquire the tools to identify processes across the division and organization.
  • You will have the opportunity to partner with a diverse team and grow your career.

What we need from you:

  • BA / BS in Business, Accounting, Finance, Economics, Mathematics or equivalent professional experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience in the fund services industry, alternatives experience required.
  • Minimum of 2 years’ supervisory or management experience.
  • Intermediate skills in Microsoft Excel.

What we would like from you:

  • The self-motivation, organization and drive to complete multiple client deliverables in a timely manner without sacrificing excellence or quality.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills as you will primarily support your clients through email and/or phone calls.
  • Strong customer service skills as you will be communicating daily with your clients and other service providers.
  • A drive to broaden one’s knowledge of the financial services industry by learning new concepts and systems and taking the initiative to apply it to daily work assignments.
  • Attention-to-detail to ensure that all deliverables consistently meet the highest standard of quality and accuracy.
  • Collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.
  • As the needs of our clients change, we need to be flexible to change with them.
  • Positivity and collegial approach in assisting both colleagues and clients and the ability to work in team environment.
  • Curiosity, critical thinking and attention to detail: Whether it’s to identify a solution to a problem or possibly help implement a more efficient process or procedure, your skills have a place in our business.
  • Someone who will embody our SEI Values of courage, integrity, collaboration, inclusion, connection and fun. Please see our website for more information.

The base salary pay for this role is $105,000 - $130,000 per year. This position will also be eligible to earn a discretionary bonus each year, subject to company approval.


Work location: Remote


SEI’s competitive advantage:


To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including comprehensive care for your physical and mental well-being, a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, support for working parents and flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.


Benefits include healthcare (medical, dental, vision, prescription, wellness, EAP, FSA), life and disability insurance (premiums paid for base coverage), 401(k) match, education assistance, commuter benefits, up to 11 paid holidays/year, 21 days PTO/year pro-rated for new hires which increases over time, paid parental leave, back-up childcare arrangements, paid volunteer days, a discounted stock purchase plan, investment options, access to thriving employee networks and more.


We are a technology and asset management company delivering on our promise of building brave futures (SM)—for our clients, our communities, and ourselves. Come build your brave future at SEI.

The position title reflected in this job description is aligned with SEI's current internal job architecture. As part of SEI's role and career framework, internal job titles may not directly correspond to external market titles and may differ from titles previously assigned during an employee's tenure or at the time of hire.

SEI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and so much more…

After over 50 years in business, SEI remains a leading global provider of investment processing, investment management, and investment operations solutions. Reflecting our experience within financial services and financial technology our offices encompass an open floor plan and numerous art installations designed to encourage innovation and creativity in our workforce. We recognize that our people are our most valuable asset and that a healthy, happy, and motivated workforce is key to our continued growth. At SEI, we’re (literally) invested in your success. We offer our employees paid parental leave, back-up childcare arrangements, paid volunteer days, education assistance and access to thriving employee networks.

SEI is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.


AI Acceptable Use in the application and interview process:


SEI acknowledges the growing integration of artificial intelligence (AI) tools into individuals’ personal and professional lives. If you intend to incorporate the use of any AI tools at any stage of the application and/or interview process, please ensure you have reviewed and adhere to our AI use guidelines.

raw.description:
Position Title: Consultant, Microsoft Modern Work Solution

Position Location: Remote in the Contiguous US

Job Summary:

As a Consultant within our Digital Workplace practice, you will deliver Microsoft Modern Work solutions for mergers and acquisitions (M&A), tenant consolidations, and divestitures. This hands-on role covers assessment through post-migration support across identity, Microsoft 365, and Intune-managed endpoints, with a focus on secure access, business continuity, and a smooth user experience.

Essential Functions:

  • Assess Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and endpoint environments to document business requirements, migration scope, dependencies, and readiness gaps.
  • Work with solution architects and technical leads to translate client requirements into Modern Work recommendations and tenant-to-tenant migration, consolidation, and divestiture plans, addressing workload sequencing, identity alignment, coexistence, cross-workload dependencies, and user impact.
  • Configure Microsoft 365 services and execute migrations across Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams using approved migration tools and documented procedures.
  • Support identity transitions, including directory synchronization, domain and UPN changes, and access policies, in coordination with security and endpoint specialists.
  • Implement Microsoft Intune endpoint solutions, including Windows Autopilot provisioning, device join and enrollment, configuration and compliance policies, application deployment, endpoint security, and Windows updates; support cross-tenant device transitions during M&A migrations.
  • Execute pilots, migration waves, and cutover activities; validate data, permissions, mail flow, and user access; troubleshoot issues and support rollback readiness and post-migration stabilization.
  • Maintain migration runbooks, configuration records, and support handoff documentation; communicate status, risks, and dependencies; and assist project managers with milestones, user communications, and delivery coordination.

Required Skills/Abilities/Competencies:

  • Sound judgment, critical thinking, and responsible handling of client data and privileged access.
  • Strong client-facing communication and customer service skills; ability to explain technical issues and user impacts, work independently, and collaborate with architects, project managers, security teams, and client stakeholders.
  • Strong organization and attention to detail in migration inventories, identity mappings, permissions, and validation; ability to manage competing priorities and meet project deadlines and cutover windows.
  • Understanding of M&A migration dependencies, including tenant coexistence, identity and domain transitions, workload sequencing, and business continuity.
  • Working knowledge of Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, hybrid identity, multifactor authentication, and Conditional Access.
  • Hands-on experience delivering the Intune and Windows Autopilot solutions described above, including application packaging and troubleshooting enrollment and policy deployment issues.
  • Hands-on proficiency administering Microsoft 365 workloads, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams, with deeper expertise in one or more areas.
  • Required hands-on proficiency with Quest and AvePoint as the primary migration tools, plus PowerShell for Microsoft 365 administration, reporting, and migration automation. Familiarity with Microsoft Graph; preferred familiarity with ForensIT, BitTitan, ShareGate, and PowerSync Pro as secondary tool options used as project and client needs dictate.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across identity, mail flow, permissions, collaboration access, and endpoint sign-in, with the ability to document findings and escalate risks promptly.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in Microsoft 365 consulting, Modern Work implementation, or enterprise migration delivery, including hands-on participation in tenant-to-tenant or M&A migration projects.
  • Relevant Microsoft certifications aligned to Microsoft 365 administration, identity, endpoint management, or collaboration.

Physical Requirements:

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Employees hired under this position must be able to perform the essential functions of the position satisfactorily and, if requested, reasonable accommodation will be made to enable employees with disabilities to perform the essential functions, absent undue hardship. The Employer retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position at any time with or without notice.

Allsup LLC is a people-centered organization with a team of hundreds who are dedicated to helping people with disabilities lead lives that are as financially secure and healthy as possible. We enjoy working together to make a difference, get the job done, and find solutions for our customers.

You will enjoy a collaborative workplace, with rewarding results where your opinion matters. We have a great benefits package and paid time off program, with casual dress and a comfortable work environment. Many positions have no weekends, or minimal weekend work. You’ll have a predictable work schedule, the potential to work from home, and enjoy an employee-centered work life and have fun.

Even better, you can develop your own knowledge and professional skills through a self-driven personal improvement approach to professional development. Our business takes complex federal programs and makes them easier for people to navigate—including SSDI, veteran’s disability, return to work and Medicare. Drive your expertise and advancement with the support of your supervisor and our organization.

About the role

  • The Accounting Specialist I is responsible for managing assigned beneficiary cases through the full payment readiness cycle within the SSA Ticket to Work program. This role includes proactive case management, beneficiary outreach, documentation validation, and preparation of billing requests in accordance with program requirements. The Specialist I plays a direct role in revenue generation by ensuring cases progress efficiently toward billable milestones.

What you'll do

  • Own and manage assigned caseloads

  • Initiate outbound communication with beneficiaries to obtain required documentation
  • Explain documentation requirements and resolve issues related to missing, incomplete, or illegible paystubs
  • Review and validate wage data processed through extraction tools
  • Complete SSA Form 821 (Work Activity Reports) as required for billing
  • Identify and address documentation gaps that may delay or prevent payment requests
  • Prepare and submit payment requests in accordance with SSA Ticket to Work guidelines
  • Update case statuses based on employment changes (e.g., unemployed, underemployed, TWP, SGA)
  • Coordinate with case owners and internal teams regarding changes impacting billing
  • Maintain accurate documentation of all actions within AES systems
  • Assist with Ticket Assignments and general portal updates as needed
  • Ensure adherence to compliance, confidentiality, and program requirements
  • Performs other job-related duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • High School diploma or GED required, associate’s degree with 6 months general office experience or appropriate Allsup experience preferred.
  • Ability to learn, retain and apply information
  • Ability to multitask effectively in a fast paced environment
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and customer relations skills
  • Must be flexible, adaptive and responsive to change
  • Highly motivated and target driven

Benefits

  • Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • 401(K) Matching
  • Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Life Insurance
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid Holidays
  • Flexible Spending and Health Savings Account
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Pet Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program

DISCLAIMER

Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in the job description are not exhaustive. The company may assign other tasks, duties and responsibilities with no prior notice.

IMPORTANT NOTICE

Offers for employment are contingent on the completion, to our satisfaction, our background check, including but not limited to, employment and education verification, criminal background checks, credit checks, and drug screen. As a federal contractor for the Social Security Administration’s Ticket to Work program, we require all Allsup Employment Services employees and anyone with access to PII for Allsup Employment Services beneficiaries to obtain a federal security clearance. This process includes, but is not limited to, a federal background check and fingerprinting process conducted by the National Background Investigation Services (NBIS).

Significant Autonomy: The freedom to develop and execute your own territory strategy with minimal micro-management.

At RevStar, we build cutting-edge cloud, data, and Generative AI solutions that transform how enterprise organizations operate. As an Advanced AWS Consulting Partner, we don’t just deliver code—we solve complex business problems, modernize legacy infrastructure, and deploy production-grade cloud native and AI applications that drive real business value. Above all, our team operates on three core principles:

  • Self-Mastery: We hold a high bar for how we think, communicate, and improve.
  • Ownership: We own outcomes, not just effort.
  • Shared Destiny: We rise or fall together.

We are seeking a Data & AI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join our Digital Solutions Practice. In this highly visible role, you will operate embedded directly at the intersection of enterprise cloud architecture, hands-on engineering, and client-facing delivery. As an FDE, you are both a master cloud builder and a trusted technical advisor. You will own the full delivery lifecycle for high-impact enterprise accounts—architecting resilient cloud-native environments, modernizing legacy infrastructure, and deploying state-of-the-art AWS Generative AI (Amazon Bedrock, Q, SageMaker) architectures. Simultaneously, you will drive AWS adoption and consumption growth by identifying new workloads, building POCs, and driving strategic technical alignment with client executive leadership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Hands-On Cloud Architecture & Implementation: Design, build, and deploy secure, scalable, and resilient cloud architectures on AWS using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CDK, CloudFormation) and modern microservices/serverless patterns (Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, DynamoDB).
  • Enterprise Customer Delivery: Serve as the primary technical leader on strategic enterprise client engagements. Partner with CIOs, CTOs, VPs of Infrastructure/Engineering, and client development teams to translate complex business goals into high-performing AWS solutions.
  • Cloud Migration & Application Modernization: Lead large-scale migrations from on-premises data centers or legacy platforms to AWS (using AWS Application Migration Service, Database Migration Service, etc.) and re-architect legacy monolithic applications into modern serverless or containerized architectures.
  • AWS Generative AI & Machine Learning: Architect and deploy enterprise GenAI and ML workloads leveraging Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Vector Databases (OpenSearch, Pinecone, pgvector), and custom RAG implementations.
  • Drive Platform Adoption & Growth: Partner with RevStar account leadership to identify new, high-value cloud workloads within client accounts, driving AWS consumption expansion and clear ROI for client executive stakeholders.
  • Technical Mentorship & Practice Building: Coach and mentor Cloud Engineers and Solutions Architects. Drive internal RevStar accelerators, reusable Terraform modules, AWS Well-Architected Review frameworks, and cloud delivery best practices.

Requirements

Qualifications & Requirements

Job Summary:

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience in Cloud Architecture, DevOps/SRE, or Software Engineering with a focus on AWS.
  • 3+ years in a client-facing consulting, Solutions Architecture, or Forward Deployed Engineering role.
  • Deep AWS Core Expertise: Mastery across core AWS services (IAM, VPC, EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, CloudFront, Route 53).
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & CI/CD: Expert-level proficiency in Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation, along with automated CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, AWS CodePipeline).
  • AWS GenAI & Data Services: Practical experience with Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Glue, Redshift, or OpenSearch for building data platforms and AI solutions.
  • AWS Certifications: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional and/or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional required. Specialty certifications (Security, Machine Learning, Data Analytics) are a plus.

Client & Business Acumen:

  • Enterprise Track Record: Proven experience leading technical delivery for Fortune 500 or mid-market enterprise clients (Healthcare, Financial Services, Retail, or SaaS).
  • Consulting & Communication Skills: Outstanding verbal and written communication; adept at whiteboarding complex architectures, building working POCs/demos, and presenting to C-level executives.
  • Growth Mindset: Ability to spot technical expansion opportunities, conduct AWS Well-Architected Reviews, and advocate for cloud modernization to expand account footprint.

Benefits

  • Remote-First Working Environment – Collaborate from anywhere while staying connected with our global team.
  • Collaborative, Innovative Culture – Work alongside top talent in a fast-paced, supportive environment that values curiosity and initiative.

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you are part of something bigger, it is because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we have helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you will help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lie within them, you will thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


Web Strategist, Web Strategy & Operations


WHAT YOU WILL DO

The Amgen Global Content Excellence Team is looking for an experienced Web Strategist to join Global Customer Capabilities & Innovation (GCCI). GCCI delivers efficient and consistent quality global marketing assets that scale across multiple channels & markets. As part of the GCCI, the Web Strategist provides integrated end-to-end program and project management to ensure successful delivery of websites, brings thought leadership and drives delivery.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Web Program Lead: Serve as a subject-matter expert on CMS, Design System, back-end system integrations, pharmaceutical web marketing best practices and emerging trends. Advise brand teams on how to apply current web capabilities to business objectives and audience needs, and identify opportunities to strengthen digital experiences. Translate business goals into strategic recommendations and proactively define future-state capability enhancements and roadmaps, partnering with business, technology, content, design, analytics, and agency teams to assess feasibility, value, and dependencies. Promote enterprise standards and consistent, scalable, compliant experiences.
  • Portfolio Prioritization & Planning: Lead quarterly intake and prioritization of web initiatives with Technology and business stakeholders, aligning investment to enterprise strategy, business value, and resource capacity. Translate prioritized needs into actionable scope, requirements, sequencing, timelines, and delivery plans. Assess cross-project and platform dependencies, clarify ownership, and apply governance to support informed prioritization and delivery.
  • Web Delivery & Release Management: Lead cross-functional web initiatives from approved plans through development, launch, and hypercare. Coordinate creative and content handoffs, development, approvals, QA/UAT, deployment, and production validation. Align timelines, resources, budgets, dependencies, and release requirements; establish launch readiness; facilitate decisions; resolve issues; and communicate status and escalations to support successful, timely delivery.
  • Program Governance, Compliance & Risk Management: Monitor program health, governance adherence, documentation, risks, issues, and change impacts across web initiatives. Coordinate business, content, creative, development, technology, analytics, and agency partners to clarify ownership, manage handoffs, and resolve conflicts across concurrent initiatives, platform migrations, technology releases, and regulatory deadlines. Embed legal, regulatory, privacy, accessibility, brand, and operational resilience requirements throughout delivery, escalating material risks as needed.
  • Performance & Continuous Improvement: Partner with analytics and SEO teams to interpret web traffic, user behavior, search performance, and other digital insights, and use findings to recommend website optimization. Lead structured retrospectives and apply performance insights, lessons learned, and emerging trends to recommend improvements to web capabilities, standards, tools, templates, and delivery processes. Scale effective practices to improve consistency, efficiency, collaboration, and speed to market.

WHAT WE EXPECT OF YOU

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The Web Strategist professional we seek is a collaborator with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

Doctorate degree

OR

Master’s degree and 6 years of digital or web project management experience

Or

Bachelor’s degree and 8 years of digital or web project management experience

Or

Associate’s degree and 14 years of digital or web project management experience

Or

High school diploma / GED and 16 years of digital or web project management experience


Preferred Experience:

  • Digital Program / Project Management Expertise:
    6+ years of experience managing end-to-end digital and website lifecycle projects in fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environments, including complex, cross-country, and high-impact initiatives.
  • Agile & Program Management:
    Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies (preferably SAFe) with experience managing website roadmaps and continuous improvement initiatives. Proficient in Program / Project Management tools such as Workfront, JIRA, ServiceNow, Confluence, and Google Analytics.
  • Stakeholder & Vendor Management:
    Proven ability to negotiate priorities, manage expectations, and build productive relationships across diverse, cross-functional teams and external partners.
  • Regulatory & Technical Acumen:
    Experience operating in regulated industries (preferably pharma) with understanding of compliance requirements. Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG), privacy regulations (GDPR, US consumer laws), web technologies (e.g., HTML/CSS), and industry best practices is a plus.
  • Documentation & Governance:
    Experience developing detailed project documentation and translating business requirements into technical specifications.

Preferred Competencies:

Healthcare Privacy Analyst

Remote

Position Summary

The Healthcare Privacy Analyst supports the organization's Privacy and Compliance programs by coordinating privacy-related activities, managing regulatory documentation, assisting with investigations, supporting audits, maintaining policies and procedures, and serving as a liaison among Compliance, Legal, Human Resources, and operational stakeholders. This role focuses on healthcare privacy, regulatory compliance, and risk mitigation activities. While incumbents may possess legal education or attorney licensure, the position does not engage in the practice of law, provide legal advice, establish attorney-client relationships, or represent the organization in legal proceedings.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Privacy Program Administration

  • Support day-to-day administration of the organization's privacy compliance program.
  • Maintain privacy policies, procedures, forms, and guidance documents.
  • Monitor regulatory updates related to HIPAA, state privacy laws, and healthcare compliance requirements.
  • Assist in implementing privacy program initiatives and corrective action plans.

Privacy Incident Management

  • Coordinate intake, tracking, and documentation of privacy incidents and potential breaches.
  • Assist in gathering facts, documentation, and evidence for privacy investigations.
  • Maintain investigation files and case management records.
  • Support preparation of breach notification documentation and regulatory submissions as directed.

Compliance Monitoring and Auditing

  • Assist with privacy audits, monitoring activities, and compliance reviews.
  • Compile data, perform documentation reviews, and prepare audit reports.
  • Track findings, recommendations, and remediation activities.
  • Maintain audit schedules and supporting records.

Regulatory and Documentation Support

  • Prepare and maintain compliance logs, reports, and records.
  • Coordinate retention of privacy and compliance documentation.
  • Support responses to regulatory requests and internal inquiries.
  • Assist with contract reviews involving privacy-related provisions under established guidelines.

Training and Communication

  • Coordinate privacy and compliance training activities.
  • Maintain training records and completion metrics.
  • Develop educational materials, job aids, and awareness communications.
  • Support department communications regarding privacy obligations and compliance requirements.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as a resource to business partners regarding privacy processes and documentation requirements.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Human Resources, Information Security, Clinical Operations, and other stakeholders on compliance initiatives.
  • Participate in compliance committees, meetings, and projects as assigned.

Reporting and Analytics

  • Prepare recurring compliance and privacy metrics.
  • Analyze trends related to incidents, audit findings, and training completion.
  • Develop dashboards and presentations for leadership review.
  • Track departmental goals and compliance program effectiveness measures.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Compliance, Legal Studies, Public Administration, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in healthcare compliance, privacy, legal operations, risk management, regulatory affairs, or related field.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and documentation skills.
  • Experience supporting HIPAA Privacy programs.
  • Healthcare industry experience a plus.
  • Certified in Healthcare Compliance (CHC), Certified HIPAA Professional (CHP), Certified Information Privacy Professional (CIPP), or related certification.
  • Juris Doctor (JD) degree or active attorney license preferred; however, legal licensure is not required.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Knowledge of healthcare privacy regulations, including HIPAA.
  • Understanding of regulatory compliance frameworks and audit practices.
  • Ability to interpret policies, regulations, and procedural requirements.
  • Strong project coordination and documentation management skills.

Important Position Disclaimer

This position is a compliance and privacy support role and is not responsible for providing legal advice, rendering legal opinions, appearing in court, representing the organization in legal matters, or otherwise engaging in the practice of law. Any attorney licensure held by an incumbent is incidental to the position and not a requirement for performing the essential functions of the role.

Kentro is hiring for a Developer Lead / Integration Developer to support the VA ESOM contract. This role will lead and coordinate ServiceNow development and integration activities, translate approved business and technical requirements into executable solutions, drive development work through design, build, testing, release.

The ideal candidate is a highly skilled ServiceNow developer and technical lead with strong experience delivering enterprise ServiceNow solutions and integrations. This role requires the ability to provide technical direction to developers while remaining actively engaged in solution design, development, integration, troubleshooting, technical reviews. The candidate should be able to identify technical dependencies, risks, blockers early and work collaboratively across architecture, business analysis, testing, Product Owners, integration teams to support predictable delivery.

The Developer Lead / Integration Developer will support development planning and sequencing, technical decision-making, release readiness, documentation, knowledge transfer while helping ensure solutions are scalable, supportable, aligned with approved SAM requirements.

Development Planning & Release Execution

Operational Collaboration

Technical Leadership & Communication

  • Promote engineering quality, accountability, documentation, knowledge sharing, consistent development practices.

Experience

  • Strong hands-on experience developing, configuring, and supporting solutions on the ServiceNow platform.
  • Demonstrated experience leading or providing technical direction to developers within an enterprise software development environment.
  • Experience designing, developing, troubleshooting, and supporting ServiceNow integrations with enterprise applications, platforms, APIs, data sources.

  • Strong understanding of ServiceNow development lifecycle practices, including solution design, development, testing, defect resolution, deployment, production support.

  • Experience integrating ServiceNow with enterprise discovery, endpoint-management, identity/access-management or other authoritative enterprise data sources.

  • Strong technical leadership and mentoring skills with the ability to guide developers while remaining hands-on with development and integration work.
