raw.description:
Overview:

FinteqHub is expanding the team and is looking for an experienced QA Tech Lead to help strengthen test coverage and develop its testing approach.

About Product:

Finteqhub

А PCI DSS certified payment gateway for online businesses, providing integration with payment systems via a single software platform.
Learn more

Purpose of the role:

FinteqHub is looking for a QA Tech Lead to shape how our engineering teams approach testing and to help them make good testing decisions on their own. You'll be based in the Payment Integrations team. There you'll drive the migration of our API tests from Java to Go and Gonkey, and from there you'll develop QA practice across all teams.

Our stack: Go, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes. Tests are written in Go, Gonkey (YAML), TypeScript and Playwright, with reporting in ReportPortal and mobile testing on BrowserStack.

Key responsibilities:

  • Audit the legacy Java API test suite and decide what to keep, what to retire, and what should move to a lower test level.

  • Oversee the AI-assisted migration of tests to Go and Gonkey, and make sure no critical checks are lost.

  • Close coverage gaps in line with the test pyramid, starting with scenarios where money is at risk.

  • Help every team define and document its own test strategy and pyramid, and review them.

  • Advise team leads and automation engineers on testing decisions, with a clear view of the risk and cost of each option.

  • Own regression: plan the runs, distribute the checks and report status. Keep daily and nightly runs healthy: tackle flaky tests, and make sure every failure has an owner and a deadline.

  • Lead the investigation of cross-team defects: bring the right people together, find where the problem is and get it reproduced.

  • Set shared QA standards and tooling: ReportPortal, TMS, and formats for test cases and bug reports.

  • Bring AI into everyday testing: agents write tests, engineers review them.

  • Run a biweekly QA sync, mentor engineers, and help manual QAs move into automation.

  • Expand UI test automation as the next stage.

Required Experience:

  • Senior or Lead-level experience in test automation, with a strong focus on API testing.

  • You have built a test strategy and test pyramid from scratch, in more than one product.

  • A track record of changing testing practices across several teams.

  • Strong test design skills: you build coverage from requirements and specs, not just automate existing cases.

  • You see the system as a whole and understand the product, not just the framework.

  • You know where a unit test is enough and where e2e is needed.

  • Ability to align teams and drive decisions without formal authority.

  • Mentoring experience.

  • Experience writing tests in several languages and frameworks, and you pick up new tools quickly.

  • You read Java well enough to audit and migrate an existing test suite.

  • Solid understanding of REST/HTTP, JSON and API contract testing.

  • Hands-on experience with k8s, Docker, PostgreSQL and any message broker.

  • Experience with CI pipelines, investigating failures across services through logs, metrics and the DB, and stabilising flaky tests.

  • You use AI in your daily QA work: generating tests from specs, porting tests between languages, analysing failures, reviewing code.

  • You also know where AI gets things wrong.

  • At least Intermediate level of English.

  • Native-level Russian.

Nice to have:

  • Go (a strong plus).

  • Experience with TypeScript and Playwright.

  • Experience migrating a test suite from one stack to another.

  • Experience building AI-based tooling or agents for QA tasks.

  • Mobile testing experience, including BrowserStack.

  • Experience in fintech or payment systems (payment flows, callbacks, idempotency, reconciliation).

  • Experience with API testing tools.

Our Benefits:

  • Full-time remote work opportunities and flexible working hours

  • Private insurance

  • Additional 1 Day Off per calendar year

  • Sports program compensation

  • Comprehensive Mental Health Programme

  • Free online English lessons with a native speaker

  • Generous referral program

  • Training, internal workshops, and participation in international professional conferences and corporate events.

raw.title: Full-Time Portfolio Product Manager
raw.excerpt: OverviewWe are hiring a product manager who can lead people and also do the hands-on product work themselves.
raw.description:
Overview

We are hiring a product manager who can lead people and also do the hands-on product work themselves. You will own quality and direction for new products across a portfolio of companies. About 5 hours per week goes to helping our digital marketing agency with technical needs. The work happens in TypeScript and JavaScript stacks, with AWS and mobile app releases as regular parts of the week. This role fits a highly capable person who is equally comfortable managing a remote team and testing a build on their own phone.

About Us

New products here start on Lovable and similar platforms so we can test them fast. The ones that work get taken over with time, which means moving the code, the infrastructure, and the app store accounts into our own hands. This role is how that handoff happens.

What You Will Do

  1. Make Sure Stakeholders Never Find a Bug. You test all work before it reaches a stakeholder. That means writing test cases from the acceptance criteria, testing on web and on real iOS and Android devices, and signing off on each release only when it holds up.
  2. Product Ownership. You own product management end to end for new features and emerging products, bridging the gap between raw business ideas and technical engineering specs. You write the acceptance criteria, keep each backlog in priority order, and manage App Store and Google Play submissions, review responses, and release schedules for our mobile apps.
  3. Rapid AI Prototyping and Development. You direct our AI-assisted workflows (Lovable, Cursor, and emerging AI agents) to spin up and validate feature prototypes quickly. Then you orchestrate the handoff to full engineering production, including the call on when a product has outgrown its starter platform and needs to move to our own codebase and AWS setup.
  4. Hands-on Architecture and Code Review. You stay close enough to the code to perform technical reviews, diagnose build bottlenecks, and directly program code overrides or refinements when AI generation tools hit their limits.
  5. Team Leadership and Construction. You help hire, structure, and scale our internal development organization. You mentor and train remote development teams, set high technical standards, and lead code reviews so AI-generated output is clean, type-safe, and scalable. You also write job descriptions and screen and interview developers and testers, so work that sits with contractors today can move in-house.
  6. Interview Stakeholders and the Team. You talk regularly with stakeholders to learn what they need and with developers to learn where they are stuck, then turn what you hear into clear backlog items.
  7. Support the Agency (About 5 Hours per Week). You take on the agency's technical needs, including AWS accounts, hosting, access, software costs, and the technical side of client projects.

Tech Stack

  • React, TypeScript, and Node.js, front end and back end
  • Supabase and PostgreSQL for application back ends and databases
  • AWS for hosting and infrastructure
  • Data warehouse storage for reporting and analytics
  • AI-assisted development with Lovable, Cursor, Windsurf, v0, and emerging AI agents, where most new products begin
  • WordPress for marketing sites, hosted on Cloudways
  • iOS and Android app releases through the App Store and Google Play

Requirements

  • Proven Engineering Leadership: 3+ years of experience managing remote software engineering teams, running agile sprint cycles, and actively driving hiring strategies or organization building.
  • Deep Coding Expertise: 7+ years of hands-on full-stack development experience (React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Supabase/PostgreSQL). You have the technical authority to audit other developers' work and enforce structural code quality.
  • AI-Augmented Workflow Competency: Active, practical experience using AI code creation or agentic tools (Lovable, Cursor, Windsurf, v0, or similar platforms) to speed up application prototyping and delivery workflows.
  • Product Mindset: Strong UI/UX awareness, product intuition, and the ability to think like a tech founder. You spot product gaps and propose solutions proactively, without needing detailed design direction.
  • Communication: Exceptional English communication skills, written and verbal, with a proven ability to coordinate effectively with international startup teams and founders.
  • A Tester's Eye: You find bugs other people miss, and you write down how to reproduce them so a developer can fix them fast.
  • Spec and Backlog Skills: You turn a rough product idea into a clear spec and a prioritized backlog.
  • Platform Familiarity: Experience with AWS and with getting a mobile app through App Store and Google Play review.
  • Industry Experience: Experience working on SaaS or marketing technology products.
  • Cross-Platform Mobile: React Native, Capacitor, or another way to ship one codebase to both app stores.
  • Startup Technical Leadership: Experience as a fractional CTO, agency tech lead, or startup technical founder.
  • AI Builder Handoffs: Experience moving a product from an AI app builder into a production codebase.
  • Marketing Technology: Familiarity with analytics, tag management, and CRM integrations.

Nice to Have

  • A deep background in marketing and sales

Hours and Language

Fluent English, spoken and written, is required. You will work a combination of US and overseas hours so you overlap with our US stakeholders and with developers in other time zones.

How We Work

  • You carry out direction without needing a manager to check on you, so your team does not have to micro-manage you.
  • You learn from the first mistake and do not need to be told the same thing twice.
  • If a deadline will slip, you tell the team before the deadline date.
  • You give and receive constructive feedback
  • You talk to people directly instead of about them, and you act with honesty and integrity.
  • You are accountable. You own your results and your commitments from start to finish.
  • You are coachable. You ask for feedback, take it in, and change how you work because of it.

How the Role Grows

You start by taking ownership of quality and backlogs for our newest products, plus about 5 hours per week for the agency. As products mature and move off their starter platforms, you take on more of the product ownership. As we hire, you spend more time setting direction, building the team, and deciding what ships.

Mission

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,
leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.

We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.

What You’ll Do:

  • Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.
  • Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.
  • Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.
  • Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have:

  • A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.
  • Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.
  • Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.
  • Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.

What We Offer

  • A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products
  • A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive

  • The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry
  • Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture

Compensation: The United States base salary range for this full-time position is $140,000-$200,000 + bonus + equity depending on experience

raw.description:
About the Company

Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada’s solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense.

With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI - rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud.

Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You’ll tackle challenges that haven’t been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada’s mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world.

About the Role

Armada is growing quickly, and our benefits program needs to scale with it. As Benefits Manager, you will own the day-to-day operation of Armada's benefits program: enrollments, renewals, broker and carrier management, compliance, and benefits-related employee relations. You will be the person employees come to when they need help with their coverage, and the person the business relies on to keep the program accurate, compliant, and competitive.

You will partner closely with HR Operations, Payroll, Finance, Legal, and Global Mobility to turn complex compliance and operational requirements into a simple, reliable experience for employees.

Location. This role is remote-based on the continental US.

What You'll Do

  • Own benefits administration end to end. Manage the full benefits lifecycle for US employees, including new hire enrollment, qualifying life events, changes, COBRA, and offboarding, resolving issues accurately and on time.
  • Run open enrollment. Coordinate with the broker and carriersand deliver clear employee communications.
  • Manage brokers, carriers, and vendors. Serve as the day-to-day owner of Armada's benefits partners, hold them to service levels, escalate service issues, and support renewal and marketing analysis with recommendations on cost and quality trade-offs.
  • Keep the program compliant. Own the compliance calendar and maintain compliance with US benefits requirements, including ERISA, ACA reporting, COBRA, HIPAA, Section 125, 401k audit, nondisrimination testing, and state-level mandates, escalating novel or evolving risks.
  • Handle benefits-related employee questions. Act as the go-to resource for benefits questions and concerns, handling sensitive situations such as medical leave, family changes, or loss with discretion and empathy.
  • Partner on payroll and budget accuracy. Work with Payroll and HR Operations to make sure deductions, employer contributions, and carrier feeds are accurate and reconciled every pay period. Partner with Finance on benefits invoices, budgeting, and forecasting.
  • Support benefits beyond the US. Partner with our EOR providers to make sure benefits for employees outside the US are compliant with local requirements and consistent with Armada's approach.
  • Build processes that scale. Document and improve benefits processes and policies so they are clear, repeatable, and audit-ready, using automation and AI tools where they add real efficiency.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 90 days: You own benefits administration and the broker relationship. You have audited current plans, carrier feeds, and the compliance calendar, and shared a prioritized list of gaps and fixes.
  • First 6 months: Core benefits processes are documented, a benefits KPI report is in place.
  • First 12 months: You have run a renewal or open enrollment cycle with clean data, on-time communications, and accurate payroll deductions from day one.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of experience in benefits administration or Total Rewards, or a Master's degree and 3+ years of experience
  • Hands-on ownership of open enrollmentfor a US employer, ideally in a high-growth company
  • Working knowledge of US benefits regulations, including ERISA, ACA, COBRA, HIPAA, and Section 125, with sound judgment about when to bring in Legal or outside experts
  • Experience working with brokers, carriers, and vendors and holding them accountable for service quality
  • Proficiency with HRIS and benefits administration platforms, plus strong spreadsheet and reporting skills
  • Clear, empathetic communication with employees and credibility with leadership when explaining trade-offs
  • A team-first, low-ego mindset, comfortable building structure in a fast-moving environment

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to international benefits through EOR providers or local entities
  • CEBS, CBP, or a similar benefits certification
  • Experience supporting a distributed workforce, including field-based or deployed employees
  • Experience in hardware, infrastructure, or defense technology companies

Compensation & Benefits

For U.S. Based candidates: To ensure fairness and transparency, the starting base salary range for this role for candidates in the U.S. are listed, varying based on location experience, skills, and qualifications. In addition to base salary, this role will also be offered equity and subsidized benefits (details available upon request).

We use a geographic pay structure based on cost-of-labor markets.

  • Tier 1 (e.g., SF Bay Area, NYC, Seattle): $109,210 – $136,600
  • Tier 2 (most U.S. metro areas): $94,960 – $118,700
  • Tier 3 (other cities): $90,220 - $112,800

Final compensation will be determined by experience, scope, and level, and may vary from the posted range.

Benefits

  • Competitive base salary and equity
  • Medical, dental, and vision (subsidized cost)
  • Health savings accounts (HSA), flexible spending accounts (FSA), and dependent care FSAs (DCFSA)
  • Retirement plan options, including 401(k) and Roth 401(k)
  • Unlimited paid time off (PTO)
  • 14 paid company holidays per year
Compensation
$94,960—$118,700 USD

You're a Great Fit if You're

  • A go-getter with a growth mindset. You're intellectually curious, have strong business acumen, and actively seek opportunities to build relevant skills and knowledge
  • A detail-oriented problem-solver. You can independently gather information, solve problems efficiently, and deliver results with a "get-it-done" attitude
  • Thrive in a fast-paced environment. You're energized by an entrepreneurial spirit, capable of working quickly, and excited to contribute to a growing company
  • A collaborative team player. You focus on business success and are motivated by team accomplishment vs personal agenda
  • Highly organized and results-driven. Strong prioritization skills and a dedicated work ethic are essential for you

Equal Opportunity Statement

At Armada, we are committed to fostering a work environment where everyone is given equal opportunities to thrive. As an equal opportunity employer, we strictly prohibit discrimination or harassment based on race, color, gender, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy applies to all employment decisions, including hiring, promotions, and compensation. Our hiring is guided by qualifications, merit, and the business needs at the time.

Unsolicited Resumes and Candidates

Armada does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from external agencies or recruiters. All candidates must apply directly through our careers page. Any resumes submitted by agencies without a prior signed agreement will be considered unsolicited and Armada will not be obligated to pay any fees.

raw.description:
Powering the world’s payments ecosystem

ACI powers the payments ecosystem – globally, and you power ACI. You’ll innovate, collaborate, and grow – in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers – in all roles and levels – are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments.

As a Senior Principal Account executive in the UK, you will join a diverse, passionate team, dedicated to powering the world’s payments ecosystem!

This purpose of this Senior Principal Account Executive is:

Own the account strategy, executive engagement model and commercial growth plan across complex, multi-business organisations. Success requires the ability to navigate Tier 1 banking structures, understand how influence and investment decisions move across business units, functions and geographies, and build durable relationships from operational stakeholders through to C-suite sponsors.

This is a pan-solution role covering licensed technology and software-as-a-service offerings. It combines the stewardship of established relationships with a strong new-business mandate: identifying whitespace, shaping relevant propositions, cross-selling into new divisions and use cases, and converting client priorities into sustainable sales and revenue growth. The role champions a 'One Team' mindset, mobilising colleagues across ACI to deliver outcomes that strengthen customer satisfaction, loyalty and long-term partnership value.

A typical day at ACI for a Senior Principal Account Executive is:

  • Own the overall commercial relationship and strategic account plan for a defined portfolio of ACI's largest and most complex UK banking and payments clients, with accountability for retention, growth, customer satisfaction and loyalty.

  • Build deep client intimacy by developing a first-hand understanding of each client's ambitions, pressures, culture and measures of success, and use that insight to make ACI the payments technology provider of choice with direct relevance to the client's strategic agenda.

  • Develop a detailed understanding of each client's organisational structure, strategy, operating model, technology landscape, investment priorities and decision-making processes; maintain current stakeholder maps that show formal authority, informal influence and relationships across divisions, functions and geographies.

  • Navigate complex Tier 1 organisations with confidence, creating access to senior decision-makers while building a broad, resilient network of executive sponsors, business leaders, technology stakeholders, procurement partners and operational teams.

  • Create and execute multi-year account strategies that define client outcomes, growth priorities, competitive positioning, relationship gaps, risks, whitespace opportunities and clear actions for ACI's account team.

  • Build trusted, value-based relationships by leading with the client's business challenges and desired outcomes rather than product specifications; bring relevant market insight, constructive challenge and a clear point of view to senior client conversations.

  • Create the conditions for strategic customers to become proud lighthouse clients for ACI by aligning on shared outcomes, visibly demonstrating value and ensuring that the relationship showcases the best of both organisations.

  • Develop and execute account-level advocacy and referenceability plans, securing appropriate client participation in case studies, peer references, executive forums, industry events and other market-facing activities.

  • Recognise, evidence and celebrate joint success with clients, converting strong delivery and measurable outcomes into greater trust, broader executive sponsorship and new growth opportunities across the organisation.

  • Identify, qualify and progress expansion opportunities across ACI's portfolio, connecting needs across account-to-account payments, card processing, merchant payments, fraud management and related services where relevant to the client.

  • Build and maintain a high-quality, balanced pipeline; provide accurate forecasts, account updates and risk assessments, and maintain disciplined records in ACI's customer relationship management system.

  • Lead the virtual account team across Solution Consulting, Product Management, Client Delivery, Customer Success, Support, Marketing, Finance, Legal and executive leadership, creating clarity of ownership and alignment around the client's priorities.

  • Coordinate executive sponsorship and governance for each strategic account, ensuring that senior engagement is purposeful, well prepared and connected to agreed client and commercial outcomes.

  • Represent the voice of the customer, translating client feedback, market developments and emerging requirements into actionable input for product strategy, service improvement and future growth opportunities.

  • Protect the existing business by anticipating commercial, delivery and relationship risks, coordinating timely resolution, and ensuring that challenges are managed transparently without losing sight of the wider strategic partnership.

  • Lead commercial negotiations for renewals, expansions and new agreements, balancing client value, long-term partnership health, revenue growth and appropriate commercial discipline.

  • Represent ACI externally with credibility at client forums and relevant industry events, strengthening ACI's position as a trusted payments partner.

  • Understand and adhere to all corporate policies to include but not limited to the ACI Code of Business Conduct and Ethics.

Knowledge, Skills and Experience needed to succeed in this role:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in relevant studies with 12+ year relevant experience.
  • Significant executive-level strategic account management or enterprise sales experience in banking, financial services technology, payments or a closely related sector.
  • A sustained record of growing major, complex accounts through relationship expansion, cross-selling, new opportunity creation and successful closure of high-value, multi-stakeholder agreements.
  • Demonstrable experience navigating Tier 1 banks, processors, merchant acquirers or comparable multinational organisations, including matrixed structures, multiple buying centres, formal governance and complex procurement processes.
  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships at multiple levels, including with C-suite and senior executive stakeholders, while maintaining strong engagement with business, technology, operations, risk, procurement and commercial teams.
  • Strong strategic account planning capability, including stakeholder mapping, whitespace analysis, opportunity qualification, competitive strategy, account governance and risk management.
  • Commercial acumen and the ability to translate client strategy, industry change and operational challenges into outcome-led propositions and measurable business value.
  • Working knowledge of the banking and payments market, including relevant technology trends, buyer priorities, regulatory drivers and competitive dynamics.

We're looking for a Student Travel and Member Engagement Specialist to own high-volume outbound member texting for a travel membership company whose members are primarily college students. You will send outbound texts to a large volume of members on a recurring basis, personalizing each message just enough to feel human, fun, and relevant rather than copied and pasted. This role is about speed, accuracy, and quality at scale — not strategy, marketing, or primarily inbound support.

The audience is college-aged. They text casually, they know when something feels scripted, and they respond to people who feel like peers rather than customer service reps. The right person for this role is digitally native, plugged into social media and current culture, and can match the energy and communication style of a college student naturally. If you can text like a friend, bring genuine enthusiasm to the work, and stay sharp and detail-oriented while moving through a high volume of conversations, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Full-time, 100% remote role
  • Preferred overlap with EST hours
  • Paid Time Off and Holiday observance per company policy
  • Clear path to expanded responsibilities including inbound support and broader member success work as trust is built

What You'll Work On

  • Send outbound texts to a large volume of members using approved messaging patterns and base templates
  • Personalize messages so they feel timely, human, and casual rather than copied and pasted
  • Review recent message history before sending so members do not receive repetitive styles or tones
  • Notice details such as recent or upcoming travel, or planning stage, and use them to choose the best message variation
  • Move through a high number of conversations quickly while staying accurate and detail-oriented
  • Read member conversations regularly to build familiarity and judgment over time
  • Follow messaging guidance while making smart small adjustments when needed
  • Escalate unusual, high-stakes, or unclear situations rather than guessing
  • Match the casual, upbeat tone that resonates with a college-aged audience without losing accuracy

What You Bring

  • Excellent written English with a strong feel for natural, casual US texting language — messages must sound like a real person texting a friend, not a scripted support rep
  • Genuinely plugged into current social media, pop culture, and the communication style that resonates with college students
  • Upbeat, fun, and approachable energy that comes through naturally in written communication
  • Ability to move through high volumes of conversations efficiently without becoming careless
  • Comfortable with repetitive communication work at pace without losing quality or tone
  • Strong memory for prior messages and context across conversations
  • Reliable, organized, and consistent, with good judgment on when to ask vs. act
  • Experience in group travel, student travel, campus programs, or similar youth-oriented travel contexts is a strong plus

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience in customer communication, outreach, texting-based support, or inbox management
  • Familiarity with travel, membership, or subscription-based businesses
  • Experience personalizing outreach at scale
  • Active presence on social media platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, or X

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself in your natural, casual communication style, describing your experience with high-volume written communication, and showing us the energy and personality you would bring to texting with a college student audience

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the teamEach stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

raw.description:
Programme Manager - Migration & Integrations

About OrderYOYO

We help takeaways and restaurants succeed online by providing them with personalised branded mobile apps, websites and personalised marketing. We are here to ensure that small to medium-sized restaurants and small chains are not subjected to high commissions, and giving the restaurant the ownership of their success!

We serve restaurants across multiple markets, including the UK, Ireland, DACH, the Netherlands and the Nordics, and acquisitions are one part of how we grow. Each business we acquire brings its own platform, data and restaurant partners, and bringing them onto OrderYOYO safely is how we protect and build on that value.

Purpose of the role

You will lead the technology integration and migration of businesses that join OrderYOYO, from technical due diligence and integration planning through migration, stabilisation and the retirement of legacy platforms.

You will own the integrated programme plan across engineering, product, data and customer-facing teams, protecting restaurant continuity and tracking delivery costs and agreed benefits.

You will coordinate dependencies with Finance, People, Commercial and other functional owners, rather than owning every aspect of corporate integration.

Key responsibilities

Programme leadership

  • Own end-to-end programme plans and a consolidated view of scope, timelines, dependencies, budget forecasts and risks.
  • Lead workstream owners, agree priorities and capacity with functional leads, and run governance, escalating unresolved trade-offs to the CTPO.
  • Embed lessons learned into a repeatable migration and integration approach.

Pre-completion and Day 1

  • Inform due diligence with assessments of migration complexity, product gaps, dependencies, effort, costs and delivery risks.
  • Prepare integration plans before completion and coordinate Day 1 access, environments, tooling and working practices with incoming teams, engineering, IT and security.
  • Coordinate early technical and compliance assessments with specialists and track follow-up actions.

Data and systems

  • Coordinate data migration and integration into our data platform and business systems with data and engineering teams, agreeing mappings, quality checks and reporting requirements.

Customer migration

  • Segment customers by size, value, product usage and complexity; lead platform gap analysis and scope decisions.
  • Recommend migration waves and sequencing based on customer impact, technical readiness and capacity, adapting plans as capabilities mature and lessons emerge.
  • Agree product, data, operational and customer-readiness criteria; coordinate testing and reconciliation of order flows, payments and key integrations, securing accountable-owner sign-off.
  • Coordinate wave runbooks covering preparation, cutover, validation, rollback and support; lead go/no-go recommendations for approval by accountable business and technical owners.
  • Own operational handover, including named support owners, stabilisation exit criteria and business acceptance; plan controlled legacy retirement after migration.

Stakeholders

  • Align engineering, product, customer-facing and finance teams around one plan and timeline, working with customer-facing teams to keep restaurant partners informed and supported.

Commercial outcomes and reporting

  • Partner with Finance to establish and track business cases, covering migration and parallel-running costs, revenue at risk, legacy-retirement savings and forecast cost to complete.
  • Verify realised benefits with business owners and report progress, customer experience and value delivered to the CTPO and leadership team.

Skills and experience required

  • 5+ years of programme management experience in a technology organisation, including at least 3 years leading platform migrations, customer migrations or post-acquisition integrations.
  • Demonstrated ownership of complex, customer-facing platform migrations, including readiness assessment, cutover, post-migration stabilisation and transition into normal operations.
  • Strong technical literacy: comfortable discussing APIs, data pipelines, CRM migrations, cutover plans and infrastructure decommissioning with engineers.
  • Experience segmenting large customer bases into migration waves, with detailed run books, rollback, hypercare and clear go or no-go criteria.
  • Commercial judgement: you can weigh the cost of a feature gap against the revenue at risk and drive a decision.
  • Excellent stakeholder management across engineering, product, commercial and executive audiences, with a proven ability to secure commitments, resolve competing priorities and lead delivery without relying on direct line-management authority.
  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication, including executive-level reporting.
  • Comfortable working across countries, cultures and time zones.

Nice to have

  • Experience in SaaS, restaurant technology, food ordering, payments or marketplaces.
  • Experience with data platform and CRM migrations.
  • Direct post-acquisition integration experience, and running a repeatable migration approach across multiple programmes.
  • A recognised programme management qualification such as MSP, PRINCE2 or PgMP.

What we offer

  • A senior role with direct visibility to the executive team and real influence on how OrderYOYO grows.
  • Ownership of our migration and integration capability from day one, with the autonomy to shape how it works.
  • Room to grow: as the portfolio expands, the opportunity to build this capability into a dedicated function and lead it.
  • Work across nine European markets alongside engineering, product, data and commercial teams.

raw.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

Responsible for screening prior-authorization and coordination of specialized services requests in the medical care management program, including a broad range of requests for inpatient, outpatient and ancillary services. Adheres to policies and procedures in order to comply with performance and compliance standards and to ensure cost effective and appropriate healthcare delivery. Maintains current knowledge of network resources for referral and linkage to member’s and provider’s needs. Authorizes certain specified services, under the supervision of the manager, according to departmental guidelines. Per standard workflows, forwards specified requests to the clinician for review and processing. Answers ACD line calls from providers and other departments and redirects, as needed.


The Prior Authorization Specialist role belongs to the Revenue Cycle Patient Access team and is responsible for coordinating all financial clearance activities by navigating all pre-registration (to include acquiring or validating patient demographic, insurance, and other required elements along with insurance verification activities), obtaining referral authorization, or precertification number(s).


The role ensures timely access to care while maximizing BMC hospital reimbursement. This role requires adherence to quality assurance guidelines as well as established productivity standards to support the work unit’s performance expectations. This position reports to the Patient Access Supervisor and requires interaction and collaboration with important stakeholders in the financial clearance process including but not limited to insurance company representatives, patients, physicians, Boston Medical Center (BMC) practice staff, case management and Patient Financial Counseling. This is a Remote Position.

Position: Prior Authorization Specialist I

Department: Insurance Verification

Schedule: Part Time, Per Diem

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES/DUTIES:

  • Prioritizes incoming Prior Authorization requests.
  • Processes incoming requests, including authorizing specified services, as outlined in departmental policies, procedures, and workflow guidelines.
  • Refers authorization requests that require clinical judgment to Prior Authorization Clinician, Manager, or Medical Director.
  • Meets or exceeds position metrics and Turn-Around Timeframes while maintaining a full caseload.
  • Supports Prior Authorization Clinicians.
  • Answers ACD line calls, verifies member eligibility and enters into CCMS or Facets the information necessary to complete the caller’s request.
  • Identifies and informs callers of network providers, services, and available member benefits.
  • Informs provider of decision per department procedure.
  • Coordinates resolution of escalated member or provider inquiries as related to Prior Authorization.
  • Works with members, providers and key departments to promote an understanding of Prior Authorization requirements and processes.
  • Maintains general understanding of applicable sections of member handbooks, and evidence of coverage.
  • Monitors accounts routed to registration and prior authorization work queues and clears work queues by obtaining all necessary patient and/or payer-specific financial clearance elements in accordance with established management guidelines.
  • Maintains knowledge of and complies with insurance companies’ requirements for obtaining prior authorizations/referrals, and completes other activities to facilitate all aspects of financial clearance.
  • Acts as subject matter experts in navigating both the BMC and payer policies to get the appropriate approvals (authorizations, pre-certs, referrals, for example) for the scheduled care to proceed. The Authorization Specialist is an important part of the larger patient care team and helps clinicians understand what payer requirements are necessary for the widest possible patient access to services.
  • Uses appropriate strategies to underscore the most efficient process to obtaining insurance verification, authorizations and referrals, including on line databases, electronic correspondence, faxes, and phone calls.
  • Obtains and clearly documents all referral/prior authorizations for scheduled services prior to admission within the Epic environment.
  • Works collaboratively with primary care practices, specialty practices, referring physicians, primary care physicians, insurance carriers, patients and any other parties to ensure that required managed care referrals and prior authorizations for specified specialty visits and other services are obtained and appropriately recorded in the relevant practice management systems for patient appointments/visits prior to scheduled patient visits or retro-actively if not in place at the time of the appointment/visit. Ensure that approval numbers are appropriately linked to the relevant patient appointment/visit.
  • Collaborates with patients, providers, and departments to obtain all necessary information and payer permissions prior to patients’ scheduled services.
  • Liaison between physician and payer for peer to peer review when needed
  • Escalates accounts that have been denied or will not be financially cleared as outlined by department policy
  • Interview patients, families or referring physicians via telephone in advance of the patient’s appointment/visit whenever possible, to obtain all necessary information, including but not limited to, financial and demographic information required for reimbursement and compliance for services rendered.
  • Ensure that all updated demographic and insurance information is accurately recorded in the appropriate registration systems for primary, secondary and tertiary insurances.
  • Review all registration and insurance information in systems and reconcile with information available from insurance carriers. For any insurance updates, utilize any available resources to validate the updated insurance information, insurance plan eligibility, primary care physician, subscriber information, employer information and appointment/visit information. Contact patients as necessary if clarifications or other follow-up is required, and at all times maintain sensitivity and a clear customer friendly approach.
  • For self-pay patients or patients with unresolved insurance, and for financial counseling, refer patients Patient Financial Counseling.
  • Maintains confidentiality of patient’s financial and medical records; adheres to the State and Federal laws regulating collection in healthcare; adheres to enterprise and other regulatory confidentiality policies; and advises management of any potential compliance issues immediately.
  • Participates in educational offerings sponsored by BMC or other development opportunities as assigned/available and complies with all applicable organizational workflows, as well as established policies and procedures.
  • Demonstrates knowledge & skills necessary to provide level of customer experience as aligned with BMC management expectations.
  • Demonstrates the ability to recognize situations that require escalation to the Supervisor.
  • Takes opportunity to know and learn other roles and processes and works together to assist with process improvement initiatives as directed.
  • Consistently meets productivity and quality expectations to align performance with assigned roles and responsibilities.
  • Handle ACD telephone calls and emails in a timely fashion, following applicable scripting and customer service standards. Appropriately manage all calls by either working with the customer or referring the call to the appropriate party.
  • Regularly undergo Quality Audits to achieve the required standard.
  • Contact the Help Desk in the BMC Information Technology Department to report faulty systems or hardware. Notify area supervisor or manager if problem is not addressed in a timely manner. For other broken or malfunctioning equipment to be serviced, contact the appropriate vendor or department and notify supervisor.
  • Communicate with all internal and external customers effectively and courteously.
  • Attend all necessary hospital and department training as required.
  • Assists in the orientation of new personnel under the direction of a manager or Supervisor.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned or required.

(The above statements in this job description are intended to depict the general nature and level of work assigned to the employee(s) in this job. The above is not intended to represent an exhaustive list of accountable duties and responsibilities required).


Must adhere to all of BMC’s RESPECT behavioral standards.



JOB REQUIREMENTS


EDUCATION:

  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • Associate’s Degree or higher preferred.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS REQUIRED:

None.


EXPERIENCE:

  • 4-5 years of office experience, specifically in either a high volume data entry office, customer service call center or health care office or hospital administration is required.
  • Experience using Insurance payer websites (i.e Blue Cross Blue Shield, Medicare, etc.)
  • Customer service experience preferred.
  • Experience with insurance verification, prior authorization, pre-certification and financial clearance process. ​

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES (KSAs):

  • Bilingual preferred
  • Ability to process high volume of requests with a 95% or greater accuracy rate
  • Ability to prioritize work load when processing referrals and authorization requests per guidelines and within specified Turn Around Timeframes
  • Effective collaboration skills
  • Strong oral and written communication skills
  • Thorough knowledge of financial clearance process is a must. Familiarity with insurances, referral authorizations and third party billing procedures.
  • Knowledge of basic medical terminology and ICD-9/CPT coding is helpful.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills to build and maintain strong relationships with managers, colleagues, and third party payers.
  • Must be self-directed and highly organized with the ability to multitask, manage complex processes, and maintain fair sense of urgency.
  • Requires ability to make independent decisions under pressure.
  • Requires excellent judgment, diplomacy, collaboration, partnering, teamwork, and customer service skills.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality of all personal/health sensitive information.
  • Must be comfortable with ambiguity, exhibit good decision making and judgment capabilities, attention to detail.
  • Knowledge of and experience within Epic is preferred.
  • Demonstrates technical proficiency within assigned Epic work queues and applicable ancillary systems, including but not limited to: ADT/Prelude/Grand Centrale.
  • Must be able to maintain strict confidentiality of all personal/health sensitive information.
  • Basic computer proficiency inclusive of ability to access, enter and interpret computerized data/information including proficiency in Microsoft Suite applications, specifically Excel, Word, Outlook and Zoom.
  • Knowledge of medical terminology and/ or coding.

Compensation Range:

$25.80- $31.43

This range offers an estimate based on the minimum job qualifications. However, our approach to determining base pay is comprehensive, and a broad range of factors is considered when making an offer. This includes education, experience, and licensure/certifications directly related to position requirements. In addition, BMCHS offers generous total compensation that includes, but is not limited to, benefits (medical, dental, vision, pharmacy), contract increases, Flexible Spending Accounts, 403(b) savings matches, earned time cash out, paid time off, career advancement opportunities, and resources to support employee and family wellbeing.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Disabled/Veterans

According to the FTC, there has been a rise in employment offer scams. Our current job openings are listed on our website and applications are received only through our website. We do not ask or require downloads of any applications, or “apps” job offers are not extended over text messages or social media platforms. Our careers fit real life. When you join us, you’re not just taking a job. You’re joining a movement to build a more neuroinclusive world. We’re a global community of over 800 employees spanning North America, UK, Europe, Australia, and New Zealand. A career here is purposeful and fast-moving, with clear expectations, modern tools, and the clarity to focus on what matters most.

Our people are supported and encouraged to show up as they are, with different ways of thinking welcomed and valued. We pride ourselves on our core values that are embedded within our culture. These are to be curious, have courage, and commit fully.

Join us at Everway - together, we can unlock the full potential of every mind.

About the role

The Core Account Manager is responsible for growing revenue across an existing portfolio of mid-market customers. You'll build account plans, deepen customer relationships and identify opportunities to increase product adoption and expand customer use of Everway's Planning, Curriculum and AT solutions.

You'll work closely with Customer Success to understand adoption and account-health signals and identify the right time for expansion conversations. You'll also partner with the Renewal Rep to support renewals and at-risk accounts, alongside colleagues across Marketing, Product, Finance, Legal and Implementation.

This role requires travel on an as needed basis to support customer engagement, industry events and sales opportunities.

Main responsibilities

In this role, you will:

  • Own expansion strategy and account plans across an assigned portfolio of existing mid-market customers.
  • Identify and progress cross-sell and upsell opportunities across Everway's Planning, Curriculum and AT solutions.
  • Deepen relationships with key stakeholders across schools, districts and educational organisations, identifying opportunities to increase product penetration and recurring revenue.
  • Coordinate with Customer Success on customer adoption and account-health signals to identify and time relevant expansion conversations.
  • Partner with the Renewal Rep to support renewal outcomes and develop appropriate commercial responses for at-risk accounts.
  • Manage expansion opportunities through the sales cycle, from discovery and qualification through proposal, negotiation and close.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records, pipeline information, forecasts and opportunity reporting across the assigned account portfolio.
  • Partner with Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, Product and Implementation teams to support customer outcomes and account growth.
  • Capture and communicate customer feedback, market intelligence and competitive insights to relevant internal teams.
  • Track progress against agreed expansion revenue, pipeline and activity targets, representing Everway at customer meetings, conferences, webinars and industry events as required.

Essential criteria

  • 3+ years of account management, expansion sales or consultative sales experience in SaaS, EdTech or a related environment.
  • Demonstrated success growing revenue within an existing customer portfolio through cross-sell, upsell or account expansion.
  • Experience managing a portfolio of existing accounts and developing account plans to prioritise growth opportunities.
  • Experience managing commercial opportunities through a structured sales process from discovery through negotiation and close.
  • Consultative selling skills, with experience building relationships across multiple customer stakeholders.
  • Experience managing sales pipeline, forecasting and commercial reporting using CRM data.
  • Communicates clearly and effectively with customers, colleagues and stakeholders.

Desirable criteria

  • K-12, education or public-sector account management or sales experience, including an understanding of education funding cycles and purchasing processes.
  • Familiarity with MEDDPICC or a similar sales methodology.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms such as Salesforce.

raw.description:
¿Qué es?

Es un profesional especializado en el diseño, desarrollo y liberación de arneses eléctricos (conjuntos de cables, conectores y componentes) para sistemas de bajo voltaje (LV) y alto voltaje (HV) en aplicaciones industriales, especialmente en la industria automotriz. Su trabajo garantiza que los sistemas eléctricos sean seguros, eficientes y compatibles con los requisitos de manufactura y calidad.

¿Cómo lo hace?

Utiliza herramientas como Siemens Capital Essentials y CATIA para crear dibujos de manufactura 2D, listas de cables, definiciones de conectores y librerías de componentes.

Colabora con proveedores, fabricantes de contratos (CM) y equipos multifuncionales para asegurar que los diseños cumplan con estándares como IPC/WHMA-A-620, ISO 26262 y USCAR-21/USCAR-2.

Resuelve problemas técnicos durante la instalación, debugging y validación de arneses, asegurando que los sistemas funcionen correctamente en entornos reales.

Participa en procesos de APQP, PPAP y gestión de ECRs para garantizar la calidad y trazabilidad de los diseños.

¿Por qué es importante?

El trabajo del Ingeniero de Arneses Eléctricos es crítico para la electrificación de vehículos y sistemas industriales, ya que:

Asegura la integración técnica entre componentes eléctricos y mecánicos.

Minimiza riesgos de fallos eléctricos en producción masiva.

Optimiza la manufacturabilidad y reduce costos en proyectos de alta complejidad.

Es clave en industrias como automotriz, aeroespacial, energía y robótica, donde la confiabilidad de los sistemas eléctricos es esencial.

Requirements

Experiencia: Mínimo 5 años en diseño de arneses eléctricos (LV/HV), creación de dibujos de manufactura 2D, listas de cables, definiciones de conectores y librerías de componentes en Siemens Capital Essentials.

Herramientas: Dominio de CATIA V5/V6 (rutado 3D) y Siemens Capital Essentials (dibujos 2D, librerías de componentes, símbolos).

Conocimientos técnicos:

Interpretación de esquemas eléctricos lógicos y físicos.

Protocolos de comunicación CAN, LIN, SAE J1939.

Restricciones físicas: protección térmica, durabilidad a vibración, selección de materiales (plásticos, calibres de cobre).

Rutado de cables en interfaces dinámicas (cadenas portacables, radios de curvatura, alivio de tensión, separación LV/HV).

Procesos de calidad: APQP, PPAP, ECRs.

Gestión: Seguimiento de BOM, manejo de proveedores y experiencia en industrialización.

About Prime Pensions

Prime Pensions, Inc. is a nationally recognized actuarial, consulting, and retirement plan administration firm serving employers across the United States since 1975. We specialize in 401(k), profit sharing, cash balance, and defined benefit retirement plans, delivering customized solutions backed by exceptional service, technical expertise, and attention to detail.

Prime Pensions has been recognized as one of the nation's leading defined contribution plan administrators and has been named a Best Place to Work in New Jersey by NJBIZ.

This position is fully remote and will support our Prime Pensions Northwest (PPNW) office.

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Defined Contribution Retirement Plan Administrator to join our Large Plan Services Team. This role provides consulting and administration services to large 401(k) and profit sharing plan clients with complex plan design, recordkeeping, compliance testing, and demographic data needs.

The consultant coordinates with plan sponsors and their service providers on ongoing administration, plan design, regulatory matters, and issue resolution while maintaining high standards of accuracy, communication, quality control, and client service.

Key Responsibilities

    Plan Consulting and Administration

    • Serve as a senior consultant and administrator for large 401(k), profit sharing, and other defined contribution plan clients.
    • Address complex plan design, recordkeeping, compliance testing, and participant demographic data requirements.
    • Advise on single-employer and multiple-employer plan administration, regulatory requirements, and evolving industry practices.
    • Research and resolve complex administrative and regulatory issues, escalating matters as appropriate.

    Compliance and Regulatory Support

    • Perform and review required compliance testing and recommend remedial measures when results are unfavorable.
    • Analyze controlled group matters and their effect on plan administration and compliance.
    • Support plan changes arising from mergers and acquisitions, including implementation and coordination requirements.
    • Coordinate applicable regulatory filings and maintain accurate supporting records.

    Recordkeeping, Data, and Quality Management

    • Work with defined contribution plan recordkeeping systems and supporting administration software.
    • Collect, analyze, reconcile, and validate payroll, human resources, census, and related client data from decentralized systems.
    • Track assigned work in designated Company systems, meet established deadlines, and review deliverables for completeness and accuracy.
    • Apply strong mathematical, research, problem-solving, and quality-control skills to complex client matters.

    Client and Service Provider Coordination

    • Coordinate with plan sponsor contacts and client service providers at all levels regarding ongoing administration, plan design, and regulatory matters.
    • Collaborate with auditors, financial advisors, plan counsel, senior management, and other stakeholders.
    • Communicate technical information clearly and provide responsive, professional client service.

Required Qualifications

    • 8 or more years of defined contribution plan industry experience.
    • Extensive experience supporting large 401(k) and profit sharing plans with complex design, recordkeeping, compliance testing, and demographic data requirements.

Shape how trusted clinical content evolves for the next generation of AI-enabled clinical decision support.

At Wolters Kluwer Health, the UpToDate suite is grounded in rigorous, evidence-based clinical knowledge. As AI changes how clinicians search, interpret, and apply that knowledge, our content strategy mustevolveso contentremainsauthoritative, traceable, structured, and ready for responsible AI-powered experiences.

As Director, Product Management, Content Strategy & AI Readiness, you will be a senior individualcontributorproduct leader responsible for defining product strategy related to content standards, structure, metadata, feedback loops, and AI readiness. You will partneracrossProduct, Editorial, Clinical, Editorial Operations, Engineering, AI, and Analytics to translate content needs into clear priorities, platform requirements, and measurable outcomes. This role helps ensure clinician editors and contributors have workflows and capabilities that allow them to focus on high-value work: clinical insight, evidence synthesis, content creation, and expert curation.

What You'll Do

  • Define the content product strategyrequiredto support responsible AI-enabled clinical decision support experiences.

  • Establish roadmap priorities for improving content readiness for search, retrieval, answer generation, source grounding, and user workflows.

  • Translate content standards, quality expectations, editorial needs, and AI-readiness requirements into scalable product priorities and platform requirements.

  • Lead the evolution of content rubrics and standards in partnership with clinical, editorial, product, and AI teams.

  • Build feedback loops thatidentifycontent gaps, quality issues, user pain points, and opportunities to improve content usefulness.

  • Define requirements for content structure, tagging, taxonomy, metadata, source traceability, and authoring workflows.

  • Partner with Editorial Operations, editorial platform, and engineering teams toidentifyworkflow and tooling needs that make structured content creation, curation, review, and maintenance easier and more scalable.

  • Drive alignment across product, editorial, clinical, engineering, AI, commercial, and leadership stakeholders.

  • Communicate content strategy, priorities, tradeoffs, and impact clearly to senior and executive stakeholders.

What You'll Bring

  • 10+ years of experience in product management, content product, platform product, editorial strategy, knowledge management, taxonomy, healthcare content, or related areas.

  • Demonstrated ability to set product strategy, influence executive stakeholders, and lead complex cross-functional initiatives as an individual contributor.

  • Strong understanding of content quality, editorial workflows, structured content, metadata, taxonomy, or knowledge systems.

  • Ability to translate complex content and platform needs into product requirements, prioritization frameworks, and measurable outcomes.

  • Strong analytical skills and ability to define metrics, feedback loops, and decision frameworks.

  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills across product, editorial, clinical, technical, commercial, and executive audiences.

Preferred Background

  • Experience with healthcare, clinical, regulatory, orprofessional-informationcontent.

  • Experience with AI-enabled search, question answering, retrieval, content platforms, editorial tooling, or knowledge graphs.

  • Familiarity with responsible AI, source grounding, content evaluation, or human-in-the-loop review workflows.

What Success Looks Like

  • Cross-functional teams are aligned on the content capabilities and workflow improvements needed to support AI-ready clinical knowledge.

  • Content standards and rubrics become clearer, more measurable, and easier to operationalize.

  • Content is increasingly structured andmaintainedin ways that improve AI-enabled product experiences.

raw.description:
Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Senior AI Developer

Compensation range: $4,000 AUD - $5,000 AUD / Monthly

Engagement type:Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with Brisbane business hours (approx. 9 AM - 5 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration, but as a contractor, you’ll have flexibility in how you manage your time.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: A training organisation delivering nationally recognised hospitality training across Brisbane and the Gold Coast. The business is focused on improving student outcomes and modernizing its internal processes through AI, with a growing focus on streamlining compliance documentation, assessment mapping, policies, and training strategies.

Role Overview: You will be our first dedicated AI developer and the technical owner of a five-tool suite in addition to other tools as they evolve to streamline and support the management of the training organisation. Each tool takes national training package data, combines it with our own context and materials, and produces audit-ready drafts that our team reviews and finalizes.

This is a hands-on build role with real ownership. You will shape the architecture, choose the right models and services, write the code, test accuracy against human experts, and deliver polished tools our non-technical staff use every day

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the technical design, build, testing and release of all five tools
  • Engineer prompts, retrieval pipelines and structured outputs that keep every claim grounded in source documents
  • Build evaluation sets with our compliance team, and measure accuracy against human reviewers
  • Create high-quality document exports using proper Word styles, templates and branding
  • Manage hosting, security, data handling and costs, with clear reporting on usage and spend
  • Translate VET and compliance requirements into practical features, asking sharp questions along the way
  • Document everything clearly so the suite stays maintainable and fully owned by 1 Education
  • Spot new automation opportunities across the business and bring ideas to the table

What You Will Build

Tool 1

Assessment Tool Mapper (TOP PRIORITY)

Validates an assessment tool against every requirement of the units in a cluster, with evidence and reasoning for each decision.

  • Ingest assessment tools (Word, PDF) and pull unit requirements from training.gov.au, recording the release version used
  • Rate every performance criterion, performance evidence, knowledge evidence, foundation skill and assessment condition as Fully, Partially or Not Covered
  • Cite the exact evidence location (document, section, question, page) with a short quote, plus a rationale and suggested fix for each gap
  • Track required volumes such as "on at least 3 occasions" and route context-dependent items to a human reviewer
  • Produce a colour-coded validation report (Word, PDF, optional Excel matrix) with executive summary, gap list, cross-unit matrix and reviewer sign-off
  • Target 85%+ agreement with experienced human validators, with every rating linked to real document text

Tool 2

Assessment Tool Generator

Generates a complete, compliant assessment pack for one or more units, ready for a qualified assessor to review.

  • Knowledge questions across multiple formats, each with a model answer, acceptable response range and satisfactory benchmark
  • Observation checklists linked to performance criteria and evidence, with assessor instructions, resources and S / NYS outcomes
  • Full pack structure: cover sheet, student and assessor instructions, reasonable adjustment guidance, marking guide, results summary and appeals note
  • Context settings for industry, job role, workplace type and learner level, with single-question regeneration and version history
  • Mapping matrix showing 100% coverage, with output that passes the Tool 1 validator with every item covered

Tool 3

Training and Assessment Strategy (TAS) Generator

Turns a guided questionnaire into a detailed, audit-ready TAS written to the Standards for RTOs 2025.

  • Pull qualification packaging rules, core and elective units, AQF level and nominal hours, and check elective choices against packaging rules
  • Design a branching, save-as-you-go questionnaire with help text and examples that an RTO representative completes unaided
  • Generate a tailored TAS with delivery schedule, amount of training rationale, assessment strategy, RPL, learner support and validation
  • Map content to the 2025 Outcome Standards, holding the Standards as editable reference data with a recorded version
  • Export a clean Word document with styles, clickable contents, well-behaved tables and versioned headers and footers

Tool 4

Learner Guide Generator

Creates contextualized learning resources in print, slide and online formats, aligned to the matching assessment tool.

  • Cover every element, performance criterion, knowledge evidence item and foundation skill, tailored to industry and job role
  • Read the assessment tool and produce an alignment matrix linking unit requirement, learning content and assessment item
  • Output a print-ready and screen-friendly Word Learning Guide, a PowerPoint deck per unit with speaker notes, and SCORM 1.2 / 2004 packages
  • Interactive knowledge checks and completion tracking in SCORM, accessible to WCAG 2.1 AA and tested on a live platform
  • Cite legislation and codes of practice for reviewer verification, with section-level regeneration and version history

Tool 5

Procedure and Policy Generator

Produces a consistent suite of RTO policies, procedures and forms mapped to every clause of the 2025 Standards and Queensland SAS requirements.

  • Capture the RTO profile and real operating practice through guided questions, so documents reflect how the business actually runs
  • Generate policies, step-by-step procedures (roles, timeframes, decision points, records) and every linked form and template
  • Apply one master template for identical styles, numbering, version control and terminology across the suite
  • Build a master compliance matrix by clause and by document, with gap flagging, plus an Excel document register
  • Flow edits through related documents, forms and the matrix, with change logs and approval sign-off

Shared Platform Foundations
All five tools share a common core. Building this well once is where your senior judgement makes the biggest difference.

  • Training package data. Reliable retrieval from training.gov.au web services and data feeds, with release-version tracking and manual unit upload as an override.
  • Reference data. The 2025 Standards and SAS requirements held as versioned, editable data, so updates flow through without a rebuild.
  • Accuracy and hallucination control. Evidence-linked outputs, structured generation, evaluation sets and repeatable results, so the same inputs give consistent outputs.
  • Human in the loop. Every output treated as a draft, with clear flags for items needing human input and easy reviewer edits before finalizing.
  • Document generation. Professionally styled Word, Excel, PDF, PowerPoint and SCORM outputs with RTO branding.
  • Privacy and security. Australian hosting where possible, transparent data handling and model providers configured so RTO content stays out of model training.
  • Ease of use. A clean, simple web interface built for non-technical trainers and compliance staff.
  • Ownership and handover. Full documentation, with 1 Education owning all code, prompts, templates and accounts.


Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of software development experience, including 2+ years building production applications on large language models
  • Strong Python and/or TypeScript, with experience building full-stack web applications
  • Hands-on work with LLM APIs (Claude, OpenAI or similar), retrieval-augmented generation, structured outputs and document parsing
  • A proven approach to accuracy and hallucination control, including evaluation and regression testing
  • Experience generating well-formatted Word, Excel and PDF files programmatically (e.g. python-docx, docx, openpyxl)
  • Cloud deployment experience (AWS, Azure or GCP), with sound security and data privacy practices
  • A portfolio of AI document-analysis, document-generation or compliance tools you have built and shipped
  • Excellent written and spoken English, and confidence explaining technical choices to a non-technical owner

Highly Regarded

  • Experience in Australian VET, education or another regulated, compliance-heavy sector
  • Working knowledge of training.gov.au, units of competency or the Standards for RTOs
  • SCORM 1.2 / 2004 packaging and LMS testing experience
  • PowerPoint generation (e.g. python-pptx) and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility
  • UX design skills for guided questionnaires and wizard-style interfaces
  • Agentic AI workflows and tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or similar AI-assisted development


How We Will Measure Success

  • Tool 1 ratings agree with an experienced human validator on 85%+ of items, with every rating citing real document text
  • Generated assessment packs map 100% of unit requirements and pass the Tool 1 validator in full
  • TAS, learner guides and policy suites are judged audit-ready by a compliance consultant with only light editing
  • Word, Excel and PowerPoint exports open and edit cleanly, with styles, contents and tables intact
  • SCORM packages import and track completion on the test platform
  • Our team uses the tools independently, turning hours of work into minutes


Why You Will Love This Role

  • Greenfield ownership of a meaningful AI product suite, from architecture to release
  • Direct access to the business owner and quick decisions
  • Clear, well-scoped briefs for every tool, with room to shape the solution
  • Work that helps students build real careers in hospitality
  • A long-term pipeline of work, with more AI projects ready once this suite is live


Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

All it takes to get started is for you to complete an easy online application and an informal interview with a talent acquisition specialist. If you do not have your equipment, MCI will provide it. You will need a home broadband connection.

WHAT DOES A WORK AT HOME CONTACT CENTER REPRESENTATIVE DO?

This position supports customer service, technical support, and customer sales interactions. This role requires you to interact with hundreds of customers each week across the country to resolve support issues, sell new products and services, and ensure best in class customer experience. In addition to being the best in the business when it comes to customer interactions, you will need to be confident, fully engaged, a team player, and dedicated to bringing a positive and enthusiastic outlook to work each day.

Qualifications

  • Must be 18 years of age or older

  • Excellent organizational, written, and oral communication skills
  • The ability to type swiftly and accurately (20+ words a minute)
  • Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook)
  • Basic understanding of Windows operating system
  • Highly reliable with the ability to maintain regular attendance and punctuality
  • The ability to evaluate, troubleshoot, and follow-up on customer issues

We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.

Ogłoszenie o pracę: Front End Engineer

Lokalizacja: Zdalnie
Forma zatrudnienia: Freelance
