Data rozpoczęcia: 01.09.2024
Język: Angielski

Opis stanowiska:

Nasz klient, dynamiczny startup z Belgii, specjalizujący się w oprogramowaniu do zarządzania energią przemysłową w sektorze energii odnawialnej, poszukuje Front End Engineer'a do swojego innowacyjnego zespołu technologicznego. Wspierany przez międzynarodowych klientów korporacyjnych i inwestorów, nasz klient jest zaangażowany w rozwiązywanie wyzwań związanych z transformacją energetyczną z kreatywnością, efektywnością i zabawą.

Twoje główne zadania:

  • Tworzenie przyjaznych dla użytkownika interfejsów aplikacji dla klientów, administratorów i partnerów.
  • Wizualizacja wyników analizy danych.
  • Podsumowanie ekonomicznego i ekologicznego wpływu produktu dla kluczowych interesariuszy.
  • Ścisła współpraca z zespołem technicznym i szerokim zespołem w celu budowania wspólnej wizji i mapy drogowej produktu.

Wymagania:

  • Pasja do produktów danych i opowiadania historii za pomocą danych.
  • Doskonała dbałość o szczegóły i praktyczne doświadczenie w inżynierii Front End z React.
  • Umiejętność tworzenia frameworków wizualizacji danych i wartościowanie prostoty.
  • Proaktywne podejście i zdolność do zadawania właściwych pytań w celu osiągnięcia celów.
  • Chęć podejmowania wyzwań i rozwijania się w firmie.

Umiejętności techniczne:

  • Biegłość w rozwoju front end przy użyciu React, szczególnie w pracy z aplikacjami webowymi opartymi na danych.
  • Znajomość wizualizacji danych (wykresy, serie czasowe itp.).
  • Znajomość Python, najlepiej z FastAPI.
  • Ta rola jest fullstackowa, z podziałem 80% front end / 20% back end.
  • Umiejętność przeprowadzenia projektu od zera i zaangażowanie się w decyzje architektoniczne.
  • Znajomość automatycznych frameworków testowania front-endu.

Umiejętności miękkie:

  • Doskonałe umiejętności komunikacyjne w języku angielskim.
  • Pragmatyczne i proaktywne podejście.
  • Pasja i motywacja do przyczyniania się do transformacji energetycznej.

Dołącz do tętniącej życiem atmosfery startupu naszego klienta, gdzie będziesz mieć wolność i odpowiedzialność za podejmowanie decyzji wpływających na rozwój i innowacyjność.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,
leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.

We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.

What You’ll Do:

  • Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.
  • Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.
  • Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.
  • Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have:

  • A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.
  • Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.
  • Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.
  • Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.

What We Offer

  • A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products
  • A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive
  • Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity
  • The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry
  • Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture
  • The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more
  • An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain

The France Based Salary range for this role is: 30,000-100,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.

Think you’re a good fit for this job?

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace.

Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

raw.description:
About Ottimate

Ottimate is an AI-powered AP [Accounts Payable] automation platform that empowers finance teams to reduce costs, prevent overpayments, detect fraud, and enforce policy compliance across the entire invoice-to-payment lifecycle.

About the role

We’re looking for a capable, growth-minded software engineer to join our team as its third engineer. This is an ideal opportunity for an early-to-mid-career engineer who wants meaningful ownership, close collaboration with experienced teammates, and the opportunity to grow quickly.

Our team solves real customer problems across a mature financial platform. The work ranges from building product features to investigating production incidents, improving database performance, strengthening security boundaries, and maintaining reliable accounting and payment workflows.

We use AI-assisted development tools extensively, but we do not treat generated code as automatically correct. A successful engineer in this role will know how to use tools such as Claude Code or Codex to navigate unfamiliar systems and accelerate development while remaining responsible for correctness, security, testing, and operational safety.

You do not need experience with every technology or with fintech. We care more about strong fundamentals, curiosity, sound judgment, and the ability to learn quickly.

Responsibilities

  • Build, test, and maintain backend product features, primarily using Python, Django, and relational databases.
  • Use AI coding tools to investigate problems, implement changes, write tests, and improve documentation.
  • Critically review AI-generated code for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability.
  • Turn customer feedback into reproducible technical problems, fix the root cause, check whether customer data was affected, and update it.
  • Translate ambiguous customer feedback into reproducible technical problems and practical product improvements.
  • Own work from initial investigation through implementation, testing, QA, deployment verification, and follow-up.
  • Build and maintain APIs, asynchronous jobs, integrations, internal tools, and data-processing workflows.
  • Write clear, maintainable code with appropriate automated test coverage.
  • Participate in code reviews and technical discussions with the rest of the engineering team.
  • Improve system reliability, observability, documentation, and development processes.
  • Protect financial correctness, tenant isolation, data integrity, auditability, and customer privacy.
  • Gradually take ownership of larger features and technical decisions as you grow in the role.

Requirements

  • Professional software engineering experience at an early-to-mid-career level.
  • Strong working knowledge of Python.
  • Experience designing, querying, and debugging applications backed by relational databases.
  • Familiarity with APIs, automated testing, Git, and collaborative software-development practices.
  • Experience using AI-assisted coding tools in real development work.
  • The ability to evaluate and validate generated code rather than accepting it automatically.
  • Strong debugging skills, including in an unfamiliar codebase, and the habit of asking what a bug did to customer data, then helping correct it.
  • An understanding of common application concerns such as authorization, concurrency, retries, idempotency, and failure handling.
  • Clear written and verbal communication.
  • A careful approach to systems that handle sensitive business and financial data.
  • Comfort working on a small team with broad ownership and changing priorities.
  • Curiosity, humility, and a willingness to ask questions, receive feedback, and learn new systems.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Django or another Python web framework.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, query analysis, and database-performance optimization.
  • Familiarity with Celery or another asynchronous job-processing system.
  • Experience with AWS, ECS, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with observability tools such as ClickStack, Sentry, or OpenTelemetry.
  • Experience with TypeScript, Angular, or another modern frontend framework.
  • Experience building or maintaining fintech, accounting, accounts-payable, payments, or ERP-integration software.
  • Experience working directly with customers, support teams, or other non-engineering stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with access controls, audit trails, data remediation, and safe bulk-data operations.
  • Experience supporting production systems or participating in incident investigation.

What makes someone successful in this role

  • You’ll thrive here if you are pragmatic, dependable, and comfortable working through ambiguity. You should enjoy understanding how systems behave in the real world—not just writing code from a ticket.
  • The strongest candidate will use AI to move faster while retaining ownership of the result. They will verify assumptions, test important behavior, consider failure cases, and communicate clearly when something remains uncertain.
  • We are not looking for someone who already knows every technology or financial concept we use. We’re looking for a generally capable engineer with good instincts, customer empathy, and a strong learning mindset.
  • This role offers close collaboration and mentorship from experienced engineers, along with the opportunity to make a visible impact on a growing product and engineering team.

Benefits

We care deeply about making Ottimate an incredible place to work and invest a significant amount of time and energy into creating and maintaining a company culture that provides our team with a generous level of support whilst inspiring them to do their best work.

The specific benefits/perks we offer are continually evolving, but currently include:

  • Salary Range: USD $130,000-155,000 (depending on level) per year + annual bonus.
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and other Company-Subsidized Benefits for you and your family.
  • Employer-sponsored 401(k) with company match.
  • Paid Time Off (and the encouragement to use it).
  • Promote from within philosophy.

Beyond the tangible benefits, though:

  • You will be part of a growing team, at a pinnacle moment of scale for the business, and experience the excitement of working in a startup where each action makes a huge difference.
  • You will have the agency to solve difficult problems creatively, the freedom to explore work that inspires you, and infrastructure to ensure you're constantly challenged and developing.
  • You will work with sharp, passionate teammates solving some of the most unique challenges and positioning our product as a premier finance automation solution.
  • Our commitment to empowering a diverse and inclusive workforce, celebrating differences, and creating a safe space for our employees to bring their whole selves to work is second to note.
  • We are transforming entire industries using innovative technology, including Artificial Intelligence, Payment Tech, and Neural Networks.
  • Our leaders lead with a people-first approach; inspiring excellence, nurturing ideas, and finding creative ways to eliminate obstacles for cultivating growth.
  • We truly love what we do and who we do it with - and we think you will too!

Ottimate is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability status, or marital status. If you are excited about the role but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. Nothing in this job posting should be construed as an offer or guarantee of employment.

raw.description:
TFS HealthScience is a leading global mid-size Contract Research Organization (CRO) that partners with biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies throughout their entire clinical development journey. Our expertise includes full service-capabilities, resourcing and Functional Service (FSP) solutions.

Join Our Team as aClinical Database Programming Process Lead - home based in UK, Sweden, Germany, Spain, Portugal or Poland

About this role

As part of our CDSGroup Management (Operations) team you will be working alongside passionate and innovative professionals to ensure our customers achieve their goals.

The Clinical Database Programming Process Leadis responsible for the ongoing ownership, strategy, and development of a consistent, scalable and high-quality clinical database programming capability across TFS.

The role combines:

(1) enterprise subject matter expertise and capability ownership;

(2) governance, quality and continuous improvement leadership;

(3) senior technical and operational support across Business Units for complex issues, strategic priorities and agreed capacity gaps. Business Units retain accountability for study delivery and local resource management.

What Will Make You Successful in This Role?

Success in this role requires a strong combination of deep hands-on clinical database programming experience, strategy and change management, as well as leadership. You will be able to assess complex technical and operational challenges, provide pragmatic, compliant, risk-based recommendations and build productive relationships across Business Units and global stakeholder groups.

You will bring credibility as a senior technical expert, who drives consistent standards, quality, cost and service definitions, capability development and continuous improvement. You will be comfortable leading with influence, communicating complex matters clearly, and applying technical expertise to drive change and action.

Key Responsibilities:

Capability and Process Ownership

  • Develop, maintain and deliver the Database Programming capability plan and prioritised improvement roadmap.

  • Own and continuously improve the DBP governance and operating model, including roles, responsibilities, decision rights, escalation routes and cross-BU forums.

  • Maintain enterprise standards, playbooks, templates, tools, reusable libraries and the DBP knowledge repository.

Quality, Compliance and Inspection Readiness

  • Act as process owner or designated SME for relevant global SOPs, Work Instructions, templates and controlled documents, coordinating changes through the applicable QMS process.

  • Monitor quality trends, recurring issues, CAPAs and systemic risks, and lead practical, risk-based improvement actions.

  • Promote consistent application of validation, testing, change control, documentation, database build and database lock requirements.

  • Provide DBP expertise for audits, inspections, client assessments and remediation activities, including preparation and follow-up where required.

Technical Leadership and Escalation Support

  • Act as senior DBP technical escalation point for complex, high-risk or strategically important DBP issues

  • Provide targeted hands-on support where required to protect delivery, resolve priority issues or address short-term capability gaps.

  • Establish and maintain a flexible resource-support model across Business Units for agreed workload peaks, absences and critical delivery periods.

  • Assess EDC/CDMS platform readiness, system changes, migrations and standards-library opportunities, and coordinate recommendations with relevant system and process owners. Support practical technical decision-making across the EDC platforms used by TFS and future platforms adopted by the organisation.

Training, Competency and Workforce Development

  • Define and maintain the DBP competency framework, training plan, onboarding pathway and technical career-development materials. Lead or coordinate technical training, mentoring, coaching and knowledge-sharing activities.

  • Establish and maintain deputy, back-up, succession and business-continuity arrangements to reduce key-person dependency.

  • Support workforce planning, role design, recruitment criteria, interview materials and technical assessment of DBP candidates.

Commercial, Proposal and Business Support

  • Maintain standard DBP costing assumptions, proposal guidance and service descriptions in coordination with relevant commercial and operational stakeholders.

  • Provide SME input for bid defence preparation or client discussions involving DBP capability, EDC platform readiness or database programming considerations.

  • Promote sustainable handover, measurable benefits and continued adoption of agreed improvements.

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years’ relevant experience in database programming, clinical systems or clinical data operations within a CRO, pharmaceutical, biotechnology or clinical research environment, including experience operating at Principal Database Programmer, Senior Principal Database Programmer, DBP SME, Capability Lead or equivalent level.

  • Significant direct technical knowledge and experience of clinical database build, validation, edit checks, data transfer programming, database lock and EDC study set-up processes.

  • Experience with one or more major EDC/CDMS platforms, with ability to work across multiple systems.

  • Strong understanding of GxP expectations relevant to clinical systems, database programming, validation, testing, documentation and inspection readiness.

  • Experience supporting audits, inspections, CAPAs or quality improvement actions.

  • Demonstrable experience developing or improving SOPs, Work Instructions, templates, standards, training materials or process documentation.

  • Experience leading technical training, mentoring or coaching to database programming staff.

  • Ability to work across multiple Business Units and stakeholder groups without direct line authority.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and practical risk-based decision-making skills.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with ability to translate technical DBP issues into practical business recommendations

  • Ability to manage an ongoing portfolio of capability, governance, improvement and operational-support priorities

Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting EDC platform change, system migration, standards library development or process transformation.

  • Experience working in a mid-sized CRO and decentralised cross-BU operating model

What We Offer

We provide a competitive compensation package, comprehensive benefits and the opportunity for personal and professional growth in a rewarding environment. You’ll be joining a team that values collaboration, innovation, and making a difference in the lives of patients

For candidates based in Spain - TFS is committed to equal opportunities. All our vacancies are open to people with disabilities, in accordance with the General Law on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (Royal Legislative Decree 1/2013).

A Bit More About Us

Our journey began over 30 years ago in Sweden, in the city of Lund. As a full-service, global Contract Research Organization (CRO), we build solution-driven teams working towards a healthier future. Bringing together over 600 professionals, TFS delivers tailored clinical research services in more than 50 countries with flexible clinical development and strategic resourcing solutions across key therapeutic areas including Dermatology, Neuroscience, Oncology and Ophthalmology.

Our core values of Trust, Quality, Passion, Flexibility, and Sustainability are our guiding light serving as the framework for decision-making at all levels of the organization. They assist us in attracting and retaining valuable talent who share our sentiments, resulting in high employee engagement and satisfaction. By aligning on these fundamental values, we cultivate a unified force, geared towards innovation and excellence. This collective effort propels us towards our shared goal and fosters a culture of mutual respect and collaboration.

Together we make a difference.

raw.description:
Our clinical activities are growing rapidly, and we are currently seeking an Experienced Clinical Research Associate to join our Clinical Operations team in Austria (home-based). This position will work on a team to accomplish tasks and projects that are instrumental to the company’s success. If you want an exciting career where you use your previous expertise and can develop and grow your career even further, then this is the opportunity for you!


Responsibilities

  • Conduct qualification, initiation, monitoring, and closeout visits for research sites in compliance with the approved protocol;
  • Communication with the medical site staff including coordinators, clinical research physicians and their site staff;
  • Verifying adequate investigator qualifications, training and resources, including facilities, laboratories, equipment, and staff;
  • Medical record and research source documentation verification against case report form data, including informing the site staff of any entry errors, ensuring good documentation practices are being adhered to and communicating protocol deviations appropriately per SOPs, GCP and applicable regulatory requirements;
  • Verification that the investigator is enrolling only eligible subjects;
  • Regulatory document review;
  • Medical device and/or investigational product/drug accountability and inventory;
  • Verification and review of adverse events, serious adverse events, concomitant medications and corresponding illnesses to confirm accurate data reporting in accordance with the protocol;
  • Assessing the clinical research site’s patient recruitment and retention success and offering suggestions for improvement;
  • Completion of monitoring reports and follow-up letters, which includes providing summaries of the significant findings, deviations, deficiencies, and recommended actions to secure compliance.

Qualifications

  • Must have a minimum of a university degree in a health or life science related field;
  • Min. 1.5 years of previous experience as a CRA;
  • Approximately 60-80% travel in Germany, Austria and Switzerland;
  • Proficient knowledge of Microsoft® Office and general computer literacy;
  • Outstanding communication and Presentation skills;
  • Must be detail-oriented and efficient in time management;
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and German;
  • Proven track record of demonstrating experience in clinical patient management, protocol, CRF, preparing of ISF, documentation to be submitted to competent authorities.

Please note that this role is fully remote-based in Austria. We kindly ask you to submit your application in English.



Medpace Overview

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. We leverage in-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6,500 people across 40+ countries.


Why Medpace?

When you join Medpace, you become part of an innovative team that brings cutting-edge therapies to market while building a meaningful and rewarding career focused on scientific excellence and improving patient outcomes around the world through continuous learning and cross-functional collaboration.

Purpose-Driven Work

    • Work alongside physicians, scientists, and industry-leading experts committed to advancing the global development of medical therapeutics through clinical research excellence

Collaborative Culture

    • Contribute to an interactive team environment that empowers decision making, creative thinking, and continuous learning through open communication and mutual trust.
    • Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable

Continuous Growth & Development

    • Office based environment with on-site mentors
    • Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities
    • Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development
    • Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
    • An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly

Other Employee Benefits

    • Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance
    • Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits
    • Office based culture with occasional WFH that provides flexibility for eligible positions after training
    • Company-sponsored social events

Please note benefits may vary based on country.

What to Expect Next

A Medpace team member will review your application and if your profile matches our current needs, you will be contacted for an interview. While we review all applications carefully, we are unable to respond to every applicant, and only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

Who we are

BrightOrder builds fleet maintenance and management software and telematics. For 30+ years we've helped fleets and repair shops keep vehicles on the road and margins intact. The role

You'll own BrightOrder's marketing plan and do a good share of the work yourself. This is a hands-on leading role, not a management seat. You set direction, build campaigns, write when it matters, read the data, and adjust. You'll also mentor two specialists and keep the team's priorities clear and moving with direct access to leadership and real influence over how marketing works here.

How the team works

You lead and mentor two specialists: one on digital and growth marketing, one on market research. We use AI tools daily and expect you to push that further. You work directly with the President and closely with Sales, Product and Customer Experience.

Stack: HubSpot, Webflow, GA4, LinkedIn and Google Ads.

See yourself at Dataminr

Dataminr is seeking a Senior Account Executive to sell our Cyber Defense solutions to high-profile US SLED accounts and ensure that Dataminr’s real-time information alerts get into the right hands at the right time. You'll deliver unique and impactful solutions to your SLED clients while exceeding quotas and establishing strong customer relationships.

This is a US-based remote role preferred locations are The Mid Atlantic or NorthEast with travel across the East Coast.

AI Innovation at Dataminr

Working at Dataminr you’ll have the opportunity to tackle the most exciting trends in AI on a daily basis to power a revolutionary product that uncovers critical events around the world as they unfold.

Regenerative AI: our AI technology, ReGenAI, is a new form of generative AI that automatically regenerates real-time Live Event Briefs as events unfold. Learn more here.

Agentic AI: we recently launched our Agentic AI capability, what we’re calling our Intel Agents, that autonomously generates critical context for our clients on real-time events, threats, and risks allowing them to see the clearest, most accurate view of what’s happening on the ground. Learn more here

Multimodal AI:our platform detects events from many different types of data (images, video, sensor data, audio, and text in over 150 languages). Learn more here.

The opportunity

  • Meet sales quota and drive success: Conduct and execute detailed sales campaigns, achieving quarterly and annual sales targets with a robust, measurable sales process
  • Build a pipeline, leverage partners and network: Build a strong pipeline through proactive prospecting, strategic networking, and leveraging our growing list of partners
  • Cultivate strong client relationships: Cultivate and sustain valuable client relationships whilst skilfully navigating and closing complex enterprise deals
  • Develop deep customer insights: Develop comprehensive insights into customer use cases, internal decision-making processes, budget cycles, and other critical information
  • Master competitive analysis: Analyze the competitive landscape and understand customer needs in order to position Dataminr’s portfolio of solutions effectively to meet customer needs and stand out from the competition
  • Provide product feedback: Provide valuable feedback to cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering) to drive the continuous enhancement, updates and improvements of our products

What you bring

At Dataminr, we value you for who you are. We encourage you to apply for this role, even if you don't meet every qualification. Our candidates are reviewed on the basis of their skill and potential to succeed.

  • Minimum 8 years full sales cycle experience selling enterprise cyber security technology solutions to a SLED client base across the Eastern US
  • Expertise in prospecting via a multi-channel approach including cold calling, channel partner relationships, LinkedIn outreach and networking
  • You have built relationships with senior cyber buyers and are able to leverage your existing network to gain introductions into new logos
  • A strategic seller, with expertise in account planning, you use a clear sales process (MEDDPICC preferred) to qualify and move deals through the pipeline to close
  • A history of consistent quota achievement and ability to deliver consistently against targets
  • Great understanding of a complex sales process and business drivers for enterprise clients

About Dataminr

At Dataminr, we are a mission driven team of talented builders, creators and visionaries who have real-world impact on how organizations are able to respond to events. Dataminr’s groundbreaking, AI-powered, intelligence platform provides organizations with the earliest signals of emerging risks, events, and threats before they unfold. Trusted by two-thirds of the Fortune 50 and half of the Fortune 100, Dataminr’s platform analyzes billions of public data inputs spanning text, image, video, audio and sensor data across 150+ languages, empowering our clients to stay one step ahead in an increasingly complex world where every second counts.

Founded in 2009, we have pioneered the world’s first real-time event detection platform, long before the recent Gen AI ‘boom.’ Dataminr operates all around the world united by our passion to use AI for the greater good, be agents of positive change and put our technology into the hands of clients charged with the responsibility to keep organizations running and keep people safe.

As our employees focus on developing our revolutionary technology, we focus on our employees. Dataminr is proud to offer a variety of flexible work arrangements, offices all over the world to foster collaboration, generous PTO and sick leave, and more, as part of our competitive benefits package aimed at keeping all our employees happy and healthy. Explore all our benefits here.

We believe our differences give us strength. Our employees are empowered to be their best, authentic selves through various opportunities, such as our robust employee resource group (ERG) network, manager development programming, professional development funds, and more.

We serve a global community made up of many cultures and strive to reflect the world and clients we serve, with a workforce built on merit and equity. We actively condemn racism and discrimination in any form. We stand for social good, fostering a culture of allyship, and standing up for those who face systemic barriers to equality. We lead with empathy and strive to be agents of positive change in our company and in our communities.

The annual on-target earnings (OTE) for this position are $231,200 - $340,000, which consists of the annual base salary and annual commission target for the role. You will also be eligible to receive Company equity. Actual OTE will be based on a number of factors including, but not limited to, geographic location, applicant skills, and prior relevant experience.

Dataminr is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. With over an 80+ year legacy of advancing science and a mission of innovating for a healthier world, our dedicated team collaborates closely with commercial, government, academic and healthcare customers to deliver our broad portfolio of analytical solutions, and OneSource services.

Job Title

Regional Marketing Specialist North Europe


Location(s)

High Wycombe, United Kingdom - Remote

Job Description

We are seeking a Regional Marketing Specialist to act as a strategic marketing partner to the Regional Vice President (RVP) and regional leadership team. This role is responsible for understanding and supporting regional business objectives, including pipeline growth, revenue targets, and brand development, while ensuring regional priorities are aligned with and represented within Global Strategic Plans.

While product strategy and content creation are led by the centralised Portfolio & Segment Marketing team, the Regional Marketing Specialist for North Europe will drive execution across the UK, Ireland, DACHP, Nordics, Benelux, and South Africa. The role focuses on stakeholder management, regional insight, and alignment of marketing activities to ensure local opportunities and requirements are effectively reflected in global initiatives.


Whilst the role is Remote, there is an expectation to attend meetings in High Wycombe on an ad hoc basis, plus travel to Sales meetings and trade shows. This will come to about a week per quarter. Candidates living in a 2 hour travelling distance of our office in High Wycombe are preferred.


Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Partnership & Planning

  • Partner with the RVP and regional leadership team to understand business priorities and develop marketing plans that support pipeline growth, revenue objectives, customer engagement, and brand awareness.
  • Act as the voice of the region within global marketing teams, ensuring regional market dynamics, customer insights, and commercial priorities are reflected in global strategies and programmes.
  • Monitor local market trends, business performance, and customer needs to provide strategic recommendations and identify opportunities to accelerate growth.

Regional Marketing Execution

  • Develop and execute integrated marketing programmes across digital, events, partner, account-based, and demand generation channels to support regional objectives.
  • Adapt global campaigns and initiatives to maximise relevance and impact within regional markets, ensuring effective localisation where required.
  • Manage the end-to-end delivery of regional marketing activities, balancing strategic priorities with changing business needs and market conditions.
  • Work closely with sales and business leaders to ensure marketing programmes support pipeline creation, progression, and revenue goals.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with central marketing functions, including portfolio, segment, digital, and the global events co-ordinator, to develop and execute regionally relevant marketing programmes that align with business priorities and drive measurable outcomes.
  • Ensure regional marketing plans and activities remain aligned to global marketing priorities, strategic focus areas, and campaign frameworks, maintaining consistency in messaging, positioning, and customer experience across markets.
  • Serve as a trusted marketing partner to regional sales leaders and product specialists, aligning marketing plans and investments to business priorities and driving marketing's contribution to pipeline growth and revenue performance.
  • Influence and coordinate stakeholders across global and regional teams to ensure consistent messaging, effective execution, and alignment with strategic business objectives.

Performance & Optimisation

  • Monitor and report on marketing performance, including pipeline contribution, lead quality, conversion, engagement, and ROI.
  • Analyse campaign and programme results to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
  • Use data and insights to make recommendations, optimise marketing investment, and continuously improve programme effectiveness.
  • Maintain an agile approach, adjusting plans and tactics in response to business priorities, market changes, and performance outcomes.

Experience and qualifications required

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications,
  • At least 5 years of experience in B2B marketing, preferably within a global organization.
  • Proven ability to translate business strategy into regional marketing plans and actions.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience influencing senior leaders.
  • Solid understanding of integrated marketing, digital engagement, and demand generation.
  • Experience collaborating with centralized marketing teams and coordinating across functions and geographies.
  • Analytical mindset with proficiency in marketing metrics, pipeline reporting, and ROI analysis.
  • Some knowledge of German would be an advantage but not essential.

Virtual Clinical Intake Specialist (Bilingual Therapist, Telehealth)

Fully Remote | 1099 Independent Contractor | Evenings | Work From Home
Florida LMHC, LCSW, LMFT, or Registered Intern | Bilingual English & Spanish Required

Support Our Admissions Team as a Contract Clinician

When a teen is struggling, the first conversation changes everything, and that conversation is yours. Adolescent Wellness Academy is a behavioral health program serving teens across South Florida. We’re looking for a bilingual, Spanish-speaking therapist to partner with us as a contract clinician leading virtual Connection Calls: telehealth intake assessments with adolescents ages 13–17 and their families. On each call you’ll screen for mental health and safety needs and decide whether our Partial Hospitalization (PHP) or Intensive Outpatient (IOP) program fits. Families leave the call ready for care. Our clinicians get a clear clinical picture before day one.

Compensation

Florida Licensed (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT)Florida Registered Interns (RMHCI, RCSWI, RMFTI)Rate$60 per assessment$35 per assessmentIncludesCall + documentationCall + documentationAvailability WindowMon–Fri, 5–8 PM ESTMon–Fri, 5–8 PM ESTStatus1099 Contractor1099 Contractor

Calls are scheduled within the availability window, Monday through Friday, based on your availability. You’re paid for every booked assessment, no matter how long it runs.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead telehealth intake assessments with teens and their parents or caregivers
  • Complete CALOCUS level-of-care screenings, crisis assessments, and suicide risk assessments
  • Recognize when a teen needs crisis intervention, escalation, or a higher level of care
  • Document clinical findings and coordinate admissions with the Admissions and treatment teams

What You Bring

  • Active Florida license as a Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC), Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW), or Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT), or Florida Registered Intern status
  • Fluent English and Spanish
  • Experience as a counselor, therapist, or clinician working with adolescents in PHP, IOP, or other behavioral health settings
  • Skills in crisis assessment, risk assessment, and de-escalation
  • A private home office with reliable internet for HIPAA-compliant telehealth sessions
  • Evening availability within our Mon–Fri, 5–8 PM Eastern window

Help teens feel heard and families feel supported from the very first conversation.

Learn More: Adolescent Wellness Academy
